title: Every Wrong Answer Counts: Option-Level Psychometrics for LLM Multiple-Choice Benchmarks
summary: Most multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmarks evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) only by whether they select the correct answers. This binary scoring treats all incorrect responses alike, even though an LLM's preferences among incorrect options may contain systematic and useful information about its behavior and ability. We introduce the LLM Nominal Response Model (LLM-NRM), an option-aware psychometric framework that models the full distribution over answer choices to jointly estimate LLM ability and option-level item characteristics, while separating model-specific response calibration sharpness, positional preference, and difficulty-dependent fallback behavior. Across 189 LLMs and 31,554 items from 14 benchmarks, LLM-NRM predicts held-out LLM-item interactions more accurately than binary Item Response models and conventional nominal-response baselines, and its ability estimates achieve the strongest Spearman correlation of 0.920 with the external human-preference Arena.ai Elo leaderboard. Distractor identity contributes +101% additional Fisher Information per item beyond correctness, and incorrect responses alone recover full-information ability estimates with Spearman 0.943. The learned item parameters also enable efficient benchmarking, where 41 selected items preserve the full-bank ranking with Kendall's correlation 0.85, corresponding to a 770 times reduction. In conclusion, we show that incorrect answers carry distinct and useful measurement information rather than representing equivalent mistakes.

AI.title_translation: 每个错误答案都重要：LLM多项选择基准中的选项级心理测量学
AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-NRM框架，通过分析LLM在多项选择题中对所有选项（包括错误选项）的选择分布，更准确地评估LLM能力和题目特征，并显著提高基准测试效率，证明错误答案包含有用的测量信息。
AI.motivation: 大多数多项选择题（MCQ）基准仅通过LLM是否选择正确答案来评估其能力，这种二元评分方式将所有错误答案一视同仁，忽略了LLM在错误选项之间的偏好可能包含关于其行为和能力的系统性和有用信息。
AI.method: 本文引入了LLM名义响应模型（LLM-NRM），这是一个选项感知的心理测量框架，它建模答案选择的完整分布，以联合估计LLM能力和选项级项目特征，同时分离模型特定的响应校准锐度、位置偏好和难度依赖的后备行为。
AI.result: LLM-NRM在189个LLM和14个基准的31,554个项目中，比二元项目响应模型和传统的名义响应基线更准确地预测了LLM-项目交互。其能力估计与外部人工偏好Arena.ai Elo排行榜的斯皮尔曼相关系数达到最高的0.920。干扰项的身份贡献了超出正确性101%的额外费舍尔信息。仅通过错误响应就能恢复斯皮尔曼相关系数为0.943的完整信息能力估计。学习到的项目参数还实现了高效基准测试，其中41个选定项目以0.85的肯德尔相关系数保持了完整题库的排名，相当于减少了770倍。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出结论，错误答案携带着独特而有用的测量信息，而不是代表等价的错误。
AI.translation: 大多数多项选择题（MCQ）基准仅通过LLM是否选择正确答案来评估大型语言模型（LLM）。这种二元评分方式将所有不正确的响应一视同仁，即使LLM在不正确选项之间的偏好可能包含关于其行为和能力的系统性和有用信息。我们引入了LLM名义响应模型（LLM-NRM），这是一个选项感知的心理测量框架，它建模答案选择的完整分布，以联合估计LLM能力和选项级项目特征，同时分离模型特定的响应校准锐度、位置偏好和难度依赖的后备行为。在189个LLM和14个基准的31,554个项目中，LLM-NRM比二元项目响应模型和传统的名义响应基线更准确地预测了LLM-项目交互，其能力估计与外部人工偏好Arena.ai Elo排行榜的斯皮尔曼相关系数达到最高的0.920。干扰项的身份贡献了超出正确性101%的额外费舍尔信息，仅通过不正确的响应就能恢复斯皮尔曼相关系数为0.943的完整信息能力估计。学习到的项目参数还实现了高效基准测试，其中41个选定项目以0.85的肯德尔相关系数保持了完整题库的排名，相当于减少了770倍。总之，我们表明不正确的答案携带着独特而有用的测量信息，而不是代表等价的错误。
AI.summary: 本文提出LLM名义响应模型（LLM-NRM），这是一个创新的心理测量框架，旨在通过分析LLM在多项选择题中对所有选项（包括错误选项）的完整选择分布，来更全面地评估LLM的能力和题目特征。与传统仅关注正确答案的二元评分方法不同，LLM-NRM能够捕捉错误答案中蕴含的系统性信息。实验结果表明，该模型能更准确地预测LLM行为，其能力评估与人类偏好基准高度相关（斯皮尔曼相关系数0.920）。此外，通过对错误选项的深入分析，该方法显著提高了基准测试的效率，实现了大规模题目数量的缩减，同时保持了评估的准确性。这证明了错误答案并非简单的错误，而是包含有价值的测量信息。
AI.keywords: LLM, 心理测量学, 多项选择题, 名义响应模型, 基准测试
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于它挑战了传统多项选择题基准测试中对LLM的二元评分范式，并提出了一个更精细的选项级心理测量框架。通过深入挖掘错误答案中的信息，该方法不仅提高了LLM能力评估的准确性，还显著提升了基准测试的效率，这对于未来LLM的快速迭代和评估具有重要意义。它揭示了即使是错误的答案也能提供关于模型行为和能力的宝贵洞察。

title: HyperFL: Query-Adaptive Representation Learning for Software Fault Localization
summary: Software fault localization identifies the code locations responsible for reported issues and is a fundamental step toward automated debugging and program repair. Recent retrieval-based approaches formulate fault localization as a dense retrieval task by learning a shared embedding space between issue reports and source code. However, these methods encode all issue reports using a fixed query representation, despite the substantial diversity of real-world issue reports in length, structure, and debugging information. To address this limitation, we propose HyperFL, a query-adaptive representation learning framework for software fault localization. HyperFL employs a lightweight hypernetwork to generate query-specific LoRA parameters for the query encoder, enabling dynamic query adaptation while keeping the code encoder fixed and reusable. Experiments on a real-world issue localization benchmark demonstrate that HyperFL consistently improves retrieval performance across multiple embedding backbones, achieving up to 13.3% relative improvement in function-level MRR@10 and 16.7% relative improvement in Hit@1 over the state-of-the-art method SweRank. Further analysis shows that HyperFL learns distinct adaptation patterns for different issue characteristics, highlighting the effectiveness of query-adaptive representations for software issue localization.

AI.title_translation: HyperFL: 查询自适应表示学习用于软件故障定位
AI.tldr: HyperFL通过为查询编码器生成查询特定的LoRA参数，实现了查询自适应的表示学习，显著提高了软件故障定位的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的检索式故障定位方法使用固定的查询表示来编码所有问题报告，但实际问题报告在长度、结构和调试信息上存在显著多样性，这限制了其性能。
AI.method: 提出HyperFL，一个查询自适应表示学习框架。它使用一个轻量级超网络为查询编码器生成查询特定的LoRA参数，实现动态查询适应，同时保持代码编码器固定和可重用。
AI.result: 在真实世界问题定位基准测试中，HyperFL在多个嵌入骨干上持续提高检索性能，函数级MRR@10相对改进高达13.3%，Hit@1相对改进高达16.7%，超过了现有SOTA方法SweRank。分析表明HyperFL为不同问题特征学习了独特的适应模式。
AI.conclusion: HyperFL通过查询自适应表示学习，有效解决了软件故障定位中问题报告多样性带来的挑战，显著提升了定位性能。
AI.translation: 软件故障定位旨在识别导致报告问题d的代码位置，是自动化调试和程序修复的关键一步。最近的基于检索的方法通过学习问题报告和源代码之间的共享嵌入空间，将故障定位表述为密集检索任务。然而，这些方法使用固定的查询表示来编码所有问题报告，尽管实际问题报告在长度、结构和调试信息上存在显著多样性。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了HyperFL，一个用于软件故障定位的查询自适应表示学习框架。HyperFL采用一个轻量级超网络为查询编码器生成查询特定的LoRA参数，从而实现动态查询适应，同时保持代码编码器固定且可重用。在真实世界问题定位基准测试上的实验表明，HyperFL在多个嵌入骨干上持续提高了检索性能，在函数级MRR@10上实现了高达13.3%的相对改进，在Hit@1上实现了高达16.7%的相对改进，优于最先进的方法SweRank。进一步分析表明，HyperFL为不同的问题特征学习了独特的适应模式，突出了查询自适应表示在软件问题定位中的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了HyperFL，一个针对软件故障定位的查询自适应表示学习框架。针对现有方法在处理多样化问题报告时使用固定查询表示的局限性，HyperFL利用轻量级超网络为查询编码器动态生成查询特定的LoRA参数，从而实现对不同问题报告的灵活适应，同时保持代码编码器的通用性。实验证明，HyperFL在故障定位任务中显著提升了性能，超越了现有SOTA方法，并能为不同问题特征学习到独特的适应模式。
AI.keywords: 软件故障定位, 查询自适应, 表示学习, 超网络, LoRA
AI.comments: HyperFL的创新之处在于引入了超网络来动态生成查询编码器的LoRA参数，从而实现了查询自适应的表示学习，有效解决了软件故障定位中问题报告多样性的挑战。这种方法提高了检索性能，并保持了代码编码器的可重用性，对自动化调试和程序修复领域具有重要意义。

title: Coverage Matters: MarginMerge for Compressing Multi-Vector Visual Document Retrievers
summary: Multi-vector visual document retrievers such as ColPali and ColQwen achieve strong retrieval by storing fine-grained patch embeddings, but this produces large indexes and costly late-interaction scoring. We argue that effective compression should preserve query-relevant coverage, meaning the diverse document regions that may become the strongest MaxSim match across queries, rather than selecting patches independently by salience. This view also explains why dense rendered pages are easier to compress than natural images. We introduce MarginMerge, a compression method for frozen multi-vector retrievers. It selects coverage-aware anchors, clusters document patches, and uses a lightweight shared network to synthesize one representative per cluster. Compression is performed once during indexing, while retrieval keeps the standard MaxSim interface. Across six datasets on both ColQwen2.5 and ColPali, MarginMerge achieves the highest matched query-agnostic average at 5% and 10% vector retention. Compared with the uncompressed index using the same backbone, it preserves between 97% and 99% of average nDCG@5 while reducing stored document vectors by between 90% and 95%. At 5% retention, it also reduces ranking flips relative to geometric merging on all six ColQwen2.5 datasets by approximately 41% on average. The same model transfers to unseen datasets and retention ratios without retraining.

AI.title_translation: 覆盖率至关重要：MarginMerge用于压缩多向量视觉文档检索器
AI.tldr: 多向量视觉文档检索器虽然强大但索引庞大。MarginMerge通过保留查询相关的覆盖范围来压缩它们，以显著更少的向量实现高检索性能并减少排名翻转。
AI.motivation: 多向量视觉文档检索器（如ColPali和ColQwen）通过存储细粒度补丁嵌入实现强大检索，但这导致索引庞大且后期交互评分成本高昂，因此需要有效的压缩方法。
AI.method: MarginMerge是一种针对冻结多向量检索器的压缩方法。它选择覆盖率感知的锚点，对文档补丁进行聚类，并使用轻量级共享网络为每个聚类合成一个代表。压缩在索引期间执行一次，检索保持标准MaxSim接口。
AI.result: 在ColQwen2.5和ColPali的六个数据集上，MarginMerge在5%和10%向量保留率下取得了最高的查询无关平均值。与未压缩索引相比，它在减少90%-95%存储文档向量的同时，保留了97%-99%的平均nDCG@5。在5%保留率下，它还使ColQwen2.5所有六个数据集上相对于几何合并的排名翻转平均减少约41%。该模型无需重新训练即可迁移到未见数据集和保留率。
AI.conclusion: MarginMerge通过关注查询相关的覆盖范围，有效压缩了多向量视觉文档检索器，显著降低了索引大小和计算成本，同时保持了高检索性能和良好的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 多向量视觉文档检索器，如ColPali和ColQwen，通过存储细粒度补丁嵌入实现强大的检索，但这会产生巨大的索引和昂贵的后期交互评分。我们认为，有效的压缩应保留查询相关的覆盖范围，这意味着可能在查询中成为最强MaxSim匹配的各种文档区域，而不是独立地通过显著性选择补丁。这一观点也解释了为什么密集渲染页面比自然图像更容易压缩。我们引入了MarginMerge，这是一种用于冻结多向量检索器的压缩方法。它选择覆盖率感知的锚点，对文档补丁进行聚类，并使用轻量级共享网络为每个聚类合成一个代表。压缩在索引期间执行一次，而检索保持标准MaxSim接口。在ColQwen2.5和ColPali的六个数据集上，MarginMerge在5%和10%的向量保留率下实现了最高的匹配查询无关平均值。与使用相同骨干网络的未压缩索引相比，它在将存储的文档向量减少90%到95%的同时，保留了97%到99%的平均nDCG@5。在5%的保留率下，它还在所有六个ColQwen2.5数据集上将相对于几何合并的排名翻转平均减少了约41%。相同的模型可以在不重新训练的情况下迁移到未见数据集和保留率。
AI.summary: 本文提出MarginMerge，一种针对多向量视觉文档检索器的压缩方法，旨在解决其索引大和评分成本高的问题。该方法通过选择覆盖率感知的锚点、聚类文档补丁并合成代表来保留查询相关的文档区域。MarginMerge在不影响检索性能（保持97%-99% nDCG@5）的情况下，将文档向量减少90%-95%，并在多个数据集上显著降低了排名翻转，且无需重新训练即可泛化。
AI.keywords: 多向量检索器, 视觉文档检索, 压缩, MarginMerge, 覆盖率
AI.comments: MarginMerge的创新之处在于其“覆盖率至关重要”的理念，即在压缩时关注保留查询相关的多样化文档区域，而非独立选择显著补丁。这不仅解释了某些现象，还提供了一种有效的压缩策略，显著降低了多向量检索器的存储和计算成本，同时保持了高检索性能和良好的泛化能力，对于实际应用具有重要意义。

title: Mapping the City Through the Lens of Language Models
summary: Language models often complete an underspecified reference to a city with unstated assumptions about urban size, form, infrastructure, environment, and function. We measure those assumptions without naming places. Ten open-weight checkpoints rate anonymized profiles derived from real morphological urban centres across 40 audited indicators and seven domains. The design combines constrained probability-based ratings, prespecified reliability screens, lineage-aware aggregation, multiple population weightings, an independent replication sample, and whole-profile validation. The clearest shared tendency favours urban profiles with larger developed area, faster recent growth, greater mapped infrastructure and non-residential capacity, and less sparse form. Most eligible directions recur in the replication data, and direct ratings of complete profiles show moderate agreement with the indicator-wise construction. Geographic differences shrink after accounting for city scale and development, while reliably measured paired tasks indicate that typicality and desirability are often closely aligned. The framework makes an otherwise vague notion of what models regard as an ordinary city empirically traceable. The resulting evidence delineates a shared yet model-dependent portrait of the city through the lens of language models.

AI.title_translation: 通过语言模型视角下的城市映射
AI.tldr: 本研究测量了语言模型在提及城市时隐含的假设，发现它们偏好规模更大、增长更快、基础设施更完善、非住宅容量更大且形态不稀疏的城市，并提供了一个经验可追溯的框架来理解语言模型对城市的认知。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在完成对城市的不明确引用时，常常包含对城市规模、形态、基础设施、环境和功能等方面的未明确假设，本研究旨在测量这些假设。
AI.method: 研究使用了十个开放权重检查点，对来自真实形态城市中心的匿名化档案进行评分，涉及40个审计指标和七个领域。设计结合了约束概率评分、预设可靠性筛选、血统感知聚合、多重人口加权、独立复制样本和全档案验证。
AI.result: 语言模型最明显的共同趋势是偏好具有更大开发面积、更快近期增长、更多映射基础设施和非住宅容量以及更不稀疏形态的城市档案。大多数符合条件的方向在复制数据中重现，完整档案的直接评分与指标构建显示出中度一致性。在考虑城市规模和发展后，地理差异缩小，且典型性和 desirability 常常紧密相关。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使得模型将普通城市视为一个模糊概念变得可经验追溯。研究结果描绘了通过语言模型视角下对城市的共享但依赖于模型的画像。
AI.translation: 语言模型在完成对城市的不明确引用时，常常包含对城市规模、形态、基础设施、环境和功能等方面的未明确假设。我们测量了这些假设，而没有命名具体地点。十个开放权重检查点对来自真实形态城市中心的匿名化档案进行了评分，涉及40个审计指标和七个领域。设计结合了约束概率评分、预设可靠性筛选、血统感知聚合、多重人口加权、独立复制样本和全档案验证。最明显的共同趋势是语言模型偏好具有更大开发面积、更快近期增长、更多映射基础设施和非住宅容量以及更不稀疏形态的城市档案。大多数符合条件的方向在复制数据中重现，并且完整档案的直接评分与指标构建显示出中度一致性。在考虑城市规模和发展后，地理差异缩小，而可靠测量的配对任务表明典型性和 desirability 常常紧密相关。该框架使得模型将普通城市视为一个模糊概念变得可经验追溯。研究结果描绘了通过语言模型视角下对城市的共享但依赖于模型的画像。
AI.summary: 本研究测量了语言模型在提及城市时所隐含的未明确假设。通过对来自真实城市中心的匿名化档案进行多维度评估，研究发现语言模型普遍偏好规模更大、增长更快、基础设施更完善、非住宅容量更大且形态不稀疏的城市。该研究提供了一个经验可追溯的框架，揭示了语言模型对城市的一种共享但依赖于模型的认知画像。
AI.keywords: 语言模型, 城市映射, 城市特征, 隐含假设, 城市规划
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过创新的方法，量化了语言模型对城市特征的隐含认知，揭示了模型在处理城市概念时的内在偏好。其重要性在于为理解和改进语言模型在地理和城市规划领域的应用提供了新的视角和经验证据。方法的严谨性体现在其结合了多种验证手段，增强了结果的可靠性。

title: ConFL: Explainable Concurrent Fault Localization via Hierarchy-Guided LLM Reasoning
summary: Localizing concurrent bugs from bug reports alone is challenging due to incomplete information, misleading program-entity mentions, and complex cross-thread interactions, causing existing LLM-based approaches to suffer from unstable reasoning and limited explainability. We propose ConFL, an explainable concurrent fault localization framework that augments LLM reasoning with structured concurrency knowledge. ConFL constructs a Concurrent Knowledge Base (CKB) from source code and performs LLM-guided hierarchical retrieval to progressively narrow the search space from components to interaction-level concurrency contexts. An interaction-level DSL explicitly encodes cross-thread interactions over shared resources, enabling focused reasoning without traversing deep call chains. Experiments on real-world concurrent bugs from eight large-scale Java projects show that ConFL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art IR-based and LLM-based baselines, achieving an MRR of 0.503 and a MAP of 0.486, while remaining robust to noisy bug reports, unseen bugs, and different LLM backbones.

AI.title_translation: ConFL：通过层次引导的LLM推理实现可解释的并发故障定位
AI.tldr: ConFL通过结构化并发知识增强LLM推理，实现可解释的并发故障定位，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 从错误报告中定位并发错误具有挑战性，原因包括信息不完整、误导性程序实体提及以及复杂的跨线程交互，导致现有基于LLM的方法推理不稳定且可解释性有限。
AI.method: ConFL构建了一个并发知识库（CKB），并执行LLM引导的层次检索，逐步缩小搜索空间，从组件到交互级并发上下文。交互级DSL明确编码了共享资源上的跨线程交互，从而实现聚焦推理，而无需遍历深层调用链。
AI.result: 在八个大型Java项目的真实并发错误上的实验表明，ConFL显著优于最先进的基于IR和基于LLM的基线，实现了0.503的MRR和0.486的MAP，同时对嘈杂的错误报告、未见过的错误和不同的LLM骨干保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ConFL通过结构化并发知识增强LLM推理，有效解决了并发故障定位的挑战，并在实际应用中表现出优越的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 从错误报告中定位并发错误是具有挑战性的，原因在于信息不完整、误导性的程序实体提及以及复杂的跨线程交互，这导致现有的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的方法在推理上不稳定且可解释性有限。我们提出了ConFL，一个可解释的并发故障定位框架，它通过结构化并发知识增强LLM的推理能力。ConFL从源代码构建了一个并发知识库（CKB），并执行LLM引导的层次检索，以逐步将搜索空间从组件缩小到交互级并发上下文。一个交互级领域特定语言（DSL）明确编码了共享资源上的跨线程交互，从而实现聚焦推理，而无需遍历深层调用链。在来自八个大型Java项目的真实并发错误上的实验表明，ConFL显著优于最先进的基于信息检索（IR）和基于LLM的基线，实现了0.503的平均倒数排名（MRR）和0.486的平均精度（MAP），同时对嘈杂的错误报告、未见过的错误和不同的LLM骨干保持鲁棒性。
AI.summary: ConFL是一个可解释的并发故障定位框架，旨在解决现有LLM方法在处理并发错误报告时推理不稳定和可解释性差的问题。它通过构建并发知识库（CKB）和利用LLM引导的层次检索，逐步缩小故障搜索范围，并使用交互级DSL明确编码跨线程交互，避免了深层调用链的遍历。实验证明，ConFL在真实世界的并发错误定位中显著优于现有基线，并展现出对噪声和不同LLM模型的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 并发故障定位, 大型语言模型, 可解释性, 层次检索, 并发知识库
AI.comments: ConFL的创新之处在于将LLM的推理能力与结构化的并发知识（通过CKB和交互级DSL）相结合，有效解决了并发故障定位中信息不完整和复杂交互的挑战。其层次引导的检索和交互级DSL设计提高了定位的准确性和可解释性，对软件调试领域具有重要意义。

title: TQLite: Multi-LLM Jury Guided Distillation for Real-time MQM Translation Quality Evaluation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in MQM-based translation quality (TQ) evaluation, and recent advances in large reasoning models (LRMs) promise even greater improvements. However, both LLMs and LRMs are computationally expensive to deploy at scale, while small language models (SLMs)---though much more efficient---struggle with the complex reasoning required for evaluation tasks. In this work, we present an extensive empirical study benchmarking SLMs, LLMs, and LRMs across a wide range of TQ evaluation setups, providing a comprehensive view of the current landscape and establishing best practices. To address the scalability challenge, we introduce TQLite, a novel distillation framework that enables SLMs to approach the MQM evaluation performance of the best LRM-based evaluators. Our approach leverages a multi-LRM jury to generate high-quality synthetic training data via practical data curation techniques and aggregation of evaluation responses across a diverse panel of models. Our results demonstrate that SLMs trained via TQLite achieve strong MQM evaluation performance that far exceeds off-the-shelf evaluation capabilities of standard SLMs, offering a scalable and cost-effective alternative to LLM- and LRM-based evaluators.

AI.title_translation: TQLite：多大模型陪审团指导的实时MQM翻译质量评估蒸馏方法
AI.tldr: 提出TQLite蒸馏框架，利用多大模型陪审团指导小模型训练，实现低成本且高效的实时MQM翻译质量评估。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型和推理模型虽然在基于MQM的翻译质量评估中表现出色，但部署成本高昂；而小语言模型虽然高效，却缺乏完成复杂评估所需的推理能力，难以直接应用。
AI.method: 提出TQLite蒸馏框架，利用多大推理模型（LRM）陪审团通过数据筛选技术和多模型响应聚合生成高质量合成训练数据，从而训练小语言模型（SLM）。
AI.result: 经TQLite训练的小语言模型在MQM评估性能上显著超越了现有的标准小模型，达到了接近顶级大推理模型的效果，提供了一种可扩展且具有成本效益的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: TQLite框架成功将大推理模型的复杂MQM评估能力蒸馏到小语言模型中，在大幅降低计算成本的同时保持了出色的评估性能。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在基于MQM的翻译质量（TQ）评估中表现出令人印象深刻的性能，大型推理模型（LRMs）的最新进展更承诺带来更大的改进。然而，LLM和LRM在大规模部署时的计算成本都很高，而小型语言模型（SLMs）虽然效率高得多，却难以应对评估任务所需的复杂推理。在这项工作中，我们进行了广泛的实证研究，对SLMs、LLMs和LRMs在各种TQ评估设置中进行了基准测试，提供了当前格局的全面视图并确立了最佳实践。为了应对可扩展性挑战，我们引入了TQLite，这是一个新颖的蒸馏框架，使SLMs能够接近基于LRM的最佳评估器的MQM评估性能。我们的方法利用多LRM陪审团，通过实际的数据策展技术和跨多样化模型面板的评估响应聚合，生成高质量的合成训练数据。我们的结果表明，通过TQLite训练的SLMs实现了强大的MQM评估性能，远远超过了标准SLMs的现成评估能力，为基于LLM和LRM的评估器提供了一个可扩展且具成本效益的替代方案。
AI.summary: 论文针对翻译质量评估中大模型成本高、小模型能力弱的矛盾，提出了名为TQLite的新型蒸馏框架。该框架利用多LRM陪审团生成合成数据来指导SLM训练，使SLM在保持高效的同时具备了接近顶尖大模型的MQM翻译评估性能。
AI.keywords: Translation Quality Evaluation, Multilingual Large Language Models, Knowledge Distillation, Model Merging, MQM
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种多大语言模型陪审团指导的小模型蒸馏框架（TQLite），有效解决了机器翻译质量评估中大模型计算成本高、小模型推理能力不足的矛盾，为实现实时、低成本的高质量翻译评估提供了切实可行的方案。

title: Sequential Operational Decision-Making for Power System Resilience Under Evolving Wildfires
summary: This paper proposes a novel automated decision-support framework aimed at enhancing the resilience of power systems and operational resilience against wildfires by formulating the decision-making process as a stochastic multi-stage programming during a progressive wildfire. The paper develops a framework that takes into account both preventive and corrective actions, enabling automated and adaptive decisions based on potential scenarios over the course of a wildfire's progression. This approach considers the evolving nature of the wildfire threat and seeks to optimize the response strategies accordingly throughout its duration. The objective is to minimize wildfire risk and operational costs while reducing load curtailment. The framework accounts for potential contingencies caused by progressive wildfires. A novel algorithm is proposed to construct a decision tree based on wildfire progression and system geographical information. Additionally, a novel stochastic dual dynamic programming approach is deployed to solve the proposed optimization problem, achieving a global optimum for the framework. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated on the IEEE 30-bus system under various wildfire impact scenarios and is then applied to the IEEE 300-bus system to illustrate the scalability of the proposed approach. The results highlight the advantages of the proposed automated framework over a single-stage operational optimization strategy in enhancing power grid resilience under wildfire conditions.

title: Enhancing Operational Grid Resilience Against Wildfires Under Decision-Dependent Uncertainties
summary: This paper proposes a new automated decision-making framework to enhance the resilience of electrical systems against wildfires by applying operational strategies that account for decision-dependent uncertainty (DDU). The proposed framework incorporates both preventive and corrective measures, enabling adaptive and automated decision-making throughout the course of evolving wildfire scenarios. First, a baseline multistage optimization model is presented as a foundation to support wildfire-driven operational decision-making. The model then incorporates DDU, wherein Public Safety Power Shutoff (PSPS) decisions made in earlier stages influence the probabilities and parameters of future wildfire scenarios. To efficiently solve the resulting complex optimization problem, a mathematical decomposition algorithm is employed. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated through case studies on the IEEE 30-bus system. Simulation results confirm that incorporating the impact of DDU into the optimization process provides more realistic, and operationally resilient solutions in the face of evolving wildfire threats.

title: Qwen-3D: A Generalist 3D Vision-Language Model for Spatial Understanding
summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have achieved remarkable success on images and short videos, yet scaling them to long videos remains challenging due to frame-centric tokenization and limited context windows. 3D geometry provides a natural compression mechanism for visual streams: depth and camera pose enable observations from multiple views and time steps to be fused into a persistent, world-aligned representation. While recent 3D LMMs leverage geometry-aware representations to improve spatial reasoning, they continue to lag behind specialist 3D perception systems on grounding and segmentation tasks. We argue that a key limitation is geometry-aware decoding: existing methods communicate 3D predictions through language tokens, proposal selection, or lightweight grounding queries, creating a bottleneck between language reasoning and dense geometric prediction. Building on these insights, we introduce Qwen-3D, a geometry-aware LMM that compresses visual information within the Qwen backbone using multi-view geometric cues, enabling efficient long-horizon visual reasoning over static scenes. Qwen-3D augments visual tokens with 3D Rotary Positional Embeddings, allowing attention to operate directly in 3D scene space rather than across independent image frames and thereby facilitating scalable cross-view and temporal reasoning. To bridge language and geometry, Qwen-3D incorporates a query-based segmentation decoder that grounds language directly in the underlying 3D scene representation, unifying referential grounding, instance segmentation, and visual question answering across both images and videos. Across a diverse set of benchmarks, Qwen-3D surpasses existing 3D LMMs and outperforms several large proprietary 2D models. Notably, Qwen-3D achieves these improvements while maintaining strong performance on standard 2D vision-language benchmarks by jointly training on 2D and 3D data.

title: Temporal Leakage in LLM Backtesting: Measurement, Validation, and Adjusted Scores
comments: 12 pages main content, 45 pages in total
summary: The standard check for contamination in LLM backtests is simple: compare scores before and after the training cutoff. We show this check is uninformative. Four flagship models fail it on questions they cannot have memorized: every scored question resolved after their cutoffs. The reason is structural. Models legitimately know more about times near their cutoff, so recency mimics leakage, and we prove no passive backtest can separate the two from genuine skill. Measurement, not just detection, requires information from outside the backtest. We supply it in two forms. A known cutoff identifies leakage at the boundary; a matched clean control identifies it globally and yields a leakage-adjusted score. We also derive where leakage hides: it concentrates on outcomes that surprised the crowd and were well covered in training, and partial memorization is disproportionately rewarded. We validate the estimators against ground truth by planting leakage in twin models, where they recover the injected dose and return null on clean questions. Deployed on frontier models, they detect one cutoff-localized signature and, at the audit's power floor, clear five models whose apparent advantages were recency alone. Backtests need not be discarded; they need one defensible reference.

title: Internalising the Identity Primitive: Cryptographic Individuality for an Autonomous Agent on a Public Blockchain
comments: 52 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Cryptographic key-to-weights binding (W = HKDF(sk) inside Groth16) with an on-chain state-commitment chain on Solana devnet; active-query, homeostatic, and economic-metabolism extensions; 166- and 168-cycle continuous runs. Code, threat model, and per-cycle telemetry: https://github.com/ksk-S/internalising-identity-2026 (tag arxiv-v1)
summary: A software agent on a public blockchain accumulates authority and economic stakes, raising the engineering question of what makes it count as an individual. The paper's central contribution is a shift of trust root for the key-to-weights binding of agent identity: from hardware, operator, or wrapper trust to cryptographic assumptions enforced by a pinned implementation (liveness, key custody, oracle trust, and the underlying software stack remain external). We design and deploy on Solana devnet an agent whose neural-network weights are a deterministic function of its private key. The binding is committed in zero knowledge at genesis, re-checked against that commitment at every state transition, and signed by the agent into an on-chain history unforkable once finalized; in a PoC-tier extension, a protocol-imposed metabolic cost is debited each cycle from a key-derived economic account, adding a consumption-side economic-viability constraint to the key-history-economy triple. Empirically, the agent completes a 2.36-day on-chain run with two host-side resumptions but no rejected transition, at bounded per-transition verification cost; a substituted substrate is rejected on chain, and independently keyed agents diverge as predicted while a same-key control stays at zero. To our knowledge, this is the first published on-chain agent whose identity primitive is itself a cryptographic invariant re-checked at every state transition. The resulting transition-time invariant instantiates the cryptographic individuality proposed by Suzuki 2026's Artificial Externality framework.

title: CAMTA: A Reconfigurable Multi-Region Activation Unit for Nonlinear Function Approximation
summary: Nonlinear activation functions are widely used in machine learning workloads, but their direct hardware implementation is often costly, function-specific, or difficult to reuse across different models. This work introduces CAMTA, a 16-bit reconfigurable multi-region activation unit for nonlinear function approximation in FPGA and ASIC accelerators. CAMTA combines independent region thresholds, per-region polynomial degrees, coefficient sets, and execution modes over a shared Horner-based datapath. Unlike conventional polynomial or piecewise approximation units that mainly reconfigure coefficients or segment selection, CAMTA also reconfigures the computational behavior of each region through HORNER, CONST, ZERO, and IDENTITY modes, enabling the same hardware to support functions with different symmetry and tail behavior without resynthesis. FPGA validation on an AMD Alveo platform shows RMSE as low as \(3.60\times10^{-6}\) for CAMTA-assisted Softmax, outperforming the CORDIC-based Softmax baseline considered in this work by nearly one order of magnitude. FPGA HLS synthesis reports 3 DSPs, 802 FFs, 1756 LUTs, and an 11-cycle datapath latency. ASIC synthesis in TSMC 65~nm at 250~MHz reports \(6632.40~μ\mathrm{m}^2\) total cell area and \(1.3634~\mathrm{mW}\) total power. Compared with a same-node, function-specific PLAC implementation, CAMTA incurs \(2.20\times\) area and \(1.75\times\) power overhead, in exchange for runtime configurability and reuse across multiple nonlinear functions.

title: AcceptMoE: Commitment-Weighted Self-Sizing Verifier Expert Sets for Efficient MoE Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding verifies a tree of draft tokens in one target-model forward pass. For a mixture-of-experts (MoE) target, however, parallel verification can activate the union of the experts selected by all tree nodes, even though only a small subset of those nodes reaches the accepted output. Token count, activated-expert union size, and expert-weight traffic are therefore distinct cost measures: reducing the token workload need not shrink the expert union proportionally, and under offloading, transfer traffic also depends on cache residency. We introduce AcceptMoE, a verifier-side expert selector that combines target-router scores with offline-estimated commitment probabilities and automatically adjusts the number of eligible experts for each verification block, eliminating the need for a user-specified expert budget. Under offloading, AcceptMoE conditions expert eligibility on cache residency instead of predicting natural routes and prefetching the corresponding expert weights. Although constraining target-expert eligibility changes the model distribution, across 12 model-task pairs spanning three MoE targets and four benchmarks, AcceptMoE's mean accuracy is 0.27 percentage points lower than that of EAGLE-3 speculative decoding with natural routing. Served with SGLang at batch size one, it reaches 1.290 times the throughput of this baseline with all expert weights in GPU memory, and 2.06 times under physical expert offloading, while reducing host-to-device traffic by 73.6 percent to 77.1 percent.

title: EmbodiedVAE: Disentangled Video VAE for Efficient and Controllable Embodied Manipulation
summary: Latent diffusion models (LDMs) have recently significantly advanced embodied learning in constructing powerful embodied manipulation world models. However, despite the remarkable performance, existing LDMs predominantly rely on Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) optimized for natural scenes while failing to account for the unique characteristics of embodied manipulation scenarios, yielding latent representations that are neither compact nor controllable, thereby hindering efficient training of LDMs and precise robotic control. To solve this problem, we present EmbodiedVAE, a novel video VAE that provides compact yet controllable latent representations tailored for the robotic manipulation world models. Specifically, EmbodiedVAE adopts a dual-encoder, single-decoder architecture with an asymmetric spatio-temporal compression module, which automatically disentangles the robot arm's motion from background environment, resulting in overall compactness while providing explicit embodied latent to support fine-grained action control. To further preserve the temporal consistency of learned robotic motion latent, we introduce an optimal-transport-based consistency module that explicitly enforces motion fidelity and inter-frame coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed EmbodiedVAE achieves superior reconstruction quality with high compression rate, while enabling more precise action control in robotic manipulation scenarios with an average of 2dB PSNR improvement over state-of-the-art video VAEs.

title: Joint Affine Spectral Shaping: Coupling Weight and Bias Updates Beyond Weight-Only Muon
summary: Matrix spectral optimizers reshape weight-update spectra but usually delegate vector-valued biases to a separate optimizer. We study whether this separation is neutral. We formulate each affine layer as a joint momentum matrix $A=[M_W,αm_b]$ and apply a capped regularized-inverse spectral map to the complete matrix, producing both the weight and physical bias updates. A strict five-seed ablation on a four-layer BERT-mini trained from scratch on IMDb compares exact-SVD Muon, weight-only inverse shaping, affine-probe inverse shaping, and the proposed joint regularized inverse (JRI). Weight-only inverse shaping raises validation-loss-selected test accuracy from $84.903\pm0.242\%$ to $85.562\pm0.308\%$ and lowers selected test loss from $0.3479$ to $0.3345$. Allowing bias to alter the joint SVD while retaining an independent Adam bias update does not improve over weight-only inverse shaping. Using the transformed bias jointly raises selected test accuracy to $85.738\pm0.180\%$ and lowers test loss to $0.3291$, with all five seeds improving relative to the probe baseline. During the peak-performance window, JRI preserves the eligible weight-update norm while reducing the bias-update norm from $0.02095$ to $0.00301$, lowers boundary-function share from $86.58\%$ to $78.97\%$, and changes the cosine between weight-induced boundary motion and explicit bias from $+0.030$ to $-0.137$. An independent 22-seed replication yields $85.743\pm0.203\%$ selected test accuracy. These results identify joint affine spectral allocation as a small but consistent extension to weight-only spectral optimization.

title: Neurosymbolic Reasoning with Incremental Knowledge for Sample Efficient Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
summary: (Flat) Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents face significant challenges in environments with sparse rewards that require long-horizon reasoning. A compelling approach to improve sample efficiency is to incorporate knowledge into learning and decision-making. In standard Hierarchical RL (HRL), knowledge is encoded in a fixed, non-updatable form, such as architectural choices, and remains unchanged throughout learning. With fixed HRL, reasoning with incremental knowledge learned during exploration is impractical before sufficient environmental knowledge is acquired, leading to poor sample efficiency. In this work, we propose neurosymbolic HRL with {\em Incremental Knowledge (InK)}: symbolic high-level components perform {\em symbolic planning} (e.g. using $D^*$) on an updatable representation of current InK, while low-level goal-conditioned neural modules learn motion primitives through experience using reward shaping. Experiments on navigation tasks demonstrate that incorporating InK substantially improves sample efficiency. Additionally, to perform {\em optimal} symbolic planning given {\em prior} knowledge about the world, we develop Belief World Tree Search. The code is available at https://github.com/CPS-research-group/ink_bwts.

AI.title_translation: 基于增量知识的高效样本分层强化学习神经符号推理
AI.tldr: 提出了带有增量知识（InK）的神经符号分层强化学习框架，利用可更新的符号规划与低层神经控制提升长航程任务的样本效率。
AI.motivation: 传统分层强化学习（HRL）通常将知识硬编码为固定的、不可更新的形式，无法在探索过程中利用新获取的增量知识进行推理，导致在稀疏奖励和需要长航程推理的环境中样本效率极其低下。
AI.method: 提出了带有增量知识（InK）的神经符号分层强化学习框架：高层符号组件基于动态可更新的 InK 表示进行符号规划（如使用 $D^*$ 算法）；低层目标条件神经网络模块通过经验和奖励重塑（reward shaping）学习运动原语。此外，还开发了 Belief World Tree Search 算法，用于在已知世界先验知识的情况下执行最优符号规划。
AI.result: 在导航任务上的实验结果表明，引入增量知识（InK）显著提高了分层强化学习的样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 将增量知识与符号规划引入神经符号分层强化学习中，能够克服传统固定结构 HRL 的局限，显著提升智能体在复杂长航程任务中的样本效率与决策规划能力。
AI.translation: （平面）强化学习（RL）智能体在需要长航程推理的稀疏奖励环境中面临巨大挑战。提高样本效率的一种有效方法是将知识融合到学习和决策中。在标准分层强化学习（HRL）中，知识是以固定的、不可更新的形式（例如架构选择）进行编码的，并在整个学习过程中保持不变。采用固定 HRL 时，在获取足够的环境知识之前，利用探索期间学到的增量知识进行推理是不切实际的，从而导致样本效率低下。在这项工作中，我们提出了具有增量知识（InK）的神经符号 HRL：高层符号组件在当前 InK 的可更新表示上执行符号规划（例如使用 $D^*$），而低层目标条件神经网络模块通过经验和奖励重塑学习运动原语。导航任务的实验表明，引入 InK 显著提高了样本效率。此外，为了在给定世界先验知识的情况下执行最优符号规划，我们开发了 Belief World Tree Search（信念世界树搜索）。代码见 https://github.com/CPS-research-group/ink_bwts。
AI.summary: 本文针对分层强化学习中知识硬编码且无法更新的问题，提出了带有增量知识（InK）的神经符号分层强化学习框架。该方法结合了高层增量知识符号规划与低层神经网络运动原语学习，并引入信念世界树搜索（Belief World Tree Search）以实现最优符号规划，显著提升了长航程任务中的样本效率。
AI.keywords: 神经符号推理, 增量知识, 分层强化学习, 样本效率, 符号规划
AI.comments: 本文巧妙地结合了符号规划的知识增量更新能力与神经网络的低层控制能力，有效解决了分层强化学习在长航程、稀疏奖励环境下知识固定导致样本效率差的痛点。创新性在于引入动态可更新的增量知识（InK）与 Belief World Tree Search。局限性在于目前实验仅在导航任务上进行了验证，在更大规模或高维连续动作空间中的泛化能力尚需进一步评估。

title: SparSEEty: Extracting Tokens from Sparsity-Exploiting LLM Serving Systems via Deterministic Side Channels
summary:
Modern large language models (LLMs) exhibit activation sparsity, wherein only a subset of their neurons is activated for given input tokens. Researchers have leveraged this property to optimize LLM serving systems by omitting weight accesses and computations pertaining to inactive neurons. Unfortunately, however, such optimizations create input-dependent weight accesses, which can be leaked over side channels.
  We present SparSEEty, a new token extraction attack that exploits input-dependent neuron weight accesses introduced by sparsity-exploiting LLM serving systems. SparSEEty first constructs a neuron-activation oracle using neuron weight access side channels during LLM inference, and then inverts the activation traces to reconstruct the input tokens, forming an end-to-end token extraction attack. We instantiate SparSEEty against an LLM serving system protected inside an Intel TDX confidential virtual machine (CVM), addressing three key challenges: (i) constructing a neuron-activation oracle using a combination of side channels exposed by CVMs, (ii) reducing inference-time overheads of neuron activation monitoring for covertness, and (iii) accurately inverting partial binary activation traces back to tokens. Our evaluation shows that SparSEEty can reconstruct both prompt and response tokens with consistently high BLEU scores (>0.95) across various models and datasets, while incurring monitoring overheads of 3.7% to 7.2%.

AI.title_translation: SparSEEty：通过确定性侧信道从利用稀疏性的LLM服务系统中提取Token
AI.tldr: SparSEEty利用稀疏性优化LLM服务系统中的神经元权重访问侧信道，在Intel TDX机密虚拟机中实现了高准确率（BLEU>0.95）的端到端Token提取攻击。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM服务系统常利用激活稀疏性（仅部分神经元被激活）来跳过未激活神经元的权重访问和计算，以提升推理效率。然而，这种优化造成了依赖于输入的权重访问模式，容易通过侧信道泄露用户隐私信息。
AI.method: SparSEEty攻击方法包含两个核心步骤：首先，在LLM推理过程中利用Intel TDX机密虚拟机（CVM）暴露的侧信道组合构建神经元激活预言机（Oracle），实现低开销（3.7%–7.2%）的神经元权重访问监测；其次，将收集到的部分二进制神经元激活轨迹准确地逆向映射还原为原始的输入与输出Token。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，SparSEEty在多种LLM模型和数据集上均能实现端到端的Token提取，重构提示词（Prompt）和响应（Response）Token的BLEU得分均持续保持在0.95以上的高水平，同时仅引入3.7%至7.2%的低推理运行开销。
AI.conclusion: 利用激活稀疏性优化的大语言模型服务系统会因依赖输入的神经元权重访问而引入严重的侧信道漏洞，使得攻击者能够在机密计算环境下以极高准确率提取出用户的敏感文本Token。
AI.translation:
现代大语言模型（LLM）表现出激活稀疏性，即对于给定的输入Token，只有一部分神经元会被激活。研究人员利用这一特性，通过省略与未激活神经元相关的权重访问和计算来优化LLM服务系统。然而不幸的是，这种优化创造了依赖输入的权重访问模式，可能会通过侧信道泄露。
我们提出了 SparSEEty，一种新的 Token 提取攻击，它利用了由稀疏性优化 LLM 服务系统引入的依赖于输入的神经元权重访问。SparSEEty 首先在 LLM 推理过程中利用神经元权重访问侧信道构建神经元激活预言机，然后逆向分析激活轨迹以重构输入 Token，形成端到端的 Token 提取攻击。我们在保护于 Intel TDX 机密虚拟机（CVM）内部的 LLM 服务系统上实例化了 SparSEEty，解决了三个关键挑战：（i）利用 CVM 暴露的侧信道组合构建神经元激活预言机；（ii）降低神经元激活监测的推理时间开销以保持隐蔽性；（iii）将部分二进制激活轨迹准确地逆向还原为 Token。我们的评估表明，SparSEEty 在各种模型和数据集上重构提示词（prompt）和响应（response）Token 时均能保持极高的 BLEU 得分（>0.95），同时产生的监测开销仅为 3.7% 至 7.2%。
AI.summary: 本文针对利用激活稀疏性优化的大语言模型推理系统，提出了首个端到端Token提取侧信道攻击SparSEEty。该方法通过利用Intel TDX机密虚拟机中的侧信道捕捉依赖输入的神经元权重访问，构建激活预言机，并精准逆向还原激活轨迹，从而以极高的准确率提取提示词和生成的响应Token。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 激活稀疏性, 侧信道攻击, Token提取, 机密虚拟机
AI.comments:
创新性：首次将针对大语言模型稀疏性推理优化的输入依赖性权重访问转化为端到端的Token提取攻击，填补了该领域的安全研究空白。
重要性：揭示了即使在Intel TDX等硬件机密虚拟机（CVM）强防护环境下，系统级优化（稀疏性加速）仍可能通过侧信道引入严重的隐私泄露风险，对LLM隐私保护与机密计算系统设计具有重要警示价值。
局限性：攻击依赖于服务系统开启激活稀疏性优化以及存在可利用的确定性侧信道，在未采用稀疏性优化的传统系统或部署了侧信道防御措施的环境中可能难以实施。

title: On the missing benchmarks layer and a potential solution
summary: Latin America is missing a foundational layer for native AI development: the benchmark layer. The benchmark layer does two things no other layer can - it audits AI systems against regional social requirements and it directs AI optimization in economically relevant environments. Without it, public institutions cannot independently evaluate foreign AI systems, and companies cannot optimize AI systems to solve local problems with SOTA performance. The cost of the missing layer is dual: a loss of auditability and a loss of optimization direction over a technology that is increasingly critical infrastructure. We propose an EvalsHub, with LatamBoard as its first regional instance - an open, task-first benchmark infrastructure where universities, public institutions, professional communities, and companies can publish, execute, compare, and maintain evaluations across models, workflows, and agents. Built once, measured forever - re-run by institutions as new AI systems ship and by industry teams after every system change. Open by design and incentive-driven by construction.

AI.title_translation: 论缺失的基准测试层及一种潜在解决方案
AI.tldr: 本文针对拉丁美洲缺乏本土AI基准测试层的问题，提出了开放式基准基础设施EvalsHub及其区域实例LatamBoard。
AI.motivation: 拉丁美洲缺乏本土AI发展的基准测试层，导致公共机构无法独立评估外国AI系统，企业也无法针对本地需求优化AI系统，面临失去审计能力与优化方向的双重风险。
AI.method: 提出了 EvalsHub 及其首个区域实例 LatamBoard——一个开放、任务优先的基准测试基础设施，支持大学、公共机构、专业社区和企业跨模型、工作流和智能体发布、执行、比较与维护评估。
AI.result: 建立了一个“一次构建，永久测量”的评估机制，允许各机构在新AI系统发布或系统变更后重新运行，具备开放性与激励驱动的特点。
AI.conclusion: 构建如LatamBoard这样的本土化开放评估基础设施，是解决区域AI审计缺失与优化方向迷失的可行且必要的解决方案。
AI.translation: 拉丁美洲缺乏本土人工智能发展的奠基性图层：基准测试层。基准测试层能完成其他任何层级都无法实现的两件事——根据区域社会需求审计AI系统，以及在具有经济相关性的环境中指导AI优化。没有它，公共机构就无法独立评估外国AI系统，公司也无法优化AI系统以通过SOTA性能解决本地问题。缺失该层级的代价是双重的：对于日益成为关键基础设施的技术，既失去了可审计性，也失去了优化方向。为此，我们提出了 EvalsHub 及其首个区域实例 LatamBoard——这是一个开放的、任务优先的基准测试基础设施，大学、公共机构、专业社区和公司可以在其中跨模型、工作流和智能体发布、执行、比较和维护评估。一次构建，永久测量——在新的AI系统发布时由机构重新运行，在每次系统变更后由行业团队重新运行。设计上保持开放，构造上由激励驱动。
AI.summary: 本文分析了拉丁美洲因缺乏AI“基准测试层”而面临的本地化优化与自主审计困境，并提出了EvalsHub及LatamBoard这一开放、任务优先且激励驱动的评估基础设施，旨在为区域AI发展提供可持续的测量与比较平台。
AI.keywords: 基准测试层, 拉丁美洲, AI评估, EvalsHub, LatamBoard
AI.comments: 本文切中了AI生态中常被忽略的“基准评估本土化”问题，强调了对特定区域社会需求和经济环境进行AI审计与优化的重要性。提出的EvalsHub和LatamBoard构想具有很高的实用与区域治理价值。局限在于摘要中未提供具体的实证评估数据或运行成效，其激励机制与跨机构协作的落地细节仍需进一步验证。

title: On the Non-Specificity of Statistical Measures Used in Script Decipherment
summary: Statistical regularities are routinely offered as evidence that undeciphered sign systems encode language; the Indus script debate is the canonical example. Any such inference rests on specificity: the reported outcome must be unusual among plausible structured non-languages. We test that premise constructively with SIGIL, a purpose-built generative emblem system whose 3,000-text core corpus carries explicit compositional meanings although no sign has a phonological value. A literature registry compiled in advance of evaluation records 54 methods and admits a method to exact scoring when both the published Indus outcome and a source-defined decision rule can be reproduced. SIGIL receives the same category as the Indus corpus on every criterion scored this way, across repetition, directional-asymmetry, and lexical-distribution tests. Declared reconstructions of entropy, frequency, positional, predictive, classifier, and network measures reproduce the familiar Indus-like signatures as well. A sequential decipherment stress test then reaches high dictionary coverage for English, Sanskrit, and Tamil on the same corpus, while grouped held-out declines and unstable keys reveal how little that coverage identifies. The construction does not decide what the Indus signs encode: it shows that the evaluated measures detect organization without being specific to language, and therefore cannot, on their own, establish encoded speech.

AI.title_translation: 论文字破译中所用统计度量的非特异性
AI.tldr: 本文通过构建无语音的符号系统 SIGIL 证明，破译古文字常用的统计度量指标仅能检测符号系统的组织性而缺乏语言特异性，不能单独作为符号编码了人类语言的证据。
AI.motivation: 统计规律常被用作未破译符号系统编码了人类语言的证据（如印度河文字争议）。这种推论依赖于“特异性”前提——即该统计特征在非语言结构系统中是罕见的。本文旨在通过构造性方法检验这一前提是否成立。
AI.method: 构建了一个专用的生成式徽章系统 SIGIL（包含 3,000 个文本的核心语料库，具有结构化语义但无语音价值），并汇集文献中 54 种用于分析印度河文字的统计方法，在 SIGIL 语料库上复现并测试这些度量指标（包括重复性、方向不对称性、词汇分布、熵、预测、网络度量等），同时进行了顺序破译压力测试。
AI.result: SIGIL 在所有精准评分的评估标准上均获得了与印度河文字语料库完全相同的分类，并重现了类似的熵、频率、位置、预测及网络特征；在破译压力测试中甚至对英语、梵语和泰米尔语达到了高字典覆盖率，但保留测试性能下降和不稳定密钥揭示了这种覆盖率的虚假性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，评估的统计度量只能检测符号系统的组织结构，而不具备语言特异性，因此不能仅凭统计指标本身来确立符号系统编码了人类语言。
AI.translation: 统计规律常被用作未破译符号系统记录了语言的证据，印度河文字争议就是典型例子。任何此类推论都建立在特异性之上：报告的结果在合理的结构化非语言系统中必须是罕见的。我们通过 SIGIL 建设性地检验了这一前提，SIGIL 是一个专门构建的生成式徽章系统，其 3000 个文本的核心语料库具有明确的组合含义，尽管没有任何符号具有语音价值。评估前编译的文献注册表记录了 54 种方法，当已发表的印度河文字结果和源定义的决策规则均可复现时，允许对方法进行精确打分。在通过这种方式打分的每一项标准上（跨越重复、方向不对称性和词汇分布测试），SIGIL 都获得了与印度河文字语料库相同的分类。熵、频率、位置、预测、分类器和网络度量的明确重构也重现了熟悉的类似印度河文字的特征。随后进行的顺序破译压力测试在同一语料库上对英语、梵语和泰米尔语达到了很高的字典覆盖率，而分组保留率下降和不稳定的密钥揭示了这种覆盖率所能识别的东西多么微乎其微。该构建并没有确定印度河符号编码了什么：它表明评估的度量方法可以检测组织结构，但对语言并不具有特异性，因此仅凭它们自身无法确立编码的语音。
AI.summary: 本文检验了脚本破译中常用统计度量方法的语言特异性。作者构建了一个具有组合语义但无语音价值的非语言徽章系统 SIGIL，并用分析印度河文字的 54 种统计度量对其进行测试。结果表明，SIGIL 在所有统计指标上均表现出与印度河文字一致的“类语言”特征，甚至能被“破译”出高字典覆盖率的多国语言。这证明现有统计指标仅能检测符号的组织结构，缺乏对语言的特异性，无法单独作为证明符号编码了语言的依据。
AI.keywords: 文字破译, 统计度量, 印度河文字, 特异性, 符号系统
AI.comments: 本文创新性极强，通过构建生成式非语言符号系统 SIGIL 进行“反向对照实验”，有力地挑战了古文字破译领域长期依赖统计指标证明“符号即语言”的范式。研究逻辑严密，对 54 种统计方法及破译测试进行了全面评估，对古文字学、计算语言学及信息论在符号系统中的应用具有重要的批判性指导意义。

title: A Wearable Stiffness-Rendering Haptic Device with a Honeycomb Jamming Mechanism for Bilateral Teleoperation
summary: This paper addresses the challenge of providing kinesthetic feedback in bilateral teleoperation by designing a wearable, lightweight (20 g), and compact haptic device, the HJ-Haptic, utilizing a honeycomb jamming mechanism for object stiffness rendering. The HJ-Haptic device can vary its stiffness, from 1.15 N/mm to 2.64 N/mm, using a 30 kPa vacuum pressure. We demonstrate its implementation in a teleoperation framework, enabling operators to adjust grip force based on a reliable haptic feedback on object stiffness. A three-point flexural test on the honeycomb jamming mechanism and teleoperated object-grasping tasks were conducted to evaluate the device's functionality. Our experiments demonstrated a small RMSE and strong correlations in teleoperated motion, stiffness rendering, and interaction force feedback. The HJ-Haptic effectively adjusts its stiffness in response to real-time gripper feedback, mimicking the sensation of direct object grasping with hands. The device's use of vacuum pressure ensures operator safety by preventing dangerous outcomes in case of gas leakage or material failure. Incorporating the HJ-Haptic into the teleoperation framework provided the reliable perception of object stiffness and stable teleoperation. This study highlights the potential of the honeycomb jamming mechanism for enhancing haptic feedback in various applications, including teleoperation scenarios, as well as interactions with extended-reality environments.

AI.title_translation: 基于蜂窝阻塞机制用于双向遥操作的可穿戴刚度渲染力触觉设备
AI.tldr: 设计了一种仅重20克的蜂窝阻塞式可穿戴触觉设备，可在遥操作中通过负压实时改变刚度，提供安全可靠的物体刚度触觉反馈。
AI.motivation: 解决双向遥操作中难以向操作员提供轻量、便携、安全且可靠的动觉与物体刚度触觉反馈的问题。
AI.method: 提出了采用蜂窝阻塞机制的触觉设备（HJ-Haptic），重约20克，利用30 kPa的真空负压可将刚度从1.15 N/mm调节至2.64 N/mm；通过三点弯曲测试评估其力学特性，并在物体抓取遥操作实验中对其运动、刚度渲染与交互力反馈能力进行了评估。
AI.result: 遥操作运动、刚度渲染和交互力反馈的实测数据表现出较小的均方根误差（RMSE）和强相关性；设备能根据抓握反馈实时调整刚度，模拟直接手握物体的感觉，且负压工作机制确保了气体泄漏时的操作安全性。
AI.conclusion: 将HJ-Haptic集成到双向遥操作框架中能够提供可靠的物体刚度感知和稳定的遥操作体验，证明了蜂窝阻塞机制在遥操作及扩展现实（XR）交互中的广泛应用潜力。
AI.translation: 本文针对双向遥操作中提供动觉反馈的挑战，设计了一款利用蜂窝阻塞机制进行物体刚度渲染的轻量化（20 g）、紧凑型可穿戴力触觉设备——HJ-Haptic。HJ-Haptic设备在30 kPa真空压力下，刚度可在1.15 N/mm至2.64 N/mm之间变化。我们在遥操作框架中演示了其应用，使操作员能够基于可靠的物体刚度触觉反馈来调整抓握力。通过对蜂窝阻塞机制进行三点弯曲测试以及遥操作物体抓取任务，对设备的功能进行了评估。实验结果表明，在遥操作运动、刚度渲染和交互力反馈方面均表现出较小的均方根误差（RMSE）和强相关性。HJ-Haptic能根据机械爪的实时反馈有效调节自身刚度，模拟人用手直接抓取物体时的感觉。设备对真空压力的使用确保了操作员的安全，防止了气体泄漏或材料失效时的危险后果。将HJ-Haptic引入遥操作框架中，提供了可靠的物体刚度感知和稳定的遥操作能力。本研究突出了蜂窝阻塞机制在提升包括遥操作场景及扩展现实环境交互在内的多种应用中触觉反馈的潜力。
AI.summary: 本研究设计了一种重量仅20g的穿戴式蜂窝阻塞力触觉设备（HJ-Haptic），用于双向遥操作中的物体刚度渲染。该设备在30 kPa负压下可实现1.15~2.64 N/mm的刚度变化。实验表明，该系统能实现低误差的运动与力反馈，提升遥操作的稳定性与刚度感知能力。
AI.keywords: 双向遥操作, 蜂窝阻塞机制, 力触觉设备, 刚度渲染, 可穿戴技术
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将蜂窝结构与阻塞机制（jamming mechanism）相结合，开发出仅重20克的轻量化穿戴式力触觉设备（HJ-Haptic），解决了遥操作中动觉反馈设备通常过于笨重或安全性不足的问题。使用负压控制保证了操作员的人身安全。局限性在于其刚度变化范围（1.15 N/mm至2.64 N/mm）相对有限，可能难以模拟极高刚度物体的触感。

title: ProPRL: Property-Aware Prerequisite Relation Learning in Educational Knowledge Graphs
summary: Prerequisite relation learning is central to adaptive instruction, yet existing methods often formulate it as conventional link prediction, limiting their ability to adaptively integrate complementary educational evidence for individual candidate pairs and to discourage contradictory reverse predictions. We propose ProPRL, a Property-aware Prerequisite Relation Learning framework. ProPRL first learns complementary concept representations from a concept-resource hypergraph and a directed learning-behavior graph, where direction-preserving personalized propagation aggregates multi-hop behavioral evidence. It then employs a Pair-conditioned Gate to adaptively weight and fuse the two views for each candidate ordered concept pair. Finally, an \textit{Irreversibility Constraint} introduces an anti-symmetry regularizer that penalizes simultaneously high confidence in both directions of the same concept pair. Experiments on multiple real-world educational datasets show that ProPRL achieves state-of-the-art performance on prerequisite relation learning.

AI.title_translation: ProPRL：教育知识图谱中感知属性的先修关系学习
AI.tldr: ProPRL通过整合超图与行为图的多视图表示、自适应门控融合及反对称不可逆约束，实现了教育知识图谱中精准的先修关系预测。
AI.motivation: 先修关系学习对于自适应教学至关重要，但现有方法常将其简化为传统的链接预测，限制了其为特定候选概念对自适应整合互补教育证据的能力，且无法有效抑制矛盾的反向预测。
AI.method: 提出ProPRL框架：1）从概念-资源超图和有向学习行为图中学习互补的概念表示，利用保持方向的个性化传播聚合多跳行为证据；2）采用成对条件门控（Pair-conditioned Gate）为每个候选有序概念对自适应地加权融合双视图表示；3）引入不可逆约束（Irreversibility Constraint）作为反对称正则化器，惩罚同概念对双向同时具备高置信度的情况。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界教育数据集上的实验表明，ProPRL在先修关系学习任务上取得了SOTA（最先进）的性能。
AI.conclusion: ProPRL框架通过感知先修关系的结构与行为属性，有效克服了传统链接预测方法的局限，为教育知识图谱中的先修关系建模提供了更精准高效的解决方案。
AI.translation: 先修关系学习对于自适应教学至关重要，然而现有方法通常将其归结为传统的链接预测，这限制了它们为特定候选概念对自适应整合互补教育证据的能力，也无法抑制矛盾的反向预测。为此，我们提出了ProPRL——一种感知属性的先修关系学习框架。ProPRL首先从概念-资源超图和有向学习行为图中学习互补的概念表示，其中保持方向的个性化传播聚合了多跳行为证据。随后，它采用成对条件门控为每个候选有序概念对自适应地加权并融合这两个视图。最后，不可逆约束引入了一个反对称正则化器，惩罚同一概念对在两个方向上同时具有高置信度的情况。在多个真实教育数据集上的实验表明，ProPRL在先修关系学习上达到了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对教育知识图谱中的先修关系学习问题，提出了ProPRL框架。该框架结合概念-资源超图和有向学习行为图学习概念的多视角表示，利用成对条件门控实现自适应视图融合，并设计了不可逆约束以消除方向矛盾的预测，在多个数据集上达到了最先进效果。
AI.keywords: 先修关系学习, 教育知识图谱, 超图学习, 非对称正则化, 链接预测
AI.comments: ProPRL创新性地解决了先修关系学习中的两大痛点：多视角教育证据的自适应融合以及先修关系不可逆（非对称）属性的约束。通过引入对偶视图学习、成对条件门控和不可逆性正则化，显著提升了关系的推断准确性。局限性在于摘要未透露其在异构图和超图构建上的计算复杂度及对稀疏数据的鲁棒性。

title: The Ground Is Shifting: A Reflection on the Foundations of Software Measurement
comments: Accepted to the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE '26) $\unicode{0x000A}$ DOI: https://doi.org/10.1145/3832783.3834553
summary: For most of the past six decades, software measurement relied on labor-intensive manual collection of proprietary data, which hampered progress. The shift to repurposing traces from version control and related tools dramatically expanded data availability$\unicode{x2014}$especially with the rise of open-source software$\unicode{x2014}$but hinged on an often unstated assumption: that these tools are used by professional developers to build genuine software systems. However, as trace-generating tools, data types and scale, and empirical methods have all evolved, it has become clear that changes in data generation and analytical approaches affect many prior findings about software development, maintenance, and evolution. With AI agents now actively using these same tools, the resulting traces frequently violate the original assumption of human origin. To preserve the relevance of software measurement research, immediate action is needed: We must detect when foundational assumptions are violated in contemporary data and develop new methodologies that remain valid under changed circumstances. To this end, we propose a systematic AI-assisted replication program that revisits key findings using modern techniques, aiming for methods that yield consistent results on current data to keep software measurement meaningful.

AI.title_translation: 基础正在动摇：对软件度量基础的反思
AI.tldr: 本文反思了软件度量的基础假设，指出AI Agent参与导致的假设失效影响了传统结论，并提出了系统化的AI辅助复现计划以重建有效的软件度量体系。
AI.motivation: 随着开源软件演进以及AI Agent广泛参与软件开发，数据生成和分析方式发生了剧烈变化，导致“轨迹数据源于专业人类开发者”这一传统软件度量的基础假设频繁失效，以往的许多研究结论可能不再成立。
AI.method: 提出一个系统化的AI辅助复现计划（systematic AI-assisted replication program），利用现代技术重新审视历史上的关键发现，并开发在改变的环境下依然有效的新方法论。
AI.result: 阐明了数据生成工具和AI参与对现有软件度量有效性的冲击，并确立了通过系统化复现以确保度量结果在现代数据下保持一致性和有意义性的路线。
AI.conclusion: 为了维持软件度量研究的相关性与意义，必须立即检测当代数据中基础假设失效的情况，并通过系统化的复现计划与现代技术开发出在当前环境下依然有效的新度量方法。
AI.translation: 在过去近六十年的大部分时间里，软件度量依赖于高耗能的专有数据人工收集，这阻碍了学科进展。向重用版本控制及相关工具轨迹数据的转变极大地扩展了数据的可用性——尤其是随着开源软件的兴起——但这一转变依赖于一个通常未经声明的假设：即这些工具是由专业开发者用于构建真实的软件系统的。然而，随着轨迹生成工具、数据类型与规模以及实证方法的演进，显而易见的是，数据生成和分析方法的变化影响了许多以往关于软件开发、维护和演进的发现。随着AI Agent现在积极使用这些相同的工具，由此产生的轨迹频繁打破了最初关于“人类来源”的假设。为了保持软件度量研究的相关性，需要立即采取行动：我们必须检测当代数据中基础假设何时被破坏，并开发在改变的情况下依然有效的新方法论。为此，我们提出了一个系统化的AI辅助复现计划，利用现代技术重新审视关键发现，旨在获得能在当前数据上产生一致结果的方法，以保持软件度量的现实意义。
AI.summary: 本文反思了软件度量领域的基础假设。随着现代工具演进及AI Agent的广泛应用，传统基于“专业人类开发者构建真实系统”的数据假设已被打破，影响了此前关于软件开发与演进结论的有效性。作者呼吁采取行动检测假设失效情况，并提出了一个系统化的AI辅助复现计划，利用现代方法重审关键发现，以维持软件度量研究的现实意义。
AI.keywords: 软件度量, 基础假设, AI Agent, 实证研究, 辅助复现计划
AI.comments: 本文洞察敏锐，紧扣当前大语言模型与AI Agent在软件工程领域广泛应用的时代背景。它深刻指出了AI生成代码与轨迹数据对传统软件工程实证研究基础假设的冲击，具有极高的理论警示意义与实践导向价值。提出的“AI辅助复现计划”为重新验证和更新软件度量学体系指明了可行路径。

title: V-FIND: Revealing the Intrinsic Forgery Knowledge Encoded in Video Forgery Detectors
summary: As generated videos become increasingly realistic, reliable video forgery detection is increasingly important. Existing studies typically optimize and use video forgery detectors as black boxes, while the latent forgery-discriminative knowledge inside them remains largely unexplored. Instead of continuing to rely on resource-intensive full-model retraining to steadily improve detection performance, we ask whether video forgery detection can also be achieved by uncovering and activating sparse forensic knowledge within the detector. We find that forgery-discriminative knowledge is not uniformly distributed across the full representation space, but is concentrated in a sparse set of functionally specialized neurons. Based on this insight, we propose a video forgery-intrinsic neuron discovery (V-FIND) framework. V-FIND first localizes critical layers that exhibit pronounced discrepancies between real and forged videos, and then identifies latent anchor neurons that consistently carry forgery-discriminative signals, organizing them into a compact forensic subspace. With the original backbone frozen and only a lightweight linear classifier trained, this subspace still delivers strong detection performance across multiple external benchmarks for generated videos. Further neuron intervention experiments provide direct evidence for the functional specificity of the discovered neurons. Overall, these results suggest that video forgery detectors contain sparse, extractable, and reusable forgery-discriminative knowledge, offering a new perspective on understanding and exploiting their intrinsic forensic capability.

AI.title_translation: V-FIND：揭示视频伪造检测器中编码的内在伪造知识
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 V-FIND 框架，通过提取视频伪造检测器中稀疏的“固有伪造神经元”构建取证子空间，在冻结主干网络的情况下实现了高效且强泛化性的视频伪造检测。
AI.motivation: 现有视频伪造检测研究大多将检测器视为黑盒，且依赖高资源消耗的全模型重训练来提升性能，缺乏对检测器内部潜在伪造鉴别知识的挖掘。本文旨在探究能否通过揭示和激活检测器内部稀疏的固有取证知识来实现高效检测。
AI.method: 提出了 V-FIND（视频伪造固有神经元发现）框架：1. 定位真实与伪造视频之间存在显著表征差异的关键层；2. 识别持续携带伪造鉴别信号的潜在锚点神经元，并将其组织为紧凑的取证子空间；3. 在冻结原始主干网络的前提下，仅在该子空间上训练轻量级线性分类器。
AI.result: 在冻结主干网络且仅训练轻量线性分类器的条件下，V-FIND 提取的取证子空间在多个外部生成视频基准上均取得了强劲的检测性能；神经元干预实验也直接验证了所定位神经元的功能特异性。
AI.conclusion: 视频伪造检测器内部编码了稀疏、可提取且可复用的伪造鉴别知识，这为理解与利用模型的内在取证能力提供了全新的视角。
AI.translation: 随着生成的视频变得越来越逼真，可靠的视频伪造检测变得日益重要。现有研究通常将视频伪造检测器作为黑盒进行优化和使用，而其内部潜在的伪造鉴别知识在很大程度上仍未被探索。本文没有继续依赖资源密集型的全模型重训练来稳步提高检测性能，而是提出一个问题：是否可以通过揭示和激活检测器内稀疏的取证知识来实现视频伪造检测？我们发现，伪造鉴别知识并非均匀分布在整个表示空间中，而是集中在少数具有功能专一性的稀疏神经元中。基于这一见解，我们提出了视频伪造固有神经元发现（V-FIND）框架。V-FIND 首先定位在真实和伪造视频之间表现出明显差异的关键层，然后识别持续携带伪造鉴别信号的潜在锚点神经元，将其组织成一个紧凑的取证子空间。在冻结原始主干网络且仅训练轻量级线性分类器的情况下，该子空间在多个生成的视频外部基准测试中仍能提供强劲的检测性能。进一步的神经元干预实验为所发现神经元的功能特异性提供了直接证据。总体而言，这些结果表明视频伪造检测器包含稀疏、可提取和可复用的伪造鉴别知识，为理解和利用其内在取证能力提供了新的视角。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了视频伪造检测器的内部表征机制，发现伪造鉴别知识并非均匀分布，而是集中在少数功能专一的稀疏神经元中。基于此，作者提出了 V-FIND 框架，通过定位关键层与锚点神经元构建紧凑的取证子空间。在冻结主干网络的情况下，仅利用该子空间即可在多个基准测试中实现高效且可解释的伪造检测。
AI.keywords: 视频伪造检测, 神经元发现, 模型可解释性, 取证子空间, 稀疏表征
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于打破了传统将伪造检测模型作为“黑盒”的范式，从神经元级别的可解释性视角深入挖掘模型内部知识。通过提取稀疏的固有取证神经元构建子空间，该方法不仅极大地降低了后续适应新任务时的计算资源消耗，还赋予了模型更强的泛化能力与可解释性，为深度伪造检测及模型内部机制探索提供了新颖而有价值的思路。

title: Tiny Enough to Break In: Agentic Remote Access Trojans Powered by Small Language Models
comments: 6 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Formatted in Springer LNCS style
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence raises a new security concern: cyber threats that reason, act, and adapt locally without continuous human direction. We examine this threat through an Agentic Remote Access Trojan (agentic RAT): a Remote Access Trojan augmented with a locally deployed Small Language Model (SLM). The SLM interprets host and network observations, selects actions, recovers from failed steps, and reduces reliance on an external operator. We implement the concept in a controlled, network-isolated lab built from Kali Linux, a Metasploitable2 target, LM Studio, and a local 8-billion-parameter Dolphin-family model. We then test whether a model this small can support autonomous cyber decision-making. This is architecturally feasible today. On commodity hardware, with no cloud service and no operator in the loop, the SLM closed the full observe-decide-act cycle: it interpreted ranked reconnaissance evidence supplied by the controller, selected actions, and obtained verified root-shell access on real vulnerable services. However, it is not yet operationally reliable. The same model hallucinated commands, misread output, and recovered from failure inconsistently, completing 10.9% of a deliberately strict checklist. That gap reflects the limits of today's small models, not a ceiling on the concept. As SLMs improve, agentic endpoint systems may become more practical, more autonomous, and harder to detect, straining existing monitoring, containment, and policy-enforcement mechanisms. Real-world incidents in 2025-2026 already show AI-driven intrusions moving from concept toward practice. That makes the local, self-contained variant we study a plausible near-term direction, not a hypothetical one.
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Formatted in Springer LNCS style

AI.title_translation: 足够微小以致入侵：由小语言模型驱动的代理远程访问木马
AI.tldr: 本文探索了基于本地部署的8B小语言模型（SLM）构建代理远程访问木马（Agentic RAT）的可行性，证明了完全自主的网络入侵在架构上可行，但目前受限于小模型可靠性。
AI.motivation: 代理式人工智能带来了无需持续人类指令即可在本地进行推理、行动和适应的新型网络安全威胁。本文旨在探索利用本地部署的小语言模型（SLM）构建自主代理远程访问木马（Agentic RAT）的可行性与潜在危害。
AI.method: 在网络隔离的受控实验室环境（由 Kali Linux、Metasploitable2 靶机、LM Studio 及本地 8B 参数 Dolphin 系列模型构成）中构建概念验证系统；在无云端服务且无人工干预的通用硬件上，评估该 SLM 独立执行“观察-决策-行动”循环并获取系统最高权限的能力。
AI.result: 在架构上，8B 参数的 SLM 成功完成了“观察-决策-行动”全循环，解释了侦察证据并获得了真实漏洞服务的 root-shell 访问权限；但系统操作可靠性尚低，模型存在命令幻觉、误读输出及失败恢复不稳定等问题，仅完成了严格检查清单中 10.9% 的任务。
AI.conclusion: 本地自包含的 Agentic RAT 是近期切实可行的攻击演进方向而非纯理论假设。随着 SLM 能力的不断提升，代理式终端攻击系统将更具实用性、自主性且更难被检测，将严重冲击现有的网络安全监控、隔离和策略执行机制。
AI.translation: 代理式人工智能引发了新的安全担忧：无需持续的人类指令，就能在本地进行推理、行动和适应的网络威胁。我们通过代理远程访问木马（agentic RAT）来审视这一威胁——这是一种通过本地部署的小型语言模型（SLM）增强的远程访问木马。该 SLM 可以解释主机和网络观察结果、选择行动、从失败步骤中恢复，并减少对外部操作员的依赖。我们在由 Kali Linux、Metasploitable2 目标、LM Studio 和本地 80 亿参数 Dolphin 系列模型构建的受控、网络隔离实验室中实现了这一概念。随后我们测试了如此小规模的模型是否能够支持自主的网络决策。结果表明，这在当今架构上是可行的。在没有云服务且无操作员干预的通用硬件上，SLM 完成了完整的“观察-决策-行动”循环：它解释了由控制器提供的分级侦察证据，选择行动，并在真实存在漏洞的服务上获得了经过验证的 root-shell 访问权限。然而，它在操作上尚不可靠。同一个模型会幻觉出命令、误读输出且故障恢复表现不稳定，仅完成了故意设置的严格检查清单中的 10.9%。这一差距反映了当今小模型的局限性，而非该概念的天花板。随着 SLM 的不断改进，代理式终端系统可能会变得更加实用、更加自主且更难被检测，从而使现有的监控、遏制和策略执行机制承受巨大压力。2025-2026 年的真实世界事件已经表明 AI 驱动的入侵正从概念走向实践，这使得我们研究的这种本地、自包含变体成为近期切实可行的演进方向，而非仅仅是假设。
AI.summary: 本文评估了结合本地小语言模型（SLM）的代理远程访问木马（Agentic RAT）的安全威胁。研究人员通过 8B 参数模型在隔离环境中验证了脱离云端与人类操控的自主攻击可行性。虽然目前 SLM 存在指令幻觉和可靠性低的问题（任务完成率 10.9%），但该系统已能独立获取根权限。这表明随 SLM 技术演进，本地自包含的 AI 驱动网络攻击将成为可预见的近期威胁。
AI.keywords: Agentic AI, Remote Access Trojan (RAT), Small Language Model (SLM), Autonomous Cyber Decision-Making, Cyber Threat
AI.comments:
创新性：提出了结合本地小语言模型（8B参数）与远程访问木马（RAT）的自治攻击体系，探索了脱离云端和人类干预的去中心化AI威胁模式。
重要性：揭示了AI驱动的网络攻击正从云端依赖向本地轻量化、自主化演进的趋势，警示现有的网络检测与遏制机制面临严峻挑战。
局限性：当前8B小模型的可靠性不足，容易出现命令幻觉和输出误读，在严格测试中的成功率仅为10.9%，在复杂场景下的作战效能尚受限制。

title: Forbidden Region Dynamic Active Constraints in Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery
summary: In robot-assisted surgery, Forbidden Region Active Constraints (FRAC) represent a control strategy that helps maintain task safety by generating anisotropic haptic guidance to surgeons. However, several challenges need to be overcome before FRAC can benefit teleoperative surgery in a clinical setting. These challenges include the ability to allow for dynamic tissue deformation, maintain energetic passivity, and speed of implementation, among others. In this study, we propose the pipeline design for an energy dissipative FRAC strategy, which accommodates the dynamic tissue deformation caused by respiratory movements, by utilizing a depth sensing camera. The proposed FRAC strategy adopts a fine mesh representation, with a total number of 122,806 polygons in the case study presented, while running at 43.48Hz. We designed in vitro trajectory tracking experiments conducted by a "virtual" surgeon to aid quantitative assessment of the method, including its effectiveness in maintaining task safety, which was confirmed by successfully maintaining a pre-defined safety distance across all trials. We also conducted comparative studies to investigate the robustness and time-efficiency of our method against other FRAC methods that rely on simple geometry AC representations. We demonstrate that our method provides a more robust and effective guidance overall, while maintaining comparable, if not lower, time costs.

AI.title_translation: 机器人辅助微创手术中的禁区动态主动约束
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合深度相机的能量耗散型动态禁区主动约束（FRAC）策略，能在应对呼吸引起的组织动态变形的同时，以高帧率提供稳健有效的触觉引导。
AI.motivation: 在机器人辅助手术中，禁区主动约束（FRAC）面临着难以应对动态组织变形（如呼吸运动）、难以维持能量被动性以及计算实现速度不足等临床应用挑战。
AI.method: 利用深度感知相机捕捉由呼吸运动引起的动态组织变形，设计了一种能量耗散型FRAC策略流水线；采用包含122,806个多边形的精细网格表示动态组织，并通过“虚拟”外科医生开展体外轨迹跟踪实验及对比实验进行定量评估。
AI.result: 所提策略在122,806个多边形的精细网格下运行频率达43.48Hz；在所有试验中均成功维持了预设的安全距离；对比实验表明，该方法在保持相当甚至更低时间成本的前提下，提供了比简单几何表示法更稳健和有效的触觉引导。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的动态FRAC策略能够有效适应呼吸运动引起的组织形变，确保手术任务安全性，具备高实时性与稳健性，为远距离操控微创手术提供了更具临床可行性的触觉引导解决方案。
AI.translation: 在机器人辅助手术中，禁区主动约束（FRAC）代表了一类通过向外科医生提供各向异性触觉引导来维持任务安全的控制策略。然而，在FRAC能够于临床环境中惠及远程操控手术之前，还需要克服若干挑战。这些挑战包括适应动态组织变形的能力、保持能量被动性以及实现速度等。在本研究中，我们提出了一种能量耗散型FRAC策略的流水线设计，该策略利用深度感知相机来适应由呼吸运动引起的动态组织变形。所提出的FRAC策略采用了精细的网格表示（在展示的案例研究中总共包含122,806个多边形），同时以43.48Hz的频率运行。我们设计了由“虚拟”医生进行的体外轨迹跟踪实验，以辅助对该方法的定量评估，包括其在维持任务安全方面的有效性（所有试验中成功维持预定义安全距离证实了这一点）。我们还进行了对比研究，以探究我们的方法相对于依赖简单几何AC表示的其他FRAC方法的稳健性和时间效率。我们证明，我们的方法总体上提供了更稳健和有效的引导，同时保持了相当甚至更低的时间成本。
AI.summary: 本文针对机器人辅助微创手术中禁区主动约束（FRAC）难以适应动态组织变形和高实时性要求的问题，提出了一种基于深度感知相机的能量耗散型动态FRAC策略。该方法采用超12万多边形的精细网格建模，以43.48Hz的频率实时运行。体外轨迹跟踪及对比实验证实，该方法能有效维持预设安全距离，相比传统简单几何方法展现出更强的稳健性、有效性及优异的时间效率。
AI.keywords: 机器人辅助手术, 禁区主动约束, 动态组织变形, 深度感知, 触觉引导
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将深度感知与精细网格建模引入到动态禁区主动约束（FRAC）中，解决了微创手术中呼吸引起的软组织动态形变难题，同时在超12万多边形的高精建模下实现了43.48Hz的实时运行，对推动触觉引导在实际远程微创手术中的临床落地具有重要意义。其局限性在于目前评估主要依赖“虚拟”医生的体外轨迹跟踪实验，未来尚需在真实活体动物或临床环境中做深入验证。

title: A Graph Signal Processing Perspective on Numerical Sequence Representations in LLM In-Context Learning
summary: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated in-context learning (ICL) capabilities for numerical inference over sequences serialized as text. Prior work has identified and characterized this form of numerical inference primarily through output-level evaluations such as prediction error. However, how numerical information is organized within LLM representations remains much less understood. To study this internal organization, we adopt a graph signal processing perspective in which attention induces a weighted graph over tokens, while token hidden states define signals on its nodes. Quantitative graph-spectral diagnostics and qualitative token-graph visualizations reveal that representations become more clearly differentiated by input dynamical complexity as context length increases. Simpler inputs produce attention-induced token graphs with stronger global connectivity and smoother, spectrally concentrated hidden-state signals, whereas more complex inputs produce more localized graphs and hidden-state signals with broader spectral support and greater high-frequency energy. Together, these findings point to systematic, context-dependent internal signatures associated with numerical ICL that are conserved across model families.

AI.title_translation: 图信号处理视角下的大语言模型上下文学习数值序列表示研究
AI.tldr: 本文利用图信号处理视角，揭示了LLM在数值上下文学习中，注意力图结构和隐藏状态信号如何随输入复杂度发生系统性变化。
AI.motivation: 此前关于大模型在文本序列上进行数值推理的研究主要集中于输出层面的评估（如预测误差），而对于数值信息在LLM内部表征中是如何组织的，目前仍缺乏深刻理解。
AI.method: 引入图信号处理（GSP）视角，将注意力矩阵视为词元（token）构成的加权图，将词元的隐藏状态视为图节点上的信号；结合定量图谱诊断与定性词元图可视化进行内部表征分析。
AI.result: 随着上下文长度增加，内部表征会根据输入的动力学复杂度产生更清晰的分化：较简单的输入会产生全局连通性更强、更平滑且频谱更集中的图与信号；而较复杂的输入则产生局部化更强、频谱支持更宽且高频能量更高的图与信号。
AI.conclusion: 数值上下文学习（ICL）存在系统性且依赖于上下文的内部表征特征，并且这些特征在不同的模型家族中具有保守性（通用性）。
AI.translation: 预训练大语言模型（LLM）已展现出对序列化为文本的数值进行上下文学习（ICL）推理的能力。先前的工作主要通过预测误差等输出层面的评估来识别和表征这种数值推理形式。然而，数值信息在LLM内部表征中是如何组织的，目前了解甚少。为了研究这一内部组织结构，我们引入了图信号处理的视角：其中注意力机制诱导出一个作用于词元上的加权图，而词元的隐藏状态则定义了图节点上的信号。定量图谱诊断与定性词元图可视化表明，随着上下文长度的增加，内部表征会根据输入动力学复杂度产生更清晰的分化。较简单的输入会产生具有更强全局连通性以及更平滑、频谱更集中的隐藏状态信号的注意力图；而较复杂的输入则产生更局部化的图以及具有更宽频谱支持和更高高频能量的隐藏状态信号。总之，这些发现揭示了与数值ICL相关的、跨模型家族保守的系统性且依赖于上下文的内部特征。
AI.summary: 本研究针对大语言模型（LLM）在上下文学习中处理数值序列时的内部表征机制展开探索。作者提出了一个图信号处理（GSP）的新视角，将注意力诱导的词元关系建模为加权图，将隐藏状态建模为节点信号。研究发现，随着上下文增加，模型内部表征能显著区分输入的动力学复杂度，简单的输入对应高连通性与平滑信号，复杂的输入对应局部化与高频信号。该结论在多个模型家族中普遍成立，为理解LLM内部数值推理机制提供了重要依据。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 上下文学习, 图信号处理, 数值序列表征, 图谱分析
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将图信号处理（GSP）理论引入大语言模型（LLM）的可解释性研究中，从内部表征和注意力机制构成的图结构出发，揭示了模型处理不同复杂度的数值序列时的内部信号特征。这种跨领域的分析方法为理解LLM的上下文学习机制提供了全新的视角，且结论在不同模型家族间具有一致性。局限性在于目前分析主要集中于数值序列推理，未来可进一步拓展至更复杂的非数值文本推理任务。

title: Clinically-Grounded Hierarchical Classification for Consistent Chest X-ray Interpretation
comments: MICCAI 2026 Accepted. First & Corresponding author: Jong Hak Moon (jh.moon@yejix.com)
summary: Accurate chest X-ray interpretation is inherently hierarchical. Clinical decisions depend not only on what abnormality is present but where it is situated, requiring reasoning from broad anatomical systems down to specific pathological findings. Yet existing automated systems largely treat this as a flat classification problem, failing to capture inter-level dependencies or enforce coherence between coarse and fine predictions. We propose CHASE (Classification with Hierarchical Analysis and Structured Enforcement), a unified single-stage framework that mirrors radiologists' coarse-to-fine reasoning through a clinically driven three-level taxonomy of 9 anatomical regions, 17 sub-regions, and 28 pathological findings. CHASE jointly optimizes multi-level supervision, cross-level probability alignment, and a hierarchy-violation penalty within a shared Vision Transformer backbone. This ensures that fine-grained findings are anatomically supported by their coarser-level context rather than predicted in isolation. Experiments demonstrate that CHASE outperforms flat and hierarchical baselines across all levels while achieving superior probabilistic hierarchy consistency, with level-wise attention maps confirming anatomically grounded predictions. Code is available at: https://github.com/yejix-ai/CHASE.

AI.title_translation: 基于临床依据的层级分类用于一致的胸部X光片解读
AI.tldr: 本文提出了CHASE框架，通过模仿放射科医师从解剖区域到病理发现的三级推理过程并引入层级一致性约束，显著提升了胸部X光片解读的准确性与逻辑一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动胸部X光片解读方法大多将其作为扁平分类问题处理，忽视了解剖区域与病理发现之间的跨层级依赖关系，无法保证粗粒度和细粒度预测结果之间的一致性。
AI.method: 提出CHASE单阶段框架，构建了包含9个解剖区域、17个子区域和28个病理发现的三级临床分类体系；在共享的Vision Transformer骨干网络中，联合优化多层级监督、跨层级概率对齐以及层级违规惩罚机制。
AI.result: CHASE在所有层级上的表现均优于扁平分类基线和层级分类基线，获得了更优的概率层级一致性，且层级注意力图验证了其预测具备明确的解剖学依据。
AI.conclusion: CHASE框架通过模拟放射科医生从粗到细的临床推理，成功保证了细粒度病理预测具有合理的解剖学依据，显著提高了胸部X光片解读的准确性与层级一致性。
AI.translation: 准确的胸部X光片解读本质上具有层级性。临床决策不仅取决于存在何种异常，还取决于其具体位置，这需要从广泛的解剖系统推理至具体的病理发现。然而，现有的自动化系统在很大程度上将其视为扁平分类问题，未能捕获层级间的依赖关系，也无法强制实施粗粒度和细粒度预测之间的一致性。我们提出了CHASE（具有层级分析和结构化约束的分类），这是一个统一的单阶段框架，通过由临床驱动的包含9个解剖区域、17个子区域和28个病理发现的三层分类体系，映射放射科医师从粗到细的推理过程。CHASE在共享的Vision Transformer骨干网络内联合优化多层级监督、跨层级概率对齐和层级违规惩罚。这确保了细粒度的发现能获得其更粗层级上下文的解剖支持，而不是被孤立地预测。实验表明，CHASE在所有层级上均优于扁平基线和层级基线，同时实现了卓越的概率层级一致性，层级注意力图也证实了预测具有解剖学依据。代码获取地址：https://github.com/yejix-ai/CHASE。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CHASE框架，旨在解决胸部X光片自动诊断中缺乏跨层级逻辑一致性的问题。该框架基于临床驱动的三级解剖-病理分类体系，在Vision Transformer中集成了多层级监督、跨层概率对齐与层级违规惩罚，实现了高准确度且具备解剖学逻辑约束的诊断预测。
AI.keywords: 胸部X光片, 层级分类, 概率一致性, Vision Transformer, 解剖学约束
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于将放射科医生的临床推理习惯（从粗粒度解剖区域到细粒度病理发现）融入到单阶段深度模型中，并通过概率对齐与层级违规惩罚显式约束跨层级预测的一致性。其重要性在于显著提升了自动诊断结果的解剖学合理性与逻辑可解释性，减少了细粒度病变与粗粒度解剖位置矛盾的情况。局限性在于其三级分类体系依赖于预定义的解剖结构，对于复杂重叠病变或未涵盖的罕见病灶的扩展性仍有待进一步评估。

title: Paired Recipient-based Evaluation of Survival Prediction for Deceased Donor Kidney Transplants
comments: To appear at the Machine Learning for Healthcare Conference (MLHC) 2026
summary: There has been significant interest in using machine learning algorithms to predict kidney transplant outcomes, such as the number of years until a graft inevitably fails. These prediction algorithms could possibly be used for pre-transplant donor-recipient matching to identify more compatible donors and recipients and thus improve post-transplant outcomes. In this study, we explore the use of survival prediction models trained on deceased donor kidney transplant data from the Scientific Registry of Transplant Recipients (SRTR). We propose a novel paired recipient-based evaluation framework that compares graft outcomes between two recipients who received kidneys from the same deceased donor, allowing us to evaluate the counterfactual benefit of changing the recipient for a certain donor. We find that five different survival prediction models, ranging in complexity from linear to deep learning-based models, all result in ~60% paired recipient-based accuracy. We further translate this accuracy into an interpretable quantity of post-transplant years gained. We also highlight major limitations of the commonly used concordance index (C-index) metric for evaluating survival prediction accuracy in this setting and demonstrate that our proposed paired recipient-based accuracy metric is more clinically relevant and better reflects real-world allocation settings.

AI.title_translation: 逝者捐赠肾移植生存预测的基于成对受者评估方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于同一供体成对受者的评估新框架，用于评估肾移植生存预测模型，比传统C指数更贴近真实器官分配场景。
AI.motivation: 现有的生存预测评估指标（如C指数）在器官分配场景中存在局限性，无法准确评估为特定供体匹配不同受者带来的反事实收益。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于成对受者的评估框架，利用SRTR数据库中接受同一逝者捐赠器官的两名受者数据，对比不同模型（线性到深度学习）在反事实选择下的预测性能，并将其转化为移植后获得的增加生存年数。
AI.result: 五种不同复杂度的生存预测模型在基于成对受者的评估指标上均取得了约60%的准确率；证明了新指标比传统C指数更具临床相关性和现实指导价值。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于成对受者的评估指标比常用的C指数具有更高的临床相关性，能更好地反映真实世界中的器官分配分配场景，为优化移植匹配决策提供了更有价值的依据。
AI.translation: 人们对使用机器学习算法预测肾移植结局（例如移植物衰竭前的维持年数）有着浓厚的兴趣。这些预测算法可用于术前供受者匹配，以识别更匹配的供受者并改善术后结局。在本研究中，我们探索了基于器官移植受者科学登记处（SRTR）逝者捐赠肾移植数据训练的生存预测模型。我们提出了一种新型的基于成对受者的评估框架，通过比较接受同一逝者供体肾脏的两名受者的移植物结局，评估为特定供体更换受者的反事实收益。结果表明，从线性模型到深度学习模型，五种不同复杂度的生存预测模型均获得了约60%的成对受者准确率。我们进一步将该准确率转化为移植后增加的生存年数这一可解释量化指标。此外，我们指出了常用的一致性指数（C-index）在该场景下的主要局限性，并证明我们提出的成对受者准确率指标更具临床相关性，能更好地反映真实世界的分配场景。
AI.summary: 本研究针对逝者捐赠肾移植的生存预测问题，提出了一种新型的基于成对受者的评估框架。该方法通过比较同一捐赠者两名受者的结局来衡量模型反事实预测收益，克服了传统C指数的局限，更符合真实世界的器官分配需求。
AI.keywords: 肾移植, 生存预测, 成对受者评估, 机器学习, 器官分配
AI.comments:
创新性：提出了基于同一供体成对受者的全新评估框架，能够有效评估更换受者的反事实收益，摆脱了传统C指数在真实器官分配场景中的局限；
重要性：为评估和优化术前供受者匹配算法提供了更贴近临床实际的衡量指标；
局限性：五种不同模型的成对准确率均在60%左右，说明模型预测精度仍有较大提升空间，且评估基于SRTR特定数据库。

title: UrbanAgent: A Tool-Augmented Agent for Cross-System Urban Tasks
summary: Modern cities rely on an increasing number of digital services to operate, but residents' daily needs are still difficult to meet. Services are fragmented and have little interoperability, placing a heavy operational burden on users. Existing digital platforms, urban foundation models, and intelligent assistants each address only isolated aspects of an urban task. But they struggle to reliably convert complex natural-language requests into executable cross-system workflows. We propose Urban-Agent, a tool-augmented agent framework for cross-system urban tasks. It couples the cognitive and reasoning capabilities of a large language model with a tool-set supporting code execution, API calls, and Model Context Protocol. Through one adaptive closed loop, it clarifies missing information before acting, grounds tool use in live observations, and aligns the final response with observed evidence and task constraints. To address the evaluation gap, we introduce Urban-Eval, a benchmark specifically designed for cross-system urban request. Unlike prior benchmarks that assess either general tool use or urban knowledge and reasoning, Urban-Eval evaluates both task results and execution quality, including required tool coverage, dependency validity, and evidence traceability. Experimental results indicate that Urban-Agent reaches a 71% task success rate, 10 points above the strongest baseline. This lead holds across GPT-5-mini, Gemini-2.5-flash, DeepSeek-V4-flash, and Qwen3-235B-A22B.

AI.title_translation: UrbanAgent：用于跨系统城市任务的工具增强型智能体
AI.tldr: 本文提出了跨系统城市任务智能体Urban-Agent及其评估基准Urban-Eval，通过结合工具集与自适应闭环机制实现了71%的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现代城市依赖众多碎片化的数字服务，服务间缺乏互操作性，给居民带来沉重的操作负担；现有平台和智能助手仅能处理孤立的城市任务，难以将复杂的自然语言请求可靠地转化为可执行的跨系统工作流。
AI.method: 提出了Urban-Agent框架，将大语言模型的认知与推理能力与代码执行、API调用及模型上下文协议（MCP）组成的工具集耦合；通过自适应闭环机制，在行动前澄清缺失信息，基于实时观察落地工具使用，并将响应与观察证据及约束对齐。此外，设计了专用于评估任务结果与执行质量的Urban-Eval基准。
AI.result: 在Urban-Eval基准测试中，Urban-Agent达到了71%的任务成功率，比最强基线高出10个百分点。该优势在GPT-5-mini、Gemini-2.5-flash、DeepSeek-V4-flash和Qwen3-235B-A22B等多个主干模型上均保持一致。
AI.conclusion: Urban-Agent通过工具增强的自适应闭环机制，显著提升了复杂跨系统城市任务的自动化执行效率与成功率，为未来智慧城市一体化服务搭建了有力基础。
AI.translation: 现代城市依赖日益增多的数字服务来运行，但居民的日常需求仍难以得到满足。服务碎片化且缺乏互操作性，给用户带来了沉重的操作负担。现有的数字平台、城市基础模型和智能助手均只能解决城市任务的孤立方面，难以可靠地将复杂的自然语言请求转化为可执行的跨系统工作流。我们提出了Urban-Agent，一个用于跨系统城市任务的工具增强型智能体框架。它将大语言模型的认知和推理能力与支持代码执行、API调用和模型上下文协议（MCP）的工具集耦合在一起。通过一个自适应闭环，它在行动前澄清缺失信息，基于实时观察落地工具使用，并将最终响应与观察到的证据及任务约束对齐。为了填补评估空白，我们引入了Urban-Eval，这是一个专门为跨系统城市请求设计的基准。与以往仅评估通用工具使用或城市知识与推理的基准不同，Urban-Eval同时评估任务结果和执行质量，包括所需的工具覆盖率、依赖有效性和证据可追溯性。实验结果表明，Urban-Agent达到了71%的任务成功率，比最强的基线高出10个百分点。这一领先优势在GPT-5-mini、Gemini-2.5-flash、DeepSeek-V4-flash和Qwen3-235B-A22B上均保持一致。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了Urban-Agent，一种面向跨系统城市任务的工具增强型大模型智能体框架。该框架结合代码执行、API调用及模型上下文协议，构建了自适应闭环以解决复杂自然语言请求的转化与执行问题。同时，研究者推出了专门评估任务结果与执行质量的Urban-Eval基准。实验证明Urban-Agent在多个主流模型上表现出色，任务成功率达到71%。
AI.keywords: 城市智能体, 工具增强, 跨系统工作流, 大语言模型, 评估基准
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将LLM与代码执行、API调用及模型上下文协议（MCP）结合，解决了跨系统城市任务中服务碎片化和交互困难的痛点。同时，提出的Urban-Eval基准填补了对执行质量和证据可溯源性评估的空白。局限性在于摘要中未详细说明其在面对动态安全隐私限制或极端边缘情况时的鲁棒性。

title: LoCA: Forward-Only LLM Tuning after One-Shot Calibration with Local Credit Assignment
summary: Parameter-efficient post-training reduces the number of trainable parameters, but still requires repeated end-to-end backpropagation through the frozen backbone. Every adaptation step therefore needs backward-capable hardware and must store or recompute activations. We ask whether this repeated backward chain can be replaced by a one-time calibration. We introduce Local Credit Assignment (LoCA), a two-stage method for small-shift adaptation. One probe backward pass fits a low-rank map at each transformer block from the final prediction error to a local hidden-state correction. LoCA then reuses these maps to form blockwise regression targets from forward activations and fits low-rank adapters with closed-form ridge solves. No further backbone backward pass is required. We evaluate LoCA on five discriminative benchmarks with Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 14B. In 16 of 25 reported task--scale comparisons, LoCA yields lower evaluation cross-entropy than the corresponding LoRA run. Its measured full-run GPU peak, including calibration, is 26--29\% lower than LoRA's. After calibration, its CPU steady-state memory is 36--52\% lower and its per-pass time is 43--48\% lower. A shared scale-normalized candidate set is reused across all tested Qwen2.5 sizes and on SmolLM2-1.7B. LoCA thus amortizes global credit assignment into one calibration and enables later forward-only tuning when repeated backpropagation is impractical. The code associated with this paper is available \href{https://github.com/Xia12121/LoCA}{here}.

AI.title_translation: LoCA：基于局部信用分配单次校准后的仅前向大语言模型微调
AI.tldr: LoCA通过单次校准构建误差映射，后续微调仅需前向传播与闭式岭回归计算，大幅降低显存和耗时并取得优于LoRA的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的参数高效微调（PEFT/LoRA）虽然减少了可训练参数量，但每个微调步骤仍需在冻结骨干网络中重复进行端到端反向传播，导致极高的显存开销（保存激活值）和对具备反向传播能力硬件的强依赖。
AI.method: 提出局部信用分配（LoCA）两阶段微调方法：1）利用单次探针反向传播（One probe backward pass），在每个Transformer块学习一个将最终预测误差映射为局部隐藏状态修正的低秩映射；2）后续微调重用该映射，利用前向激活构建块级回归目标，并使用闭式岭回归求解（Closed-form ridge solves）拟合低秩适配器，无需进一步进行骨干网络反向传播。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5（0.5B-14B）和SmolLM2-1.7B模型及5个鉴别性基准测试中，LoCA在25个对比中有16个取得了比LoRA更低的评估交叉熵；全流程GPU峰值显存比LoRA降低26-29%；校准后CPU稳态内存降低36-52%，单次时间消耗减少43-48%。
AI.conclusion: LoCA将全局信用分配成功分摊至单次校准中，在无需重复反向传播的前提下实现了大模型的仅前向微调，显著提升了算力和显存效率。
AI.translation: 参数高效后训练减少了可训练参数的数量，但仍需要在冻结的骨干网络中进行重复的端到端反向传播。因此，每个适应步骤都需要具备反向传播能力的高特硬件，并且必须存储或重新计算激活值。我们探讨这种重复的反向链是否可以被一次性校准所取代。本文提出了局部信用分配（LoCA），一种用于小偏移适应的两阶段方法。一次探针反向传播在每个Transformer块处拟合一个低秩映射，该映射将最终的预测误差转换为局部隐藏状态修正。随后，LoCA重复使用这些映射，利用前向激活构建块级回归目标，并通过闭式岭回归求解拟合低秩适配器。此后不再需要骨干网络的反向传播。我们在带有0.5B至14B参数的Qwen2.5模型上，在五个鉴别性基准测试中评估了LoCA。在25个报告的任务-规模对比中，LoCA在16个对比中取得了比相应LoRA运行更低的评估交叉熵。包含校准在内的全运行测量GPU峰值比LoRA低26--29%。校准后，其CPU稳态内存降低了36--52%，单次通过时间缩短了43--48%。一个共享的规模归一化候选集在所有测试的Qwen2.5尺寸以及SmolLM2-1.7B上得到了重用。因此，LoCA将全局信用分配摊销为一次校准，并在重复反向传播不切实可行时实现了后续的仅前向微调。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LoCA（局部信用分配），一种实现大语言模型仅前向微调的新方法。LoCA通过一次探针反向传播完成校准，构建预测误差到局部隐藏状态修正的映射，随后完全依赖前向传播和闭式岭回归拟合低秩适配器。实验表明，LoCA不仅大幅节省了显存和算力开销，且在多项任务表现上优于LoRA。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型微调, 仅前向微调, 参数高效微调, 局部信用分配, 闭式岭回归
AI.comments: 该工作极具创新性，打破了传统PEFT必须依赖重复端到端反向传播的范式，通过“单次探针校准 + 闭式岭回归拟合”实现了高效的仅前向传播微调。这对于受限于GPU显存或仅支持前向推断的边缘设备具有重要工程应用价值。局限在于目前主要在鉴别性任务和相对较小的分布偏移下验证，其在复杂生成式任务上的泛化能力仍有待探究。

title: MeloCodec: Harnessing Melodic Priors for High-Fidelity Singing Voice Representation
comments: 7 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at IEEE ICME 2026
summary: Neural audio codecs serve as fundamental tokenizers for LLM-based audio generation. While semantic priors are widely exploited to enhance linguistic intelligibility, the integration of explicit acoustic priors remains underexplored, limiting synthesis fidelity in frequency-sensitive domains. To address this gap, we introduce MeloCodec, a novel framework designed to effectively incorporate melodic priors, a critical form of acoustic information for singing. To address the optimization instability typically caused by the direct fusion of such explicit priors, we propose a Tokenize-then-Fuse paradigm that pre-trains a discrete melodic branch to lock in structures before feature fusion. To robustly realize this paradigm, we further propose a two-stage training strategy that prevents codebook collapse and ensures stable convergence. Experiments show that MeloCodec outperforms baselines in singing voice representation, improving pitch consistency and enabling controllable pitch manipulation with minimal timbre degradation.
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at IEEE ICME 2026

AI.title_translation: MeloCodec：利用旋律先验实现高保真歌声表示
AI.tldr: MeloCodec通过引入旋律先验和“先分元后融合”范式，实现了高保真且音高可控的歌声表示。
AI.motivation: 神经网络音频编解码器缺乏对显式声学先验（如旋律）的融合，导致其在歌声等频率敏感领域的合成保真度受限；同时直接融合显式先验容易引发优化不稳定的问题。
AI.method: 提出了MeloCodec框架，包含：1. “先分元后融合”（Tokenize-then-Fuse）范式，即在特征融合前预训练一个离散旋律分支以锁定结构；2. 两阶段训练策略，用以防止码本崩溃并保障训练稳健收敛。
AI.result: MeloCodec在歌声表示任务上超越了基线模型，不仅显著提升了音高一致性，还在对音色造成极小劣化的前提下实现了可控的音高操纵。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入旋律先验并通过“先分元后融合”范式与两阶段训练策略进行优化，能够有效改善神经网络音频编解码器在歌声表示上的保真度与音高控制能力。
AI.translation: 神经网络音频编解码器是基于大语言模型（LLM）的音频生成的关键分词器。尽管语义先验被广泛用于增强语言可解释性，但显式声学先验的结合仍缺乏深入探索，从而限制了频率敏感领域的合成保真度。为了弥补这一空白，我们提出了 MeloCodec，这是一个旨在有效结合旋律先验（歌声的关键声学信息形式）的新型框架。为了解决直接融合此类显式先验通常导致的优化不稳定问题，我们提出了“先分元后融合”（Tokenize-then-Fuse）范式，在特征融合之前预训练一个离散旋律分支以锁定结构。为了稳健地实现该范式，我们进一步提出了两阶段训练策略，以防止码本崩溃并确保稳定收敛。实验表明，MeloCodec 在歌声表示方面优于基线模型，提高了音高一致性，并在极小音色劣化的前提下实现了可控的音高操纵。
AI.summary: 本文提出了MeloCodec框架，旨在通过引入显式旋律先验来提升歌声的高保真表示。针对先验融合易引发的优化不稳定及码本崩溃问题，论文设计了“先分元后融合”范式和两阶段训练策略。实验证明该方法在歌声表示质量、音高一致性及音高可控性方面均取得了优异表现。
AI.keywords: 歌声表示, 音频编解码器, 旋律先验, 先分元后融合, 音高控制
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于针对歌声表示显式引入了旋律先验，并设计了“先分元后融合”（Tokenize-then-Fuse）范式与两阶段训练策略，巧妙解决了显式声学先验融合带来的优化不稳定与码本崩溃问题。其重要性在于提升了基于大语言模型的音频生成在歌声等频率敏感领域的合成质量与音高可控性。局限性在于摘要中未展示具体的定量对比指标及该方法在非歌声通用音频上的泛化能力。

title: Standalone DINOv3 for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation in Remote Sensing
summary: Remote sensing semantic segmentation is hindered by costly pixel-level annotations, motivating training-free open-vocabulary methods. Recently, the recent release of DINOv3 brings DINO.txt, which equips the standalone DINO backbone with image-text contrastive learning and thus opens up the possibility of open-vocabulary segmentation. We propose DinoSplat-OV, a training-free framework that adapts DINOv3 to remote sensing without fine-tuning or additional pretraining. Targeting the dense distribution, multi-scale nature, and large size of remote sensing imagery, we design two core modules. Its Text-aware Laplacian Propagation module de-noises patch-level predictions by combining textual semantic affinities with local visual similarity, improving regional consistency while preserving boundaries. Its Gaussian Splatting Upsampling module reconstructs pixel-level features through RGB-guided anisotropic aggregation and test-time optimization. A global-anchor sliding-window strategy further supports large-scale imagery.
