title: An asymptotic-preserving adjoint unified gas kinetic scheme for sensitivity analysis
summary: High-dimensional sensitivity analysis and uncertainty quantification for multiscale gas dynamics, spanning the continuum to rarefied regimes, require computationally efficient and mathematically consistent gradient evaluation. This paper develops a discrete adjoint method for the unified gas-kinetic scheme (UGKS) based on a dual-consistent formulation. The adjoint system is derived directly from the discrete microscopic velocity-distribution equation coupled with the macroscopic-moment compatibility conditions. To resolve the stiff cross-scale coupling, we propose an asymptotic-preserving (AP) adjoint formulation constructed via macroscopic-moment projection and microscopic lifting. Under this framework, the AP adjoint formulation eliminates the stiff collision coupling and removes the collision-time step restriction in the continuum regime. Numerically, a memory-efficient residual-evaluation algorithm that mirrors the forward UGKS cell-vertex data structure is implemented to bypass the memory bottleneck in velocity space. Furthermore, a macroscopic--microscopic predictor--corrector implicit marching scheme is designed to accelerate convergence without solving a globally coupled system. The accuracy, consistency, and robustness of the proposed AP-adjoint scheme are rigorously verified against an independent linearized UGKS solver across a wide range of Knudsen numbers, including lid-driven cavity heat conduction, microchannel thermal creep flow, and hypersonic flow past a circular cylinder.

title: Relational Priors as Convergence Pressure in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language model-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) are designed through roles, debate protocols, and aggregation rules. These choices create implicit social expectations: agents may be expected to trust, challenge, defer to, or collaborate with peers. We study the effects of making inter-agent relation semantics explicit. We use a minimal signed-network formulation of relational priors and inject natural-language renderings into agent system prompts while holding the task protocol fixed. Across a commons-governance simulation and multi-agent debate, relational priors primarily act as convergence pressure: increasing relational positivity tends to make agents coordinate or agree more readily. This pressure can help when utility rewards behavioral alignment, as in sustainable resource governance and subjective consensus. It does not, however, reliably improve accuracy. In objective QA debates, higher positivity can increase agreement even when correctness-conditioned agreement does not improve and may decline in some settings. Effects vary by model backbone, relation type, and topology; explicit neutrality is not equivalent to omitting relational framing. We argue that relational priors should not be a default add-on for LLM-MAS. Their safer use is diagnostic and task-specific: compare against a no-prior baseline, monitor correctness-conditioned metrics when truth matters, and omit the relational layer when validation does not justify it.

title: UniNav: A Unified World-Action Diffusion Model for Visual Navigation
summary: Image-goal visual navigation is a fundamental capability for embodied agents. Existing navigation policies efficiently predict waypoint trajectories but lack visual foresight, while navigation world models can anticipate future observations but often require costly planning rollouts. We present UniNav, a unified world-action model that generates future visual observations and continuous waypoint trajectories through a single diffusion process. Given history frames and a goal image, UniNav jointly denoises visual and waypoint tokens within a single transformer, unifying future prediction and action generation in a shared framework. To improve spatial grounding, we incorporate geometry-aware camera tokens. We also train on both trajectory-labeled navigation data and video-only data, enabling the model to benefit from diverse videos without waypoint annotations. Based on this unified framework, we introduce two variants: UniNav-Full jointly predicts interpretable future observations and their corresponding trajectories, while UniNav-Fast removes future-image tokens at inference for efficient trajectory prediction. Experiments on navigation benchmarks show that UniNav outperforms the strongest baseline in ATE across all datasets. With one-step inference, UniNav-Fast achieves a latency of 0.1s without a substantial accuracy drop. Code will be released.

title: CIGTSurv: Clinical Information Guided Tri-modal Survival Prediction with Local Prototype Association and Global Feature Alignment
summary: Multimodal learning has significantly advanced survival prediction by integrating pathology images with genomic data. However, clinical information, despite its critical role in reflecting a patient' s overall health, remains underutilized due to its discrete, sparse, and low-dimensional nature. Furthermore, the inherent heterogeneity across these modalities pose significant challenges in modeling cross-modal interactions. In this paper, we propose CIGTSurv, a Clinical Information Guided Tri-modal framework for Survival prediction. Specifically, we first design a holistic text template and use pretrained foundation models to transform clinical tabular data into high-dimensional tokenized embeddings. Using clinical information as an anchor, we then introduce a dual-level interaction mechanism: 1) a local prototype association (LPA) module based on cross-attention to explicitly learn token-level correspondences between different modalities, and 2) a global feature alignment (GFA) loss based on Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to implicitly enhance cross-modal distribution consistency. Extensive experiments on five TCGA cancer cohorts demonstrate that CIGTSurv achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) survival prediction performance. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Daijing-ai/CIGT-Surv.git.

title: One Knob to Rule Them All: A Unified Optimal Transport View of Cold-Start Active Learning
summary: Cold-Start Active Learning (CSAL) aims to select a valuable subset from an unlabeled pool without any prior knowledge or human assistance. Existing methods take diverse routes based on typicality, coverage, or diversity. Each rests on its own inductive bias and therefore performs well on some tasks yet poorly on others. We argue that the real challenge is not to design yet another selection heuristic, but to make CSAL adapt automatically to the data and task at hand. To this end, we revisit CSAL through the lens of optimal transport. First, we propose a generalized transport selection framework that reveals the shared allocation structure of existing methods and exactly subsumes representative formulations. Second, we introduce a theoretical analysis that characterizes the trade-off controlled by entropic regularization and establishes a task-agnostic minimax bound for cold-start selection. These results provide a principled foundation for adapting the regularization strength to the unlabeled data. Third, we derive a data-adaptive regularization rule and present a novel Sinkhorn-based CSAL algorithm, termed $ε$-Adaptive Selection ($ε$-AS). Extensive experiments on six public datasets and multiple annotation budgets show that $ε$-AS consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. On ImageNet-1k, it improves the average accuracy over ActiveFT by 1.29% while reducing selection time by 56.2%. Code will be released at https://github.com/Z-yiwei/OT-CSAL

title: ShielDroid: A Hybrid Approach Integrating Machine and Deep Learning for Android Malware Detection
summary: The rapid advancement of modern technology has led to a significant increase in the use of smart devices, such as smartphones and tablets, resulting in the widespread adoption of mobile applications. Although applications are required to undergo malware screening before being published on official app stores, many malicious applications successfully evade detection by concealing sophisticated malware variants. These malicious behaviors are often activated only during runtime, making them difficult to identify through conventional static analysis. As a result, malware may remain undetected until after installation, potentially causing irreversible damage to users and their devices. This study presents a real-time Android malware detection framework that analyzes application behavior to accurately identify and classify complex malware. The proposed approach employs a hybrid dynamic analysis technique to distinguish malicious applications from benign ones. After preprocessing and filtering the collected dataset, the applications are classified using multiple machine learning algorithms. A comprehensive performance evaluation is conducted to compare the effectiveness of different classification techniques in terms of detection accuracy and execution time. Experimental results demonstrate that a hybrid model combining Random Forest and a Multilayer Perceptron achieves the best overall performance, attaining an accuracy of 97.5% with an execution time of 22.945 seconds. The proposed framework can enhance mobile device security by enabling timely detection of malicious applications and reducing the risk of cyberattacks.

title: From Wearable Data to Personalized and Actionable Health Insights
summary: Commercial wearable devices continuously capture rich physiological data (e.g., heart rate, respiration), opening new possibilities for monitoring health conditions, notably around stress. Despite their promise, turning raw wearable physiological data streams into visualizations that surface stress-related insights in daily activities, and that ultimately foster reflection, awareness, and better stress management, remains a significant challenge. The data are noisy and context-dependent: the same spike in heart rate can come from sprinting, a tense presentation, or laughing with friends. To address these challenges, we propose a framework that combines user annotations with wearable data to support better stress management. We introduce a web framework offering interactive visualizations that layer daily activities, stress events, and interventions onto raw physiological streams, enabling users to reflect and identify trends. In a four-week pilot with seven university graduate and undergraduate student participants who logged 269 events, our tool revealed patterns between different types of interventions and stress: social interaction reduced average heart rate by 4.35 to 5.0 beats per minute, deliberate rest reduced average Garmin stress scores by 10.03 to 13.83 points, and mindfulness activities decreased average HRV by 6.61 to 13.22 milliseconds.

title: Clarity Contrast and Similarity Selection for Multi-Focus Image Fusion
summary: Multi-focus image fusion (MFIF) aims to generate an all-in-focus image from multiple images of the same scene focused at different regions. Most existing deep learning-based methods lack explicit interaction between the source images, which limits their performance and interpretability. This paper presents a novel Clarity Contrast and Similarity Selection Network (CSNet), to bridge direct information exchange for MFIF. Specifically, by contrasting the clarity differences between source images within our proposed Clarity Contrast Attention Module (CCAM), we mutually enhance sharp features while suppressing blurry ones. This allows us to identify the exactly focused regions in each source and locate the focused-defocused boundaries. Moreover, the Defocus Spread Effect (DSE) degrades pixels in all source images around the boundaries. To further refine these ambiguous areas, we introduce a Similarity Selection Strategy, which reconstructs an initial clear image from source images and selects optimal pixels by comparing the similarity among them. Through this interactive approach, CSNet effectively preserves focused regions as well as recovering natural boundaries to fuse an all-in-focus output. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance both quantitatively and qualitatively. Our code is available on Github: https://github.com/ZYC-HUST/CSNet.

title: CLASVS: Continuous-Latent Autoregression for Melody-Preserving Lyric Editing in Singing Voice Synthesis
summary: Reference-conditioned melody-preserving lyric editing replaces words while retaining a performance's timing, singer identity, and naturalness. Continuous-latent autoregression avoids finite codebooks and offers stepwise generation with learned stopping. Editing creates a conflict absent from ordinary reconstruction: training pairs reference cues with original lyrics, whereas inference asks revised lyrics to override source-lyric-correlated cues; one source-following patch can propagate through AR history. We introduce CLASVS. Its State-Control-Transition (SCT) routing keeps target-lyric and reference-melody controls persistent, returns semantic feedback on phonetic progress to the causal planner, and confines the previous latent patch to the local Transition. Progressive State-Control Grounding (PSCG) learns this contract through paired-edit-free, content-consistent Mandarin reconstruction. On two Mandarin benchmarks, CLASVS improves all four operations over discrete-AR Vevo2 and reduces macro-PER by 46.2%, while maintaining melody, singer similarity, and perceptual quality. Together, these results establish a strong continuous-AR operating point for score-annotation-free lyric edits and a basis for broader stepwise control. Audio demonstrations are available on our project page: https://piedpiperg.github.io/Liyric-SVS/.

title: An L-Stable Sequential Two-Stage Fourth-Order Method with ADER Trajectory Derivatives for Stiff Transport--Relaxation Systems
summary: A fully implicit two-stage fourth-order two-derivative time discretization was introduced previously as a temporal method. This paper closes that sequential integrator for stiff transport--relaxation equations by pairing a conservative finite-volume residual $\mathcal L_h$ with its discrete trajectory derivative $\mathcal G_h^{\rm tr}=D\mathcal L_h\,\mathcal L_h$. An ADER/Cauchy--Kowalevski predictor provides interface states and physical time derivatives; differentiating the same numerical flux and taking shared face differences yields a conservative approximation $\widetilde{\mathcal G}_h$. For linear constant-coefficient balance laws, $\widetilde{\mathcal G}_h=\mathcal G_h^{\rm tr}=\mathcal L_h^2$ exactly, although the derivative operator is assembled independently rather than by squaring the residual matrix. For nonlinear discretizations, the fourth-order temporal theory applies to $\mathcal G_h^{\rm tr}$, while a trajectory-closure consistency estimate controls the ADER approximation. The two unknown stage vectors are solved successively through two $N$-unknown systems. The completed step is fourth order and L-stable; the parameter $C_q=5/183$ cancels the leading inverse-power term and changes the deep-stiff amplification from $O(|z|^{-1})$ to $O(|z|^{-2})$. For fixed compatible spatial spaces, a slow--fast decomposition proves a full-step asymptotic-preserving operator limit with an $O(δ)$ estimate and gives a preparation-dependent uniform-accuracy classification. Linear finite-volume, nonlinear relaxation, one- and two-dimensional damping, diffusion-limit, and modal experiments verify the corresponding closure, accuracy, stability, and singular-limit claims within their stated scopes.

title: NanoMorph-3D: An End-to-End Physics-Driven Unrolling Framework for Nanomaterial Reconstruction
summary: Precise 3D characterization of nanomaterials is essential for unlocking structure-property relationships. However, standard electron tomography is fundamentally limited by the missing wedge problem. Consequently, conventional algorithms suffer from severe geometric distortions, a challenge further complicated by pervasive noise interference. Current learning-based methods either rely on physics-blind post-processing or employ end-to-end architectures constrained by local receptive fields, failing to capture complex 3D topologies. We propose NanoMorph-3D, a unified end-to-end framework grounded in a comprehensive Nanomorphological Taxonomy. Powered by a large-scale synthetic dataset explicitly modeling non-linear electron attenuation, we design a Physics-Driven Unrolled Network mapping proximal gradient descent into a learnable architecture. To capture complex internal topologies, we formulate a hierarchical attention mechanism with Physics-Normalization for long-range 3D dependencies and scale invariance. Crucially, our Dual-Domain strategy leverages Sinusoidal Attention to explicitly model physical projection trajectories, enforcing strict sinogram consistency to mitigate missing wedge artifacts. Finally, an unsupervised dual-stream mechanism bridges the simulation-to-reality gap. Experiments demonstrate NanoMorph-3D reconstructs diverse topologies with superior fidelity and speed.

title: FinVerse: Financial Time-Series Benchmark
summary: As time-series foundation models have emerged, the need for benchmarks that can evaluate their forecasting ability in meaningful ways has become increasingly important. Existing time-series forecasting benchmarks provide useful standardized comparisons, but they often evaluate heterogeneous series with uniform error-based metrics. Strong performance under such metrics does not necessarily imply that a model's forecasts will support the best real-world decisions across domains. For example, in stock forecasting, correctly predicting whether a price will rise or fall can be more directly relevant to realized returns than minimizing point-wise forecast error alone. To this end, we introduce FinVerse, a finance-domain time-series forecasting benchmark that takes a first step toward more realistic evaluation. The released FinVerse data artifact contains 116,897 financial time series with 171.1M observations, of which 60,232 series with 17.4M observations are selected as evaluated targets based on their economic relevance to financial decisions. Unlike generic forecasting benchmarks that primarily emphasize uniform point-forecast or probabilistic accuracy, FinVerse defines 11 metric families comprising 78 evaluation metrics and assigns the most appropriate evaluation metrics to each individual time series based on its underlying economic meaning. Our analysis of 43 public time-series forecasting foundation models shows that strong performance under generic forecasting criteria does not necessarily translate into useful financial forecasts. This finding highlights the need for domain-aware benchmarks that evaluate models under objectives closer to real-world decision making.

title: ED-DiT: Physics-Guided Diffusion Pretraining for Transferable Molecular Representations from Electron Density
comments: 16 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Pretraining has shown strong potential for learning transferable representations, yet it remains underexplored for electron-density-based molecular learning. Electron density provides a continuous three-dimensional description of molecular electronic structure, capturing both local spatial patterns and global physical quantities. This raises a key question: can electron-density fields be used for self-supervised pretraining to learn a shared representation that transfers across diverse electronic-structure-related tasks? We propose ED-DiT, a physics-guided Diffusion Transformer for self-supervised pretraining on electron-density point clouds. ED-DiT learns reusable representations by reconstructing corrupted and partially masked log-density fields across diffusion noise levels. An electron-number consistency constraint is further introduced to preserve the total electronic mass. The pretrained encoder can be adapted to property prediction, open-/closed-shell classification, molecule-electron-density retrieval, and molecule-conditioned electron-density prediction. Experiments on six EDBench tasks show that ED-DiT consistently outperforms the same architecture trained from scratch, especially under limited supervision. For molecule-conditioned electron-density prediction, it reduces RMSE from 2.2474 to 1.3753 and surpasses the available baseline. With only 10% labels, it improves orbital energy prediction RMSE from 0.0293 to 0.0138. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of physics-guided electron-density pretraining for learning transferable molecular representations.
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables, including supplementary material

AI.title_translation: ED-DiT：物理引导扩散预训练，用于从电子密度中学习可迁移分子表示
AI.tldr: ED-DiT提出了一种基于电子密度点云的物理引导扩散Transformer，用于自监督预训练，以学习可迁移的分子表示。它通过重建被破坏的对数密度场并引入电子数一致性约束来实现，在多个电子结构相关任务中表现出色，尤其是在有限监督下。
AI.motivation: 预训练在学习可迁移表示方面显示出巨大潜力，但在基于电子密度的分子学习中仍未得到充分探索。电子密度提供了分子电子结构的连续三维描述，捕获局部空间模式和全局物理量。因此，主要问题是：电子密度场能否用于自监督预训练，以学习在不同电子结构相关任务之间迁移的共享表示？
AI.method: 我们提出了ED-DiT，一种物理引导的扩散Transformer，用于对电子密度点云进行自监督预训练。ED-DiT通过在不同扩散噪声水平下重建被破坏和部分遮蔽的对数密度场来学习可重用表示。此外，还引入了电子数一致性约束以保持总电子质量。
AI.result: ED-DiT在六项EDBench任务中持续优于从头训练的相同架构，尤其是在有限监督下。对于分子条件电子密度预测，RMSE从2.2474降低到1.3753，并超越了现有基线。仅使用10%的标签，它将轨道能量预测的RMSE从0.0293提高到0.0138。
AI.conclusion: 物理引导的电子密度预训练在学习可迁移分子表示方面是有效的。
AI.translation: 预训练在学习可迁移表示方面显示出巨大潜力，但在基于电子密度的分子学习中仍未得到充分探索。电子密度提供了分子电子结构的连续三维描述，捕获局部空间模式和全局物理量。这提出了一个关键问题：电子密度场能否用于自监督预训练，以学习在不同电子结构相关任务之间迁移的共享表示？我们提出了ED-DiT，一种物理引导的扩散Transformer，用于对电子密度点云进行自监督预训练。ED-DiT通过在不同扩散噪声水平下重建被破坏和部分遮蔽的对数密度场来学习可重用表示。此外，还引入了电子数一致性约束以保持总电子质量。预训练的编码器可以适应属性预测、开/闭壳分类、分子-电子密度检索和分子条件电子密度预测。在六项EDBench任务上的实验表明，ED-DiT持续优于从头训练的相同架构，尤其是在有限监督下。对于分子条件电子密度预测，它将RMSE从2.2474降低到1.3753，并超越了现有基线。仅使用10%的标签，它将轨道能量预测的RMSE从0.0293提高到0.0138。这些结果证明了物理引导的电子密度预训练在学习可迁移分子表示方面的有效性。
AI.summary: ED-DiT提出了一种创新的物理引导扩散Transformer模型，旨在通过对电子密度点云进行自监督预训练来学习可迁移的分子表示。该模型通过重建损坏的对数密度场并结合电子数一致性约束来捕获分子电子结构。实验证明，ED-DiT在多种电子结构相关任务中表现出优越性，尤其是在数据稀缺的情况下，显著提升了预测精度并超越了现有基线，证实了其在学习可迁移分子表示方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 电子密度, 扩散预训练, 分子表示, 自监督学习, Transformer
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将扩散模型和Transformer架构应用于电子密度场的自监督预训练，并引入了物理引导（电子数一致性）来增强模型的物理合理性。这为从电子密度中学习更通用、可迁移的分子表示提供了一个新颖且有效的方法，对于解决电子结构相关任务中的数据稀缺问题具有重要意义。

title: The Ignition Is Real, and It Lives at the Readout: Latent composition, difficulty-clocked ignition, and the interface-constituted commit in a recurrent-depth reasoner
summary: We test whether the "compositional ignition" reported in latent-reasoning models is real computation, an instrument artifact, or inherited from verbal training data. We grow an independent realization of a published 30M-parameter recurrent-depth reasoner from scratch (same recipe and seed), film its development, certify fidelity through a pre-registered whole-signature gate, and measure resolution in two channels at once: the vocabulary readout and the hidden state. The ignition is real and lives at the readout: arrival time rises lawfully with problem depth, resolution is sharp and holds, and the signature reproduces across two same-seed realizations with divergent training trajectories. At commitment the decision margin jumps 5.8-8.0 logits in one iteration, exceeding the 90th percentile of near-threshold non-event steps in 96% of cases; the signed margin's zero-crossing there is definitional and carries no evidential weight, so the evidence is that conditioned magnitude. The hidden-state direction snaps in raw geometry, meeting its pre-registered criterion (in the decoder's LayerNorm coordinates it attenuates just below our bar, so the composite decoder-coordinate claim is not confirmed), and then freezes in both (descriptively so in decoder coordinates; angular steps 52.9 to 1.2 degrees over eight iterations), while subsequent displacement is predominantly radial (0.961 of squared-norm) and readout-null to a measured bound (radial logit effect <=5.7e-6). An earlier velocity-trough claim is withdrawn: pre-registered normalization controls showed it coordinate-dependent. Intermediates were never recoverable through the tied readout (relay 0.00). All criteria were frozen before their data; the predictions ledger, including this paper's own withdrawn headline, ships in the companion repository.

AI.title_translation: “点火”是真实的，并存在于读出层：循环深度推理器中的潜在组合、难度计时点火和接口构成的提交
AI.tldr: 潜在推理模型中的“组合点火”是一个真实的计算事件，发生于读出层，而非伪影或训练数据继承。
AI.motivation: 测试潜在推理模型中报告的“组合点火”是真实的计算、仪器伪影，还是继承自语言训练数据。
AI.method: 从头开始独立实现了一个已发布的30M参数循环深度推理器，记录了其开发过程，通过预注册的全签名门认证了其保真度，并同时测量了词汇读出层和隐藏状态两个通道的分辨率。
AI.result: 点火是真实的，并存在于读出层：到达时间随问题深度合法地增加，分辨率清晰且保持，并在相同种子的不同训练轨迹实现中重现。在提交时，决策裕度在一个迭代中跳跃了5.8-8.0 logits。隐藏状态方向在原始几何中突然变化。早期关于速度谷的说法被撤回，因为其与坐标相关。中间结果从未通过绑定的读出层恢复。
AI.conclusion: “组合点火”是一个真实的计算事件，它定位在读出层，并在提交时表现出决策裕度的显著跳跃和隐藏状态方向的明确变化。
AI.translation: 我们测试了潜在推理模型中报告的“组合点火”是真实的计算、仪器伪影还是继承自语言训练数据。我们从头开始（相同的配方和种子）独立实现了一个已发布的30M参数循环深度推理器，记录了其开发过程，通过预注册的全签名门认证了其保真度，并同时测量了两个通道的分辨率：词汇读出层和隐藏状态。点火是真实的，并存在于读出层：到达时间随问题深度合法地增加，分辨率清晰且保持，并且签名在两个具有不同训练轨迹的相同种子实现中重现。在提交时，决策裕度在一个迭代中跳跃了5.8-8.0 logits，在96%的情况下超过了接近阈值的非事件步骤的90%分位数；有符号裕度的零交叉是定义性的，不携带任何证据权重，因此证据是条件下的幅度。隐藏状态方向在原始几何中突然变化，符合其预注册标准（在解码器的LayerNorm坐标中，它衰减到我们的阈值以下，因此复合解码器坐标声明未得到证实），然后两者都冻结（在解码器坐标中是描述性的；八次迭代中角度步长从52.9度到1.2度），而随后的位移主要是径向（平方范数的0.961），并且读出层对测量边界无效（径向logit效应<=5.7e-6）。早期关于速度谷的说法被撤回：预注册的归一化控制显示它与坐标相关。中间结果从未通过绑定的读出层恢复（中继0.00）。所有标准在数据之前都已冻结；预测账本，包括本文自己的已撤回标题，随附在配套存储库中。
AI.summary: 本文通过复制和分析一个循环深度推理器，研究了潜在推理模型中“组合点火”是否为真实的计算现象。研究证实，“点火”是一个真实的事件，发生于读出层，其特征是在提交时决策裕度急剧增加和隐藏状态方向发生明显变化。论文驳斥了先前关于速度谷和中间结果可恢复性的说法。
AI.keywords: 组合点火, 潜在推理, 循环深度推理器, 读出层, 隐藏状态
AI.comments: 该论文通过复制研究和预注册标准，严谨地调查了潜在推理模型的一个基本方面，确保了科学的有效性。其发现有助于定位和表征“点火”事件，提供了关于这些模型如何做出决策的见解。明确撤回先前的声明展示了科学的完整性。

title: Hear to See: Discerning Stateful Listening for Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation
summary: Audio-visual instance segmentation (AVIS) requires accurately identifying and tracking individual sounding objects with pixel-level masks. Existing methods struggle to match overlapping acoustic events with visual instances and handle asynchronous audio-visual dynamics. Therefore, two critical questions arise: how can a model establish precise correspondence between overlapping sound sources and visual instances, and how can a model maintain robust tracking when audio and visual signals are temporally misaligned?This paper proposes Hear to See (H2S), addressing these challenges through two mechanisms. The Acoustic-Semantic Projector (ASP) disentangles mixed audio and establishes hierarchical correspondence from semantic to spatial domains. The Asynchronous Dynamics Modulator (ADM) adaptively adjusts state transitions via audio-modulated Mamba, prioritizing current information during dynamic variations and maintaining continuity in stable periods.Experiments on AVISeg show H2S achieves SOTA performance, attaining 48.54 mAP with a COCO pretrained ResNet50 and surpassing the previous by 7.8\%. The code will be open-sourced once the paper is accepted. The source code will be publicly available at https://github.com/leiyeliu/H2S.

AI.title_translation: 听声辨影：辨别有状态的听觉用于音视频实例分割
AI.tldr: H2S提出了一种新的音视频实例分割方法，通过处理重叠声源和异步音视频动态，实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频实例分割方法难以匹配重叠声学事件与视觉实例，并处理异步音视频动态。因此，需要解决如何建立重叠声源与视觉实例的精确对应，以及如何在音视频信号时间错位时保持鲁棒跟踪的问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了Hear to See (H2S)方法，通过两种机制解决挑战：声学-语义投影器 (ASP) 用于解耦混合音频并建立从语义到空间域的层次对应；异步动态调制器 (ADM) 通过音频调制的Mamba自适应调整状态转换，在动态变化期间优先考虑当前信息，并在稳定期间保持连续性。
AI.result: 在AVISeg上，H2S取得了SOTA性能，使用COCO预训练的ResNet50达到了48.54 mAP，超越了之前的方法7.8%。
AI.conclusion: H2S通过其创新的ASP和ADM机制，有效解决了音视频实例分割中重叠声源匹配和异步动态处理的难题，并取得了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 音视频实例分割 (AVIS) 需要准确识别并以像素级掩码跟踪单个发声物体。现有方法难以将重叠的声学事件与视觉实例匹配，并处理异步的音视频动态。因此，出现了两个关键问题：模型如何建立重叠声源与视觉实例之间的精确对应，以及当音频和视觉信号在时间上错位时，模型如何保持鲁棒的跟踪？本文提出了Hear to See (H2S)，通过两种机制解决这些挑战。声学-语义投影器 (ASP) 解耦混合音频，并建立从语义到空间域的层次对应。异步动态调制器 (ADM) 通过音频调制的Mamba自适应调整状态转换，在动态变化期间优先考虑当前信息，并在稳定期间保持连续性。AVISeg上的实验表明，H2S取得了SOTA性能，使用COCO预训练的ResNet50达到了48.54 mAP，超越了之前的方法7.8%。论文一旦被接受，代码将开源。源代码将在 https://github.com/leiyeliu/H2S 公开提供。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Hear to See (H2S) 的音视频实例分割方法，旨在解决现有方法在处理重叠声源与视觉实例匹配以及异步音视频动态方面的不足。H2S引入了声学-语义投影器 (ASP) 来解耦混合音频并建立层次对应，以及异步动态调制器 (ADM) 通过音频调制的Mamba自适应调整状态转换。实验结果表明，H2S在AVISeg数据集上实现了48.54 mAP的最先进性能，相较于之前的方法提升了7.8%。
AI.keywords: 音视频实例分割, 声学-语义投影器, 异步动态调制器, Mamba, 状态跟踪
AI.comments: 该论文通过提出H2S框架，创新性地解决了音视频实例分割中两个核心挑战：重叠声源与视觉实例的精确匹配以及异步音视频信号的鲁棒跟踪。ASP和ADM机制的设计思路独特，特别是ADM利用音频调制的Mamba来处理时序动态，有望为多模态时序建模提供新的视角。其SOTA的性能提升也证明了方法的有效性。

title: Impacts of Single-objective Landscapes on Multi-objective Optimization
comments: 9 pages, 12 figures, 1 table. Author's accepted version. Published in Proc. 2022 IEEE Congress on Evolutionary Computation (CEC), part of IEEE WCCI 2022
summary: This work revealed a relationship between a multi-objective optimization problem and single-objective optimization problems that exist in the multi-objective problem. This work focused on combinatorial problems and investigated the relations between the local optima networks of the single-objective problems and the Pareto optima network of the multi-objective problem. Each of their networks has a graph structure. We divided the entire network into subgraphs. Each subgraph was called a component and characterized by overlapping relations between the single-objective local optima networks and the multi-objective Pareto optima network. Results on multi-objective landscape problems showed that most Pareto optimal solutions were reachable from the single-objective local optimal solutions. This tendency was emphasized by increasing the number of objectives and the objective correlation. The number of co-variables impacted the number of cross-link relations between the single-objective local optima networks and the multi-objective Pareto optima network. The results suggested that searching for single-objective problems is a clue to multi-objective optimization.

AI.title_translation: 单目标景观对多目标优化的影响
AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了多目标优化问题与其内部单目标优化问题之间的关系，发现单目标局部最优解有助于找到多目标帕累托最优解，并指出搜索单目标问题是多目标优化的一个线索。
AI.motivation: 揭示多目标优化问题与其内部存在的单目标优化问题之间的关系，特别关注组合问题，并探讨单目标局部最优网络与多目标帕累托最优网络之间的关系。
AI.method: 将多目标问题中的单目标问题局部最优网络和多目标问题帕累托最优网络都视为具有图结构的实体，并将其划分为子图（组件）。通过分析单目标局部最优网络与多目标帕累托最优网络之间的重叠关系来表征这些组件。在多目标景观问题上进行了结果验证。
AI.result: 大多数帕累托最优解都可以从单目标局部最优解中获得。这种倾向随着目标数量和目标相关性的增加而增强。协变量的数量影响了单目标局部最优网络与多目标帕累托最优网络之间交叉链接关系的数量。
AI.conclusion: 搜索单目标问题是多目标优化的一个线索。
AI.translation: 这项工作揭示了多目标优化问题与多目标问题中存在的单目标优化问题之间的关系。这项工作侧重于组合问题，并研究了单目标问题局部最优网络与多目标问题帕累托最优网络之间的关系。它们各自的网络都具有图结构。我们将整个网络划分为子图。每个子图称为一个组件，并以单目标局部最优网络与多目标帕累托最优网络之间的重叠关系为特征。多目标景观问题的结果表明，大多数帕累托最优解都可以从单目标局部最优解中获得。这种趋势随着目标数量和目标相关性的增加而增强。协变量的数量影响了单目标局部最优网络与多目标帕累托最优网络之间交叉链接关系的数量。结果表明，搜索单目标问题是多目标优化的一个线索。
AI.summary: 这项研究深入探讨了多目标优化问题与其中包含的单目标优化问题之间的关系，特别是在组合问题背景下。通过将单目标局部最优网络和多目标帕累托最优网络建模为具有图结构的网络，并分析它们之间的重叠关系，研究发现绝大多数帕累托最优解可从单目标局部最优解中达到。这一趋势在目标数量和目标相关性增加时更为显著。此外，协变量数量对两类最优解网络之间的交叉链接关系数量有影响。研究结果强烈暗示，对单目标问题的探索可以作为解决多目标优化问题的有效途径。
AI.keywords: 多目标优化, 单目标景观, 帕累托最优, 局部最优, 组合问题
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过深入分析单目标景观与多目标优化之间的内在联系，为多目标优化提供了一种新颖的视角。其创新点在于将两种优化问题的“最优解网络”视为图结构并分析其重叠关系，揭示了从局部单目标信息推导全局多目标最优解的可能性。这对于理解复杂优化问题和设计更高效的多目标优化算法具有重要意义。

title: FedGSA: Geometry-Consistent Subspace Aggregation for Differentially Private Federated LoRA
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables communication-efficient federated fine-tuning of pretrained language models. However, integrating differential privacy (DP) into federated LoRA remains challenging: independently perturbing and aggregating its two low-rank matrices can cause aggregation mismatch and the quadratic noise term. Existing methods mitigate these issues by freezing one low-rank matrix but still rely on Euclidean aggregation, which is basis-dependent and may distort the global update. To address this limitation, we propose FedGSA, a geometry-consistent aggregation framework for differentially private federated LoRA. FedGSA represents each privatized client update as a basis-invariant subspace on the Grassmann manifold. In each communication round, clients extract low-dimensional subspaces capturing dominant update directions and encode them as projection matrices. The server aggregates these representations to estimate a geometry-consistent global update subspace and reconstructs the global LoRA factors within it, reducing distortion caused by basis misalignment, privacy noise, and heterogeneous client updates. We prove that FedGSA incurs no additional privacy loss beyond client-side DP training and establish its convergence under standard assumptions. Experiments on four GLUE tasks and a language generation benchmark demonstrate consistent improvements across privacy budgets and degrees of data heterogeneity. In particular, FedGSA improves average accuracy over the strongest baseline by 2.17% and 2.27% under $ε=6$ and $ε=3$, respectively.

AI.title_translation: FedGSA：差分隐私联邦LoRA的几何一致子空间聚合
AI.tldr: FedGSA提出了一种几何一致的子空间聚合框架，用于差分隐私联邦LoRA，通过在格拉斯曼流形上聚合基不变的子空间更新，有效解决了现有方法中的聚合不匹配、二次噪声和基依赖性问题，并在多个NLP任务上取得了显著的准确性提升。
AI.motivation: 将差分隐私（DP）集成到联邦低秩适应（LoRA）中面临挑战：独立扰动和聚合两个低秩矩阵会导致聚合不匹配和二次噪声项。现有方法通过冻结一个低秩矩阵来缓解这些问题，但仍依赖于欧几里得聚合，这种聚合方式依赖于基且可能扭曲全局更新。
AI.method: FedGSA是一种几何一致的聚合框架。它将每个隐私化的客户端更新表示为格拉斯曼流形上的基不变子空间。在每个通信轮次中，客户端提取捕获主要更新方向的低维子空间，并将其编码为投影矩阵。服务器聚合这些表示以估计几何一致的全局更新子空间，并在其中重建全局LoRA因子，从而减少由基不对齐、隐私噪声和异构客户端更新引起的失真。该方法证明了除了客户端侧DP训练之外，不会产生额外的隐私损失，并建立了在标准假设下的收敛性。
AI.result: 实验在四个GLUE任务和一个语言生成基准上进行，结果表明在不同的隐私预算和数据异构程度下均取得了持续的改进。具体而言，在ε=6和ε=3的条件下，FedGSA相对于最强基线平均准确率分别提高了2.17%和2.27%。
AI.conclusion: FedGSA通过引入几何一致的子空间聚合，有效解决了差分隐私联邦LoRA中的挑战，提高了模型性能和隐私保护水平。该方法在理论上保证了隐私无额外损失和收敛性，并在实践中展现出优越的准确性。
AI.translation: 低秩适应（LoRA）使得预训练语言模型的通信高效联邦微调成为可能。然而，将差分隐私（DP）集成到联邦LoRA中仍然具有挑战性：独立扰动和聚合其两个低秩矩阵可能导致聚合不匹配和二次噪声项。现有方法通过冻结一个低秩矩阵来缓解这些问题，但仍依赖于欧几里得聚合，这种聚合方式依赖于基且可能扭曲全局更新。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了FedGSA，一个用于差分隐私联邦LoRA的几何一致聚合框架。FedGSA将每个隐私化的客户端更新表示为格拉斯曼流形上的基不变子空间。在每个通信轮次中，客户端提取捕获主要更新方向的低维子空间，并将其编码为投影矩阵。服务器聚合这些表示以估计几何一致的全局更新子空间，并在其中重建全局LoRA因子，从而减少由基不对齐、隐私噪声和异构客户端更新引起的失真。我们证明了FedGSA除了客户端侧DP训练之外，不会产生额外的隐私损失，并建立了在标准假设下的收敛性。在四个GLUE任务和一个语言生成基准上的实验表明，在不同的隐私预算和数据异构程度下均取得了持续的改进。特别是，在ε=6和ε=3的条件下，FedGSA相对于最强基线平均准确率分别提高了2.17%和2.27%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了FedGSA，一种用于差分隐私联邦LoRA的几何一致子空间聚合框架。针对现有联邦LoRA中DP集成导致的聚合不匹配、二次噪声和基依赖性问题，FedGSA将客户端更新视为格拉斯曼流形上的基不变子空间。通过聚合这些子空间表示并重建全局LoRA因子，FedGSA有效减少了由基不对齐和隐私噪声引起的失真。理论分析证明了其隐私无额外损失和收敛性。实验结果显示，FedGSA在多个NLP任务上显著提升了在不同隐私预算和数据异构条件下的模型准确性。
AI.keywords: 联邦LoRA, 差分隐私, 子空间聚合, 格拉斯曼流形, 几何一致性
AI.comments: FedGSA的创新点在于将联邦学习中的模型更新视为格拉斯曼流形上的子空间，从而实现了几何一致的聚合。这种方法有效地解决了传统欧几里得聚合在差分隐私联邦LoRA中面临的基依赖性和失真问题，为如何在隐私保护下进行更鲁棒、更准确的联邦模型更新提供了一个新的视角。其理论证明和实验结果都支持了该方法的有效性和重要性。

title: Efficient Video Dataset Distillation via Cluster-Guided Prototype Blending
summary: Video dataset distillation aims to compress a large video dataset into a compact surrogate set that preserves its training utility. Most existing approaches synthesize condensed videos through iterative optimization, whose cost is amplified by the temporal dimension. Rather than further reducing the number of optimized variables, we investigate whether effective distilled videos can be constructed without gradient-based optimization of the stored videos. Such a construction-based approach must address three challenges: selecting informative temporal segments, covering diverse intra-class variations under a limited videos-per-class budget, and increasing the information carried by each stored sample. To this end, we propose ProtoBlend, an efficient select-allocate-blend framework. First, teacher-guided temporal clip selection retains a high-confidence segment from each source video. Second, cluster-guided prototype allocation partitions the selected clips in the teacher feature space and assigns one distilled slot to each intra-class cluster. Third, each prototype is blended with an in-cluster anchor, while their teacher predictions are combined using the same coefficient to provide mixture-source supervision. Experiments on four trimmed action-recognition benchmarks demonstrate that ProtoBlend achieves a competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-off without iterative optimization of the distilled videos.

AI.title_translation: 通过聚类引导原型混合实现高效视频数据集蒸馏
AI.tldr: ProtoBlend通过选择、分配和混合策略，无需迭代优化即可高效地蒸馏视频数据集，在动作识别基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有视频数据集蒸馏方法通过迭代优化合成浓缩视频，其成本因时间维度而放大。本文旨在探索无需基于梯度的优化，通过构建方式来创建有效的蒸馏视频。
AI.method: 本文提出了ProtoBlend，一个高效的选择-分配-混合框架。首先，通过教师引导的时间片段选择，从每个源视频中保留高置信度片段。其次，通过聚类引导的原型分配，将选定的片段在教师特征空间中进行分区，并为每个类内聚类分配一个蒸馏槽。第三，每个原型与一个类内锚点混合，同时它们的教师预测使用相同的系数进行组合，以提供混合源监督。
AI.result: 在四个修剪过的动作识别基准上的实验表明，ProtoBlend在没有对蒸馏视频进行迭代优化的情况下，实现了有竞争力的准确性-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: ProtoBlend通过其独特的构建方法，在视频数据集蒸馏中实现了高效且具有竞争力的性能，避免了传统迭代优化的计算开销。
AI.translation: 视频数据集蒸馏旨在将大型视频数据集压缩成一个紧凑的替代集，以保留其训练效用。大多数现有方法通过迭代优化合成浓缩视频，其成本因时间维度而放大。我们没有进一步减少优化的变量数量，而是研究是否可以在不进行存储视频的基于梯度的优化的情况下构建有效的蒸馏视频。这种基于构建的方法必须解决三个挑战：选择信息丰富的时间片段，在有限的每类视频预算下覆盖多样化的类内变异，以及增加每个存储样本携带的信息量。为此，我们提出了ProtoBlend，一个高效的选择-分配-混合框架。首先，教师引导的时间片段选择从每个源视频中保留一个高置信度片段。其次，聚类引导的原型分配将选定的片段在教师特征空间中进行分区，并为每个类内聚类分配一个蒸馏槽。第三，每个原型与一个类内锚点混合，同时它们的教师预测使用相同的系数进行组合，以提供混合源监督。在四个修剪过的动作识别基准上的实验表明，ProtoBlend在没有对蒸馏视频进行迭代优化的情况下，实现了有竞争力的准确性-效率权衡。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为ProtoBlend的高效视频数据集蒸馏框架，旨在解决现有方法中迭代优化带来的高计算成本问题。ProtoBlend采用选择-分配-混合策略，首先通过教师引导选择高置信度视频片段，然后通过聚类引导分配原型以覆盖类内多样性，最后将原型与锚点混合并结合教师预测进行监督。实验证明，该方法在不进行迭代优化的情况下，在动作识别任务上实现了有竞争力的准确性与效率平衡。
AI.keywords: 视频数据集蒸馏, ProtoBlend, 聚类引导, 原型混合, 动作识别
AI.comments: ProtoBlend的创新之处在于它提出了一种非迭代、基于构建的视频数据集蒸馏方法，显著降低了计算成本。通过引入聚类引导的原型分配和混合策略，有效解决了类内多样性和信息量问题，为视频数据集蒸馏领域提供了一个高效的新范式。

title: GUI-Lens: Coarse-to-Fine Cropping for GUI Grounding with General-Purpose VLMs
summary: GUI grounding maps natural-language instructions to click locations and is essential for reliable GUI agents. The task remains difficult on high-resolution, densely populated interfaces because a vision-language model (VLM) may recognize a requested control without locating it precisely enough for interaction. Most existing methods provide various forms of localization assistance, but still rely on a direct click prediction, allowing visual ambiguity or an inaccurate initial estimate to propagate to the final result. In this paper, we introduce GUI-Lens, a coarse-to-fine grounding framework that allows a general-purpose VLM to determine the target through active visual observations. Specifically, GUI-Lens extracts OCR text and detected UI components from the screenshot and presents their positions as coordinate references. Using the instruction, the current view, and these references, the VLM selects the region and scale of the next view, which is cropped and enlarged to provide finer visual details. This process continues over successively focused views until the target is determined. Proposed crops and clicks are checked against the instruction throughout the process, and the final local position is mapped back to the original screen coordinates. Experiments on four GUI grounding benchmarks and three general-purpose VLM backends show that GUI-Lens improves overall grounding accuracy by up to 24.9 percentage points and achieves state-of-the-art performance with GPT-5.5.

AI.title_translation: GUI-Lens：通用VLM的GUI定位粗到细裁剪方法
AI.tldr: GUI-Lens引入了一种粗到细的裁剪方法，用于GUI定位，显著提高了通用视觉语言模型（VLM）的定位精度，并实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 在高分辨率、密集界面的GUI定位任务中，现有方法难以精确识别和定位目标，因为视觉语言模型（VLM）可能识别出控件但无法精确定位，且直接点击预测容易受到视觉模糊或不准确初始估计的影响。
AI.method: GUI-Lens是一个粗到细的定位框架，它通过主动视觉观察使通用VLM确定目标。它从屏幕截图中提取OCR文本和UI组件的位置作为坐标参考。VLM利用指令、当前视图和这些参考来选择下一个视图的区域和比例，然后裁剪并放大以提供更精细的视觉细节。这个过程在连续聚焦的视图上进行，直到确定目标，并在此过程中检查提议的裁剪和点击，最终将局部位置映射回原始屏幕坐标。
AI.result: GUI-Lens在四个GUI定位基准和三个通用VLM后端上的实验表明，其整体定位准确性提高了高达24.9个百分点，并使用GPT-5.5实现了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: GUI-Lens通过引入一种新颖的粗到细裁剪机制，有效解决了GUI定位中的精度挑战，显著提升了通用视觉语言模型在该任务中的准确性，使其能够更可靠地执行指令。
AI.translation: GUI定位将自然语言指令映射到点击位置，对于可靠的GUI代理至关重要。在高分辨率、密集界面的任务仍然很困难，因为视觉语言模型（VLM）可能识别出请求的控件，但无法精确定位以进行交互。大多数现有方法提供各种形式的定位辅助，但仍然依赖于直接点击预测，这可能导致视觉模糊或不准确的初始估计传播到最终结果。在本文中，我们引入了GUI-Lens，一个粗到细的定位框架，允许通用VLM通过主动视觉观察来确定目标。具体来说，GUI-Lens从屏幕截图中提取OCR文本和检测到的UI组件，并将其位置作为坐标参考。VLM使用指令、当前视图和这些参考来选择下一个视图的区域和比例，然后裁剪并放大该视图以提供更精细的视觉细节。这个过程在连续聚焦的视图上继续，直到确定目标。在整个过程中，提议的裁剪和点击会根据指令进行检查，最终的局部位置会映射回原始屏幕坐标。在四个GUI定位基准和三个通用VLM后端上的实验表明，GUI-Lens将整体定位准确性提高了24.9个百分点，并使用GPT-5.5实现了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种名为GUI-Lens的粗到细定位框架，旨在提高通用视觉语言模型（VLM）在GUI定位任务中的准确性。针对现有方法在高分辨率GUI上精确本地化困难的问题，GUI-Lens通过迭代裁剪和放大视图，并结合OCR文本和UI组件参考，使VLM能够逐步精确定位目标。这种主动视觉观察方法显著提升了定位准确性，并使用GPT-5.5取得了最先进的成果。
AI.keywords: GUI定位, 视觉语言模型, 粗到细, 裁剪, UI交互
AI.comments: GUI-Lens的创新之处在于其粗到细的裁剪策略，它模拟了人类的视觉搜索过程，解决了VLM在GUI定位中精度受限的问题。这种主动观察机制与通用VLM的结合，使其成为创建更可靠GUI代理的强大而灵活的解决方案。其显著的性能提升证明了其重要性。

title: Attacking and Defending Multi-Agent Collaborative Filtering Systems Through Connectivity
comments: 10 pages, 10 figures, 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '26)
summary:
Multi-agent collaborative filtering (CF) systems coordinate autonomous LLM-powered user and item agents through natural-language interaction to refine preferences and generate recommendations. These systems inherit vulnerabilities from both their data-driven nature and their multi-agent interactions, which manifest in distinct ways. Understanding how connectivity modulates vulnerability in these systems could facilitate the development of more robust recommendation pipelines.
  In this work, we adapt attacks and defenses from the general multi-agent systems (MAS) literature to the agent-based CF setting, evaluating them under systematically varied connectivity in the AgentCF framework, where CF connectivity is characterized along two axes: (i) candidate count (the number of item candidates per turn per user, measuring user-side interaction density) and (ii) catalog concentration (the degree of item catalog overlap across users).
  Our contributions include: (1) Adaptation: we reproduce MAS-inspired attacks and defenses in the agentic CF domain, confirming partial transferability of original observations. (2) Characterization: we characterize how the two aspects of connectivity shape attack and defense outcomes, revealing role asymmetries between user and item agents, non-monotonic temporal dynamics in attack efficacy, and divergent patterns across dissemination and extraction attack goals. Additionally, as an exploratory extension, we assess the applicability of epidemic-inspired static metrics in ranking CF configurations by expected attack outcome, potentially enabling cost-efficient robustness assessment. Implementation is available at https://github.com/anjunhu/ConnACF
comment: 10 pages, 10 figures, 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '26)

AI.title_translation: 通过连接性攻击和防御多智能体协同过滤系统
AI.tldr: 本文研究了多智能体协同过滤系统中的连接性如何影响攻击和防御，通过将多智能体系统中的攻击和防御适应到智能体CF环境中，并评估了不同连接性下的效果，揭示了连接性对攻击防御结果的影响以及潜在的鲁棒性评估方法。
AI.motivation: 多智能体协同过滤（CF）系统存在固有的漏洞，这些漏洞源于其数据驱动性质和多智能体交互。理解连接性如何调节这些系统中的漏洞，可以促进开发更强大的推荐管道。
AI.method: 作者将通用多智能体系统（MAS）文献中的攻击和防御方法应用于基于智能体的协同过滤（CF）设置，并在AgentCF框架中系统地改变连接性进行评估。CF连接性通过两个轴线表征：候选数量（每回合每个用户的项目候选数量，衡量用户侧交互密度）和目录集中度（用户间项目目录重叠的程度）。此外，还探索性地评估了流行病学启发式静态指标在根据预期攻击结果对CF配置进行排名中的适用性。
AI.result: 1. 成功将MAS启发式攻击和防御方法复制到智能体CF领域，并确认了原始观察结果的部分可迁移性。2. 阐明了连接性的两个方面（候选数量和目录集中度）如何影响攻击和防御结果，揭示了用户和项目智能体之间的角色不对称性、攻击效力的非单调时间动态，以及在传播和提取攻击目标上的不同模式。3. 评估了流行病学启发式静态指标在通过预期攻击结果对CF配置进行排名中的适用性，这可能实现成本效益高的鲁棒性评估。
AI.conclusion: 连接性在多智能体协同过滤系统的攻击和防御中扮演着关键角色，理解其影响有助于开发更鲁棒的推荐系统，并且流行病学启发式指标可能提供一种成本效益高的鲁棒性评估方法。
AI.translation:
多智能体协同过滤（CF）系统通过自然语言交互协调由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的自主用户和项目智能体，以完善偏好并生成推荐。这些系统继承了其数据驱动性质和多智能体交互的漏洞，这些漏洞以独特的方式表现出来。了解连接性如何调节这些系统中的漏洞，有助于开发更强大的推荐管道。
在这项工作中，我们将通用多智能体系统（MAS）文献中的攻击和防御方法应用于基于智能体的CF设置，并在AgentCF框架中系统地改变连接性进行评估，其中CF连接性沿两个轴线进行表征：(i) 候选数量（每个用户每回合的项目候选数量，衡量用户侧交互密度）和 (ii) 目录集中度（用户间项目目录重叠的程度）。
我们的贡献包括：(1) 适应性：我们在智能体CF领域重现了MAS启发式攻击和防御方法，证实了原始观察结果的部分可迁移性。(2) 特征化：我们阐明了连接性的两个方面如何影响攻击和防御结果，揭示了用户和项目智能体之间的角色不对称性、攻击效力的非单调时间动态，以及在传播和提取攻击目标上的不同模式。此外，作为一项探索性扩展，我们评估了流行病学启发式静态指标在根据预期攻击结果对CF配置进行排名中的适用性，这可能实现成本效益高的鲁棒性评估。实现代码可在 https://github.com/anjunhu/ConnACF 获取。
AI.summary: 本文研究了多智能体协同过滤（CF）系统中的漏洞，特别关注连接性如何影响攻击和防御。作者将通用多智能体系统（MAS）的攻击和防御策略应用于基于智能体的CF环境，并在不同连接性（通过候选数量和目录集中度衡量）下进行评估。研究发现，MAS方法在CF领域部分可迁移，并详细描述了连接性如何塑造攻击和防御结果，揭示了智能体角色不对称性、攻击效力的动态变化以及不同攻击目标的模式。此外，还探索了使用流行病学启发式指标进行鲁棒性评估的可能性。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 协同过滤, 漏洞, 攻击与防御, 连接性
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过将多智能体系统领域的攻击和防御策略引入到新兴的LLM驱动的多智能体协同过滤系统中，具有创新性。它系统地研究了连接性对系统漏洞和鲁棒性的影响，为理解和构建更安全的推荐系统提供了新的视角。特别是在连接性特征化方面，揭示了智能体角色、攻击动态和目标模式的差异，这些都是重要的发现。探索流行病学启发式指标也为未来的鲁棒性评估提供了潜在的成本效益方法。

title: Right Divisibility in Erasing Semi-Thue Systems: A Minimal View of Intruder Deduction
comments: 26 pages, 1 figure (Tikz generated), submitted to CSL 2027
summary: The intruder deduction problem is central to symbolic security-protocol analysis: it asks whether an attacker can derive a target message from observed messages using (cryptographic) operators available to the attacker. Although convergent rewrite systems provide canonical normal forms, deduction modulo convergent theories remains undecidable in general, and existing decidable fragments are often shaped by practical cryptographic examples. In this paper, we study deduction from a minimal structural perspective. When all function symbols are unary, terms collapse to words and deduction becomes a right-divisibility problem for semi-Thue systems: given words $u$ and $v$ decide whether there exists $w$ such that $wu \equiv_S v$. We investigate this problem for several classes of semi-Thue systems and prove, to the best of our knowledge, new decidability results for convergent prefix-erasing and convergent suffix-erasing systems. We then extend this perspective to term rewriting systems whose rules erase contexts while lifting selected subterms or variables. Although these classes suggest possible decidable generalisations beyond the unary setting, we show that deduction is already undecidable for a convergent simultaneous variable-lifting system. This exposes both the potential and the limits of extending the right-divisibility results to richer equational theories.
