AI.translation: 微缩放（MX）现在是低位大语言模型（LLM）推理的标准。其4位形式MXFP4仍然会损失大量精度，因为现有的MX格式在块之间固定了元素格式或精度恢复方案，因此只能捕获有限的量化异构性。量化异构性出现在两个层面：1）在块之间，首选的元素格式和精度恢复方案各不相同；2）在操作数之间，权重和激活需要不同的编码。我们引入了AdaMX（自适应微缩放），这是一种异构感知的格式和加速器。它在不增加等效比特宽度（EBW）的情况下，为每个块选择精度恢复方案，并为每个操作数选择表示方式。一个设计涵盖两种块大小，提供更高的精度操作点和更低的EBW操作点以节省存储。我们实现了一个22纳米FD-SOI AI加速器原型，其中包含所提出的解码器、计算单元和量化逻辑。与一个同样使用FP4乘法器的MXFP4加速器相比，AdaMX增加了约1%的系统能耗。在较低EBW点，AdaMX在降低内存占用和能耗的同时，比基线更准确。在3B到70B的LLM上，AdaMX消除了MXFP4在常识任务上83%的精度损失和在MMLU上82%的精度损失，以及NVFP4在常识任务上43%和在MMLU上27%的损失。AdaMX还泛化到多模态模型。在Gemma-4 12B上，它在所有四个视觉-语言基准测试中都优于MXFP4，并保持了高达96%的FP16精度。
AI.summary: 本文提出AdaMX（自适应微缩放），一种解决低位LLM推理中量化异构性导致精度损失的新型微缩放格式和专用加速器。AdaMX通过为每个块自适应选择精度恢复方案和为每个操作数选择表示方式，显著提高了4位量化LLM的准确性，同时保持了高效能。实验结果表明，AdaMX在多种LLM（3B-70B）和多模态模型上，相较于MXFP4和NVFP4能大幅恢复精度，且仅增加约1%的系统能耗，或在低EBW点实现更优的能耗和内存占用。
AI.keywords: 微缩放, LLM推理, 低位量化, AdaMX, 异构感知
AI.comments: AdaMX的创新点在于其异构感知设计，能够根据块和操作数的不同特性自适应调整量化策略，有效克服了传统微缩放格式的局限性。它不仅在精度上取得了显著提升，同时在硬件实现上也考虑了效率，通过提供不同操作点满足多样化需求。其对多模态模型的泛化能力也增强了其实用性，预示着低位量化技术在更广泛AI应用中的潜力。

title: GENESIS: Towards Explainable Causal Discovery
summary: Causal Discovery (CD) from observational data faces two fundamental challenges. First, purely statistical methods often lack the power to resolve structural ambiguities in low-sample regimes. Second, although LLM-assisted hybrid approaches improve structure recovery through semantic reasoning, the influence of that reasoning on individual edge decisions remains largely opaque. Consequently, existing hybrid methods fail to satisfy a fundamental requirement: explaining why a particular edge is included or excluded in the learned directed acyclic graph (DAG). This is critical in real-world applications, where no ground-truth DAG exists and every structural decision must be independently justified. We formalize this requirement as decision traceability, requiring every inferred edge to be supported by auditable statistical evidence, Markov Blanket consistency, or explicit domain reasoning. We propose GENESIS, an explainable hybrid CD framework that decomposes graph construction into interpretable decision points. GENESIS first identifies and scores three-node structural motifs, including chains, forks, and colliders, to establish transparent structural priors, then progressively refines the graph by integrating these priors with observational evidence, invoking domain knowledge only when statistical evidence is insufficient. By design, every edge decision is resolved through an auditable source of evidence. Experiments show that GENESIS achieves 100% decision traceability across all settings, establishing explainability as a first-class objective in causal discovery. Despite this additional requirement, GENESIS consistently outperforms purely statistical CD methods on the majority of benchmark datasets across all sample regimes in terms of Structural Hamming Distance (SHD), while achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art LLM-assisted approaches.

AI.title_translation: GENESIS：迈向可解释的因果发现
AI.tldr: 因果发现（CD）在低样本下缺乏统计能力，且现有LLM辅助方法对边缘决策的影响不透明。GENESIS提出一个可解释的混合CD框架，通过可审计的证据实现100%的决策可追溯性，并优于纯统计方法，同时与最先进的LLM辅助方法性能相当。
AI.motivation: 从观测数据中进行因果发现面临两大挑战：一是纯统计方法在低样本状态下解决结构模糊性的能力不足；二是LLM辅助的混合方法虽然通过语义推理提高了结构恢复能力，但其推理对单个边缘决策的影响不透明。因此，现有混合方法未能满足一个基本要求：解释为什么在学习到的有向无环图（DAG）中包含或排除特定边缘，这在没有真实DAG的实际应用中至关重要。
AI.method: GENESIS是一个可解释的混合因果发现（CD）框架，它将图构建分解为可解释的决策点。首先识别并评估三节点结构基序（包括链、分叉和碰撞器），以建立透明的结构先验；然后通过将这些先验与观测证据相结合来逐步细化图，仅当统计证据不足时才调用领域知识。通过设计，每个边缘决策都通过可审计的证据来源（统计证据、马尔可夫毯一致性或明确的领域推理）解决。
AI.result: GENESIS在所有设置下实现了100%的决策可追溯性，将可解释性确立为因果发现的一流目标。尽管有这一额外要求，GENESIS在大多数基准数据集的所有样本制度中，在结构汉明距离（SHD）方面始终优于纯统计CD方法，同时实现了与最先进的LLM辅助方法相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: GENESIS成功地将可解释性作为因果发现的首要目标，通过提供全面的决策可追溯性，解决了现有方法在解释边缘决策方面的不足，并在保持高性能的同时超越了纯统计方法。
AI.translation: 从观测数据中进行因果发现（CD）面临两个基本挑战。首先，纯统计方法往往缺乏在低样本状态下解决结构模糊性的能力。其次，尽管LLM辅助的混合方法通过语义推理改进了结构恢复，但该推理对单个边缘决策的影响在很大程度上仍然不透明。因此，现有混合方法未能满足一个基本要求：解释为什么在学习到的有向无环图（DAG）中包含或排除特定边缘。这在实际应用中至关重要，因为实际应用中不存在真实DAG，并且每个结构决策都必须独立地进行论证。我们将这一要求形式化为决策可追溯性，要求每个推断的边缘都必须得到可审计的统计证据、马尔可夫毯一致性或明确的领域推理的支持。我们提出了GENESIS，一个可解释的混合CD框架，它将图构建分解为可解释的决策点。GENESIS首先识别并评估三节点结构基序，包括链、分叉和碰撞器，以建立透明的结构先验，然后通过将这些先验与观测证据相结合来逐步细化图，仅当统计证据不足时才调用领域知识。通过设计，每个边缘决策都通过可审计的证据来源解决。实验表明，GENESIS在所有设置下实现了100%的决策可追溯性，将可解释性确立为因果发现的一流目标。尽管有这一额外要求，GENESIS在大多数基准数据集的所有样本制度中，在结构汉明距离（SHD）方面始终优于纯统计CD方法，同时实现了与最先进的LLM辅助方法相当的性能。
AI.summary: GENESIS是一个新颖的可解释混合因果发现（CD）框架，旨在解决现有方法在边缘决策可解释性方面的不足。它通过将图构建分解为可解释的决策点，并利用可审计的统计证据、马尔可夫毯一致性或领域推理来支持每个边缘决策，从而实现100%的决策可追溯性。该方法首先识别并评分三节点结构基序以建立透明先验，然后将这些先验与观测证据结合，并在统计证据不足时引入领域知识。实验证明，GENESIS在保持与最先进LLM辅助方法相当性能的同时，在结构汉明距离方面优于纯统计CD方法，并成功地将可解释性确立为因果发现的核心目标。
AI.keywords: 因果发现, 可解释性, 决策可追溯性, 混合框架, 结构基序
AI.comments: 本文的核心创新在于将“决策可追溯性”引入因果发现领域，并将其作为首要目标。GENESIS通过结合结构先验、观测证据和领域知识的混合方法，提供了一个透明且可审计的因果图构建过程。其能够在实现100%可解释性的同时，超越纯统计方法并与LLM辅助方法性能相当，这表明在因果发现的实际应用中，可解释性与高性能并非不可兼得，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: EvoHIL: Self-Evolving Reward and Flow-Matched Policy Optimization for Robust Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
summary: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HIL-RL) enables robots to learn contact-rich manipulation from limited real-world interaction, but deployment exposes three coupled limitations: static visual reward models fail under scene changes; independently sampled actions cause temporally inconsistent motion; and vision-based policies remain sensitive to appearance shifts. We present EvoHIL, a unified framework that adapts the reward model, action generator, and visual do main within a staged human-in-the-loop learning process. First, self-evolving reward (SER) adapts the success classifier from human-confirmed positives and provisional weak negatives. Second, Action Flow Stabilization (AFS) generates temporally coherent action chunks through flow matching, grounding policy updates in executed action prefixes and demonstrated behavior. Third, retention-aware offline fine-tuning replays relit interaction data while anchoring the AFS actor-critic to prior behavior, adapting the visual domain without additional robot interaction. Across six manipulation tasks on Franka FR3 and SO-101 arms under a controlled lighting shift, EvoHIL improves task success, agreement with human-confirmation labels, motion smoothness, and completion time relative to human-in-the-loop and imitation baselines.Project page: https://anonymous4366.github.io/EvoHIL/

AI.title_translation: EvoHIL：自演进奖励和流匹配策略优化，实现稳健的人机协作强化学习
AI.tldr: EvoHIL是一个统一框架，通过自演进奖励、动作流稳定和保留感知离线微调，解决了人机协作强化学习中奖励模型静态、动作不一致和视觉策略对外观变化敏感的问题，提高了机器人在复杂操作任务中的成功率、平滑度和完成时间。
AI.motivation: 现有人机协作强化学习（HIL-RL）在部署时存在三个耦合限制：静态视觉奖励模型在场景变化下失效；独立采样的动作导致时间上不一致的运动；以及基于视觉的策略对外观变化敏感。
AI.method: EvoHIL是一个统一框架，通过分阶段的人机协作学习过程来适应奖励模型、动作生成器和视觉域。具体包括：1. 自演进奖励（SER）：从人类确认的阳性样本和临时的弱阴性样本中调整成功分类器。2. 动作流稳定（AFS）：通过流匹配生成时间上连贯的动作块，将策略更新基于已执行的动作前缀和演示行为。3. 保留感知离线微调：重放重新点亮（relit）的交互数据，同时将AFS的actor-critic锚定到先前的行为，从而在不额外进行机器人交互的情况下适应视觉域。
AI.result: 在Franka FR3和SO-101机械臂上进行的六项操作任务中，EvoHIL在受控光照变化下，相对于人机协作和模仿学习基线，提高了任务成功率、与人类确认标签的一致性、运动平滑度和完成时间。
AI.conclusion: EvoHIL通过其自演进奖励、动作流稳定和保留感知离线微调机制，有效解决了人机协作强化学习在复杂操作任务中面临的挑战，显著提升了机器人的学习性能和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 人机协作强化学习（HIL-RL）使机器人能够从有限的真实世界交互中学习接触丰富的操作，但部署时暴露出三个耦合限制：静态视觉奖励模型在场景变化下失效；独立采样的动作导致时间上不一致的运动；以及基于视觉的策略对外观变化敏感。我们提出了EvoHIL，一个统一的框架，通过分阶段的人机协作学习过程来适应奖励模型、动作生成器和视觉域。首先，自演进奖励（SER）从人类确认的阳性样本和临时的弱阴性样本中调整成功分类器。其次，动作流稳定（AFS）通过流匹配生成时间上连贯的动作块，将策略更新基于已执行的动作前缀和演示行为。第三，保留感知离线微调重放重新点亮（relit）的交互数据，同时将AFS的actor-critic锚定到先前的行为，从而在不额外进行机器人交互的情况下适应视觉域。在Franka FR3和SO-101机械臂上进行的六项操作任务中，EvoHIL在受控光照变化下，相对于人机协作和模仿学习基线，提高了任务成功率、与人类确认标签的一致性、运动平滑度和完成时间。项目页面：https://anonymous4366.github.io/EvoHIL/
AI.summary: EvoHIL是一个创新的人机协作强化学习框架，旨在解决现有HIL-RL在实际部署中遇到的静态奖励模型、动作不连贯和视觉策略对外观变化敏感等问题。该框架通过引入自演进奖励（SER）来动态调整成功分类器，动作流稳定（AFS）来生成时间上连贯的动作序列，以及保留感知离线微调来在不增加机器人交互的情况下适应视觉域。实验结果表明，EvoHIL在多项操作任务中显著提升了任务成功率、运动平滑度和效率，展现了其在复杂操作场景下的鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.keywords: 人机协作强化学习, 自演进奖励, 流匹配, 策略优化, 机器人操作
AI.comments: EvoHIL的创新之处在于其将奖励模型、动作生成器和视觉域适应集成到一个统一的框架中，并采用分阶段的人机协作学习过程。特别是自演进奖励机制和动作流稳定方法，有效地解决了HIL-RL在动态环境和复杂操作中面临的核心挑战。保留感知离线微调也增强了其在有限交互下的泛化能力。这项工作对于提升机器人学习的实用性和鲁棒性具有重要意义。

title: ContinualSkillBench: Can LLM Agents Truly Evolve Their Capabilities?
summary: Modern agent frameworks equip large language models with external skill libraries to solve complex tasks. However, it remains unclear whether these systems can effectively evolve their skills and whether the resulting skills improve task-solving capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce ContinualSkillBench, a dynamic evaluation framework for in-context continual skill learning. It covers five representative domains, each containing 100 interconnected subtasks ordered by increasing difficulty and opportunities for cross-task skill reuse. Our experiments show that sequential execution generally improves performance, but the gains vary substantially across models and domains. Moreover, in-context learning performs comparably to explicit skill maintenance on average, suggesting that much of the improvement arises from adaptation to prior context and feedback rather than reusable skill abstraction alone. Explicit skills nevertheless provide selective benefits for tasks requiring reusable procedures or precise outputs. We further find that less capable models tend to accumulate larger, more fragmented collections of task-specific skills. These findings show that current in-context skill evolution mechanisms can support continual adaptation, but still struggle to consistently consolidate experience into robust and transferable skills.

AI.title_translation: ContinualSkillBench：大语言模型智能体能否真正进化其能力？
AI.tldr: 本文提出了ContinualSkillBench框架来评估大语言模型智能体的持续技能学习能力，发现当前模型主要依靠上下文适应而非真正的技能抽象，在技能巩固和迁移上仍有待提高。
AI.motivation: 尽管现代智能体框架为大语言模型配备了外部技能库以解决复杂任务，但目前尚不清楚这些系统是否能真正有效地进化其技能，以及由此产生的技能是否能切实提升任务解决能力。
AI.method: 引入了ContinualSkillBench评估框架，涵盖5个代表性领域（每个领域包含100个按难度递增且可交叉复用的互连子任务），并对比了顺序执行、上下文学习以及显式技能维护等策略在不同模型上的表现。
AI.result: 实验表明，顺序执行通常能提升性能，但增益因模型和领域而异；上下文学习的平均表现与显式技能维护相当，暗示性能提升多源于对先前上下文和反馈的适应而非单纯的技能抽象；显式技能在需要可复用程序或精确输出的任务中具有选择性优势；同时，较弱的模型往往会积累更大、更碎片化的特定任务技能集合。
AI.conclusion: 当前的大语言模型智能体虽然能够通过上下文学习实现持续适应，但在将经验转化为鲁棒且可迁移的通用技能方面仍存在不足。弱模型往往会积累更多碎片化的特定任务技能，凸显了未来改进技能抽象与维护机制的必要性。
AI.translation: 现代智能体框架为大语言模型配备了外部技能库以解决复杂任务。然而，这些系统是否能有效地进化其技能，以及由此产生的技能是否能提高任务解决能力，目前尚不清楚。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了ContinualSkillBench，一个用于上下文持续技能学习的动态评估框架。它涵盖五个具有代表性的领域，每个领域包含100个互连的子任务，这些子任务按难度递增且具有跨任务技能复用的机会。我们的实验表明，顺序执行通常能提高性能，但收益在不同模型和领域之间存在显著差异。此外，上下文学习的平均表现与显式技能维护相当，这表明大部分性能提升来自于对先前上下文和反馈的适应，而不仅仅是可复用的技能抽象。尽管如此，显式技能为需要可复用程序或精确输出的任务提供了选择性收益。我们进一步发现，能力较弱的模型倾向于积累更大、更碎片化的特定任务技能集合。这些发现表明，当前基于上下文的技能进化机制可以支持持续适应，但在持续将经验巩固为鲁棒且可迁移的技能方面仍然存在困难。
AI.summary: ContinualSkillBench是一个用于评估大语言模型智能体在上下文中持续学习技能的新型动态评估框架。研究发现，虽然顺序执行和上下文学习能促进任务适应，但现有的技能进化机制在将经验巩固为鲁棒、可迁移的可复用技能方面仍然面临挑战。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型智能体, 持续技能学习, 动态评估框架, 上下文学习, 技能进化
AI.comments: 该论文设计了一个极具前瞻性的动态评估框架 ContinualSkillBench，深入探讨了大语言模型智能体在持续技能学习和进化方面的真实能力，指出了当前显式技能维护与纯上下文学习的局限性与优劣，为未来智能体架构的发展提供了重要的实证依据和改进方向。

title: Enhancing VLM Reward Models Through Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning
summary: Designing effective reward functions remains a major bottleneck in Reinforcement Learning (RL). Recent work uses large foundation Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as reward models, computing text-observation similarity to bypass manual reward engineering. Although promising, these rewards are often noisy and unreliable, limiting their direct utility during deployment. We present Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning (SAFT), a simple, self-supervised method that refines these imperfect reward signals online without access to ground-truth supervision. SAFT leverages intrinsic structural priors to regularize the VLM's latent space via LoRA adapters. We rigorously evaluate SAFT across a spectrum of base model capabilities to demonstrate its versatility. Our results show that SAFT consistently denoises the reward landscape, yielding faster policy convergence and substantially improved alignment (EPIC distance) relative to the underlying base model, suggesting that failures can often be attributed to structural brittleness rather than semantic misunderstanding. By replacing extensive human preference annotation with structural inductive biases inherent to the task, SAFT offers a scalable path for stabilizing text-conditioned RL and underscores the broader value of incorporating task structure as a general inductive bias.

AI.title_translation: 通过结构感知微调增强VLM奖励模型
AI.tldr: SAFT是一种简单的自监督方法，通过利用内在结构先验来微调VLM奖励模型，从而在无需人工监督的情况下稳定文本条件强化学习，提高策略收敛并改善对齐。
AI.motivation: 强化学习 (RL) 中设计有效的奖励函数仍然是一个主要瓶颈。最近的工作使用大型基础视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 作为奖励模型，通过计算文本-观察相似性来绕过手动奖励工程，但这些奖励通常是嘈杂且不可靠的，限制了它们在部署期间的直接效用。
AI.method: SAFT (Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning) 是一种简单、自监督的方法，可以在线细化这些不完美的奖励信号，无需地面真实监督。SAFT 利用内在结构先验通过 LoRA 适配器来正则化 VLM 的潜在空间。
AI.result: SAFT 持续去噪奖励景观，相对于底层基础模型，产生更快的策略收敛和显著改进的对齐 (EPIC 距离)，这表明失败通常可归因于结构脆弱性而非语义误解。
AI.conclusion: 通过用任务固有的结构归纳偏置取代广泛的人类偏好注释，SAFT 为稳定文本条件强化学习提供了一条可扩展的路径，并强调了将任务结构作为一般归纳偏置的更广泛价值。
AI.translation: 设计有效的奖励函数仍然是强化学习 (RL) 的主要瓶颈。最近的工作使用大型基础视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 作为奖励模型，通过计算文本-观察相似性来绕过手动奖励工程。尽管前景广阔，但这些奖励通常是嘈杂且不可靠的，限制了它们在部署期间的直接效用。我们提出了结构感知微调 (SAFT)，这是一种简单、自监督的方法，无需访问地面真实监督即可在线细化这些不完美的奖励信号。SAFT 利用内在结构先验通过 LoRA 适配器来正则化 VLM 的潜在空间。我们严格评估了 SAFT 在一系列基础模型能力上的表现，以证明其多功能性。我们的结果表明，SAFT 持续去噪奖励景观，相对于底层基础模型，产生更快的策略收敛和显著改进的对齐 (EPIC 距离)，这表明失败通常可归因于结构脆弱性而非语义误解。通过用任务固有的结构归纳偏置取代广泛的人类偏好注释，SAFT 为稳定文本条件强化学习提供了一条可扩展的路径，并强调了将任务结构作为一般归纳偏置的更广泛价值。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为结构感知微调 (SAFT) 的自监督方法，旨在解决视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 奖励函数在强化学习中存在的噪声和不可靠问题。SAFT 利用内在结构先验通过 LoRA 适配器正则化 VLM 的潜在空间，从而在线细化奖励信号，无需人工监督。实验结果表明，SAFT 能够有效去噪奖励景观，加速策略收敛并显著改善与基础模型的对齐，为稳定文本条件强化学习提供了一条可扩展的路径。
AI.keywords: VLM 奖励模型, 强化学习, 自监督学习, 结构感知微调, LoRA
AI.comments: SAFT 的创新点在于其自监督的特性，通过利用任务固有的结构归纳偏置来替代昂贵的人工偏好注释，从而提供了一种可扩展且高效的 VLM 奖励模型微调方案。它揭示了 VLM 奖励模型失败可能更多源于结构脆弱性而非语义理解不足，为未来的研究提供了新的视角。

title: From population norms to personalized trajectories: interpretable Bayesian forecasting for cognitive decline
summary: The timing and rate of cognitive decline vary substantially between individuals, limiting the ability of fixed population-level thresholds to determine whether a new observation represents meaningful change for an individual. We developed Personalized Risk Inference via Sequential Monitoring (PRISM), an interpretable framework for individualized longitudinal forecasting of cognitive decline. PRISM estimates a personalized cognitive baseline from routinely collected demographic, health, and functional variables using an Explainable Boosting Machine, then updates this expectation through Bayesian inference with temporal decay as cognitive scores accrue. Decline is evaluated relative to an age-adjusted personal anchor, with uncertainty quantified through posterior probabilities. We evaluated PRISM in 30,664 adults from the Health and Retirement Study and externally validated it in 1,866 Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative participants. Forecasting performance was compared with demographic-norm and cumulative-average baselines, and discrimination with a linear mixed-effects model. PRISM identified emerging decline before study-defined cognitive worsening in 31% of sustained decliners in the Health and Retirement Study and 41% in the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, with median lead times of 6 and 2 years, respectively. By the time of worsening, 68% and 56% had been identified. PRISM also achieved lower forecasting error than demographic-norm and cumulative-average baselines and distinguished worsening from stable trajectories better than a linear mixed-effects model, particularly early in follow-up. PRISM enables earlier, interpretable, uncertainty-aware detection of cognitive decline relative to each individual's expected trajectory using routinely collected data. It may support closer monitoring and timely assessment when personal longitudinal history is limited.

AI.title_translation: 从群体规范到个性化轨迹：可解释的贝叶斯认知衰退预测
AI.tldr: 该研究开发了PRISM，一个可解释的贝叶斯框架，用于个性化预测认知衰退，它比传统方法能更早、更准确地检测到衰退。
AI.motivation: 个体间认知衰退的时间和速度差异很大，传统的固定群体水平阈值难以确定个体有意义的变化，因此需要一种个性化的方法。
AI.method: 开发了PRISM（通过序贯监测进行个性化风险推断）框架，该框架利用可解释增强机器从常规数据中估计个性化认知基线，然后通过贝叶斯推断和时间衰减更新预期。衰退是相对于年龄调整的个人锚点进行评估，并通过后验概率量化不确定性。
AI.result: PRISM在健康与退休研究中31%和阿尔茨海默病神经影像倡议中41%的持续衰退者中，在认知恶化前识别出衰退，中位提前时间分别为6年和2年。到恶化时，68%和56%的病例已被识别。PRISM的预测误差低于人口统计学规范和累积平均基线，并且比线性混合效应模型更能区分恶化和稳定轨迹。
AI.conclusion: PRISM能够利用常规收集的数据，相对于每个个体预期轨迹，实现更早、可解释、不确定性感知的认知衰退检测。它可能支持在个人纵向历史有限时进行更密切的监测和及时评估。
AI.translation: 个体间认知衰退的时间和速度差异很大，这限制了固定群体水平阈值确定新观察是否代表个体有意义变化的能力。我们开发了通过序贯监测进行个性化风险推断（PRISM），这是一个用于认知衰退个体化纵向预测的可解释框架。PRISM使用可解释增强机器从常规收集的人口统计学、健康和功能变量中估计个性化认知基线，然后随着认知评分的累积，通过具有时间衰减的贝叶斯推断更新这一预期。衰退是相对于年龄调整的个人锚点进行评估的，不确定性通过后验概率量化。我们在健康与退休研究的30,664名成人中评估了PRISM，并在1,866名阿尔茨海默病神经影像倡议参与者中进行了外部验证。预测性能与人口统计学规范和累积平均基线进行了比较，判别能力与线性混合效应模型进行了比较。PRISM在健康与退休研究中31%的持续衰退者和阿尔茨海默病神经影像倡议中41%的持续衰退者中，在研究定义的认知恶化之前识别出正在出现的衰退，中位提前时间分别为6年和2年。到恶化时，68%和56%的病例已被识别。PRISM还实现了比人口统计学规范和累积平均基线更低的预测误差，并且比线性混合效应模型更能区分恶化和稳定轨迹，尤其是在随访早期。PRISM能够利用常规收集的数据，相对于每个个体预期轨迹，实现更早、可解释、不确定性感知的认知衰退检测。当个人纵向历史有限时，它可能支持更密切的监测和及时评估。
AI.summary: 本研究开发了PRISM（通过序贯监测进行个性化风险推断），一个用于个体化纵向预测认知衰退的可解释贝叶斯框架。PRISM利用可解释增强机器建立个性化认知基线，并通过贝叶斯推断更新。在两项大型研究中，PRISM表现出比传统方法更早、更准确地识别认知衰退的能力，并具有更低的预测误差。该框架有望支持早期检测和更精细的个体化监测。
AI.keywords: 个性化轨迹, 贝叶斯预测, 认知衰退, PRISM, 可解释性
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了PRISM框架，将可解释增强机器与贝叶斯推断相结合，实现了从群体规范到个体化轨迹的认知衰退预测。其优势在于能够提供早期、可解释且考虑不确定性的个体化衰退检测，对于临床实践中的早期干预具有重要意义。

title: Operationally Feasible Synthetic Power-Grid Scenarios via Learning the AC-Operable Joint Distribution
summary: Synthetic power-grid scenarios are essential for planning, resilience assessment, contingency analysis, and data-driven power-system applications. Recent synthetic grid generation methods have improved structural realism and operational feasibility by incorporating engineering knowledge through post-generation validation, optimization, or physics-aware generation. However, generated scenarios may still exhibit low AC feasibility and robustness, limiting their practical value for downstream power-system studies. This paper proposes a feasibility-aware distribution-learning framework that learns the AC-operable joint distribution of network topology, branch electrical parameters, and time-varying load profiles. Instead of enforcing feasibility after generation, the proposed framework incorporates AC power-flow convergence and operational constraints into hierarchical diffusion-based distribution learning. This enables the generator itself to produce operationally feasible grid scenarios through efficient diffusion sampling. The hierarchical architecture decomposes the high-dimensional generation task into three engineering-motivated stages: topology and bus-attribute generation, branch-parameter generation conditioned on the generated structure, and load-profile generation conditioned on both network structure and electrical characteristics. Experiments on benchmark systems demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly improves operational feasibility and contingency robustness while maintaining strong statistical fidelity and eliminating optimization-based post-processing.

AI.title_translation: 学习交流可操作联合分布的运行可行合成电网场景
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可行性感知分布学习框架，通过在生成过程中嵌入交流潮流收敛和运行约束，直接生成运行可行的合成电网场景，显著提高了可行性和鲁棒性，并消除了后处理需求。
AI.motivation: 合成电网场景对于电力系统规划、韧性评估、事故分析和数据驱动应用至关重要。现有方法生成的场景在交流可行性和鲁棒性方面表现不足，限制了其实用价值。
AI.method: 本文提出一个可行性感知分布学习框架，该框架学习网络拓扑、支路电气参数和时变负荷曲线的交流可操作联合分布。它将交流潮流收敛和运行约束纳入分层扩散式分布学习中，使生成器能够直接产生运行可行的电网场景。分层架构包括三个阶段：拓扑和母线属性生成、条件于生成结构的支路参数生成、以及条件于网络结构和电气特性的负荷曲线生成。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提出的框架显著提高了运行可行性和事故鲁棒性，同时保持了强大的统计保真度，并消除了基于优化的后处理。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习交流可操作的联合分布并将交流潮流收敛和运行约束直接整合到分层扩散式生成过程中，可以高效生成运行可行且具有良好事故鲁棒性的合成电网场景，解决了现有方法在可行性和鲁棒性上的不足。
AI.translation: 合成电网场景对于规划、韧性评估、事故分析和数据驱动的电力系统应用至关重要。最近的合成电网生成方法通过在生成后验证、优化或物理感知生成中融入工程知识，提高了结构真实性和运行可行性。然而，生成的场景可能仍然表现出较低的交流可行性和鲁棒性，限制了它们在下游电力系统研究中的实用价值。本文提出一个可行性感知分布学习框架，该框架学习网络拓扑、支路电气参数和时变负荷曲线的交流可操作联合分布。与在生成后强制执行可行性不同，所提出的框架将交流潮流收敛和运行约束纳入分层扩散式分布学习中。这使得生成器本身能够通过高效的扩散采样产生运行可行的电网场景。分层架构将高维生成任务分解为三个工程驱动的阶段：拓扑和母线属性生成、条件于生成结构的支路参数生成，以及条件于网络结构和电气特性的负荷曲线生成。在基准系统上的实验表明，所提出的框架显著提高了运行可行性和事故鲁棒性，同时保持了强大的统计保真度，并消除了基于优化的后处理。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种可行性感知分布学习框架，通过学习网络拓扑、支路电气参数和时变负荷曲线的交流可操作联合分布，并将其交流潮流收敛和运行约束直接整合到分层扩散式生成过程中，从而能够高效生成运行可行且具有良好事故鲁棒性的合成电网场景，克服了现有方法在后期验证或优化中存在的局限性。
AI.keywords: 合成电网场景, 分布学习, 交流可行性, 扩散模型, 电力系统
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将AC潮流收敛和运行约束直接融入到扩散式分布学习框架中，实现了“生成即可行”，避免了传统方法中后处理的复杂性和效率问题。这对于需要大量可靠电网场景的电力系统研究具有重要意义。

title: Evaluating MFU as a Proxy for GPU Power for Energy-Aware Simulation of LLM Training
summary: High-fidelity performance simulators are essential for designing and configuring efficient AI systems, yet today's tools lack the ability to predict power consumption. Established GPU power models rely on hardware utilization counters, which do not exist until the workload has actually run. This work evaluates whether Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU)-an analytical, software-defined metric relating achieved throughput to peak hardware capability-can serve as a portable, software-defined predictor of GPU power for LLMs. We benchmark almost 3000 single-device training runs across six GPUs, covering different model families, numerical precisions, batch sizes, and context-window lengths. We find that a linear MFU-based power model fits every tested GPU as long as the workload is compute-bound, as in production LLM training. Fitting per-(GPU, dtype, batch size) instead of per-GPU drops the within-cell mean error from around 10% to around 1%, matching the cross-repeat measurement-noise floor.

title: MultiGlobeQA: A Multilingual and Globally Diverse Benchmark for Geospatial Reasoning
summary: Geospatial reasoning, i.e., computing distances, containment, and other spatial relations over real-world entities, is central to navigation and logistics, yet large language models (LLMs) struggle with the required geometric and topological computation despite storing considerable geographic knowledge. Existing benchmarks localize these failures only partially: they are synthetic or smallscale, largely monolingual, and offer limited control over geographic coverage. We introduce MultiGlobeQA, a multilingual benchmark of 46,060 question-answer pairs spanning 14 spatial-function families and 15 answer formats, with execution-based ground truth over three knowledge graphs. It covers 201 countries and territories via income- and density-stratified sampling, with parallel questions in English and 16 additional high- and low-resource languages. Across parametric, reasoning, and agentic settings, LLMs collapse on tasks requiring grid indexing and shape computation, while topological relations and directions fare best. Retrieval and tool use yield considerable gains, yet performance plateaus below two thirds even when gold facts are supplied, indicating that computation, not access to knowledge, is the bottleneck. Models also underperform on low-income regions, a gap that gold facts widen rather than close.

AI.title_translation: 多区域QA：一个用于地理空间推理的多语言和全球多样化基准
AI.tldr: 现有的地理空间推理基准存在局限性，因此我们提出了MultiGlobeQA，一个包含46,060个问答对的多语言基准，涵盖14个空间函数族和15种答案格式，并对201个国家和地区进行了抽样。该基准包含英语和16种其他语言的并行问题。结果显示，大型语言模型在网格索引和形状计算等任务上表现不佳，而在拓扑关系和方向方面表现较好。检索和工具使用有所帮助，但性能仍然受限，表明瓶颈在于计算而非知识获取。此外，模型在低收入地区表现较差，而且提供事实信息反而会扩大这种差距。
AI.motivation: 现有的地理空间推理基准在评估大型语言模型（LLMs）方面存在不足，因为它们通常是合成的、小规模的、单一语言的，并且地理覆盖范围有限，无法全面捕捉LLMs在地理空间推理方面的能力。因此，需要一个更全面、更多样化的基准来准确评估LLMs在真实世界地理空间推理任务中的表现。
AI.method: 提出MultiGlobeQA，一个包含46,060个问答对的多语言基准。该基准涵盖14个空间函数族和15种答案格式，并使用三个知识图谱进行基于执行的地面真实性验证。通过对201个国家和地区进行收入和密度分层抽样，确保了地理多样性。同时，提供英语和16种其他高低资源语言的并行问题。
AI.result: 在参数化、推理和agentic设置下，大型语言模型在需要网格索引和形状计算的任务上表现不佳，而在处理拓扑关系和方向方面表现最好。检索和工具使用显著提高了性能，但即使提供黄金事实，性能也无法超过三分之二，这表明计算能力而非知识获取是瓶颈。此外，模型在低收入地区表现不佳，而提供黄金事实反而会扩大这种差距。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型在地理空间推理方面存在显著挑战，尤其是在处理网格索引和形状计算等复杂几何和拓扑任务时。虽然检索和工具使用可以提升性能，但计算能力的限制仍然是主要瓶颈。此外，模型在低收入地区表现出的性能差距以及提供事实信息后差距的扩大，凸显了公平性和对不同地区地理知识处理能力的进一步研究的必要性。
AI.translation: 地理空间推理，即在真实世界实体上计算距离、包含关系和其他空间关系，对于导航和物流至关重要。然而，尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）存储了大量的地理知识，但在所需的几何和拓扑计算方面却表现不佳。现有的基准仅部分地指出了这些失败：它们是合成的或小规模的，主要是单一语言的，并且对地理覆盖范围的控制有限。我们引入了MultiGlobeQA，一个多语言基准，包含46,060个问答对，涵盖14个空间函数族和15种答案格式，并在三个知识图谱上进行了基于执行的地面真实性验证。通过对201个国家和地区的收入和密度分层抽样，该基准覆盖了这些地区，并提供英语和16种其他高低资源语言的并行问题。在参数化、推理和agentic设置下，LLMs在需要网格索引和形状计算的任务上表现不佳，而拓扑关系和方向则表现最好。检索和工具使用带来了显著的改进，但即使提供了黄金事实，性能也无法达到三分之二，这表明计算而非知识获取是瓶颈。模型在低收入地区也表现不佳，而黄金事实反而会扩大而非缩小这种差距。
AI.summary: MultiGlobeQA是一个新提出的多语言基准，旨在解决现有地理空间推理评估的局限性。该基准包含超过46,000个问答对，覆盖广泛的空间功能和地理区域，并提供多种语言的支持。实验表明，大型语言模型在处理复杂的几何和拓扑推理任务时面临挑战，而检索和工具使用可以缓解部分问题，但计算能力仍然是关键瓶颈。此外，模型在低收入地区表现出的性能差异值得关注。
AI.keywords: 地理空间推理, 大型语言模型, 多语言基准, 几何计算, 拓扑关系
AI.comments: 该研究提出MultiGlobeQA基准，有效地解决了现有地理空间推理评估的局限性，通过其多语言、全球多样性和大规模的特点，为评估大型语言模型在这一领域的表现提供了坚实的基础。研究结果揭示了LLMs在几何和拓扑计算方面的固有挑战，并强调了计算能力而非知识获取是关键瓶颈，这一点具有重要的理论和实践意义。此外，模型在低收入地区表现出的性能差距及其在提供事实信息后被放大的现象，突显了公平性问题，并为未来研究指明了方向。然而，该基准的构建和评估过程可能涉及大量的人工和计算资源，未来可以探索更高效的基准构建和评估方法。

title: DS@GT-ARC at eRisk 2026 Task 3: Sparse, Semantic, and LLM Reranking for ADHD Symptom Sentences
summary: This paper describes our submissions to eRisk 2026 Task 3, ADHD Symptom Sentence Ranking. The task requires systems to rank candidate Reddit sentences according to their relevance to each of the 18 symptoms in the Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale (ASRS-v1.1). Because no annotated training data were released for this first edition of the task, we relied on zero-shot experimentation, manual validation, and unsupervised or weakly guided retrieval pipelines. Our systems combine sparse BM25 retrieval, evidence-aware rescoring for self-referential symptom reports, embedding-based reranking, query-prototype expansion, and LLM-based reranking. All submitted systems follow a staged retrieval design in which BM25 retrieves candidates at scale and semantic or LLM rerankers refine the final rankings. Among our submissions, the LLM reranker achieved the strongest official scores, followed by the prototype query-expansion run. Our manual top-10 analysis aligned with the official expert scoring trend, suggesting that staged reranking is a promising direction for further development.

AI.title_translation: DS@GT-ARC 在 eRisk 2026 任务 3：ADHD 症状句子的稀疏、语义和 LLM 重排
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个多阶段的 ADHD 症状句子排序系统，结合了 BM25、语义和 LLM 重排技术，在没有训练数据的情况下取得了良好的效果，其中 LLM 重排表现最佳。
AI.motivation: eRisk 2026 任务 3 要求对与 18 种 ASRS 成人 ADHD 自评量表症状相关的 Reddit 句子进行排序，但任务初期未提供标注训练数据。
AI.method: 该研究结合了稀疏 BM25 检索、基于证据的重评分、基于嵌入的重排、查询原型扩展以及基于 LLM 的重排。系统采用分阶段检索设计，首先用 BM25 大规模检索候选句子，然后用语义或 LLM 重排器优化最终排名。
AI.result: 在 eRisk 2026 任务 3 中，LLM 重排系统取得了最好的官方分数，其次是原型查询扩展运行。人工对排名前 10 的分析与官方专家评分趋势一致。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段重排是 ADHD 症状句子排序的一个有前景的研究方向。
AI.translation: 本文描述了我们向 eRisk 2026 任务 3（ADHD 症状句子排序）提交的系统。该任务要求系统根据候选 Reddit 句子与成人 ADHD 自评量表 (ASRS-v1.1) 中 18 种症状的相关性进行排序。由于该任务的第一版没有发布标注训练数据，我们依赖于零样本实验、人工验证以及无监督或弱指导的检索流程。我们的系统结合了稀疏 BM25 检索、基于证据的重评分（针对自我指涉的症状报告）、基于嵌入的重排、查询原型扩展以及基于 LLM 的重排。所有提交的系统都遵循分阶段检索设计，其中 BM25 大规模检索候选句子，然后由语义或 LLM 重排器优化最终排名。在我们提交的系统中，LLM 重排器取得了最好的官方分数，其次是原型查询扩展运行。我们的人工前 10 名分析与官方专家评分趋势一致，表明分阶段重排是未来发展的一个有前景的方向。
AI.summary: 该研究介绍了 DS@GT-ARC 团队在 eRisk 2026 任务 3（ADHD 症状句子排序）中的系统。面对缺乏训练数据的情况，研究人员采用了零样本学习方法，并结合了 BM25 检索、语义分析和大型语言模型（LLM）重排等技术。系统采用分阶段检索策略，先用 BM25 进行初步筛选，再用更复杂的模型进行精细排序。结果表明，LLM 重排方法效果最佳，验证了分阶段重排在处理此类任务中的潜力。
AI.keywords: ADHD 症状排序, eRisk 2026, BM25, LLM 重排, 分阶段检索
AI.comments: 该研究在缺乏标注数据的情况下，通过结合多种检索和重排技术（包括 LLM），有效地解决了 ADHD 症状句子排序问题。分阶段检索的设计思路值得肯定，尤其是在大规模数据处理方面。然而，关于人工验证和弱指导检索的具体细节可以进一步阐述，以评估其对最终性能的贡献程度。

title: BanglaWild: An In-the-Wild Bengali Scene Text Recognition Benchmark for OCR and Vision-Language Models
summary: In-the-wild Bengali scene text recognition is largely unmeasured: existing resources target handwritten documents or constrained sign-board parsing, report only aggregate edit-distance metrics, and evaluate either conventional OCR or VLMs, never both on the same in-the-wild data. To address this gap, we introduce BANGLAWILD, a benchmark of 2,535 Bengali scene text images, each paired with a verbatim gold transcription, two categorical axes, four diagnostic attributes, and an orthographically standard form where the in-image text deviates from canonical spelling. We evaluate fifteen VLMs and three conventional OCR systems under three prompting strategies, fine-tune 6 open-source models with LoRA, and complement edit-distance metrics with an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation. Our results reveal a persistent gap in which larger models within the same family do not outperform smaller ones. Our fifteen-class error taxonomy shows that visual mis-recognition accounts for ~60% of errors in the strongest systems, while conjunct-related errors contribute under 2%, challenging a long-standing assumption in Bengali OCR research; the same visual dominant profile also holds across architectures, including the one conventional baseline that reads Bengali reliably. Prompt language mainly affects cross-script drift and LoRA reduces catastrophic failures in weak models without lifting the ceiling on already competent ones. Code and data will be publicly released.

AI.title_translation: BanglaWild：一个用于OCR和视觉语言模型的孟加拉语野外场景文本识别基准
AI.tldr: BANGLAWILD是一个新的孟加拉语野外场景文本识别基准，用于评估OCR和VLMs。研究发现，大型模型不一定优于小型模型，视觉误识别是主要错误来源，并挑战了孟加拉语OCR中关于连字错误的主导假设。
AI.motivation: 现有的孟加拉语场景文本识别资源针对手写文档或受限的标牌解析，仅报告聚合编辑距离指标，且只评估传统OCR或VLMs，从未在相同的野外数据上同时评估两者。为解决这一空白，本文引入了BANGLAWILD。
AI.method: 本文引入了BANGLAWILD，一个包含2,535张孟加拉语场景文本图像的基准，每张图像都配有逐字转录、两个分类轴、四个诊断属性以及正字法标准形式。评估了15个VLMs和3个传统OCR系统，采用三种提示策略，并使用LoRA微调了6个开源模型。除了编辑距离指标外，还辅以LLM-as-a-Judge评估。
AI.result: 研究发现，同一系列中较大的模型并不优于较小的模型。十五类错误分类显示，在最强的系统中，视觉误识别占约60%的错误，而连字相关错误贡献不到2%，这挑战了孟加拉语OCR研究中长期存在的假设；同样的视觉主导特征也适用于各种架构。提示语言主要影响跨脚本漂移，LoRA减少了弱模型中的灾难性故障，但并未提升已具备能力的模型的上限。
AI.conclusion: 大型模型在孟加拉语野外场景文本识别中并不总是优于小型模型，视觉误识别是主要错误来源，而非连字错误。新基准和评估方法揭示了当前模型能力的局限性，并为未来研究提供了方向。
AI.translation: 野外孟加拉语场景文本识别在很大程度上尚未被衡量：现有资源针对手写文档或受限的标牌解析，仅报告聚合编辑距离指标，并且只评估传统OCR或视觉语言模型（VLMs），从未在相同的野外数据上同时评估两者。为了解决这一空白，我们引入了BANGLAWILD，一个包含2,535张孟加拉语场景文本图像的基准，每张图像都配有逐字黄金转录、两个分类轴、四个诊断属性以及当图像内文本偏离规范拼写时的正字法标准形式。我们评估了15个VLMs和3个传统OCR系统，采用三种提示策略，并使用LoRA微调了6个开源模型，同时辅以LLM-as-a-Judge评估来补充编辑距离指标。我们的结果揭示了一个持续存在的差距，即同一系列中较大的模型并未超越较小的模型。我们的十五类错误分类表明，在最强的系统中，视觉误识别占约60%的错误，而连字相关错误贡献不到2%，这挑战了孟加拉语OCR研究中一个长期存在的假设；同样的视觉主导特征也适用于各种架构，包括唯一一个能可靠识别孟加拉语的传统基线。提示语言主要影响跨脚本漂移，而LoRA减少了弱模型中的灾难性故障，但并未提升已具备能力的模型的上限。代码和数据将公开发布。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了BANGLAWILD，一个针对孟加拉语野外场景文本识别的新基准，旨在弥补现有资源在评估OCR和VLMs方面的不足。该基准包含2,535张图像，并提供了详细的标注和属性。研究评估了多种VLMs和传统OCR系统，发现大型模型不一定表现更优，且视觉误识别是主要的错误来源（约60%），而非此前认为的连字错误。LoRA对弱模型有益，但对强模型提升不大。该工作挑战了孟加拉语OCR研究中的一些传统假设，并提供了新的洞察。
AI.keywords: 孟加拉语场景文本识别, BanglaWild, OCR, 视觉语言模型, 基准
AI.comments: 这项研究通过引入BANGLAWILD基准，填补了孟加拉语野外场景文本识别领域的重要空白。其创新之处在于首次在同一野外数据集上同时评估OCR和VLMs，并引入了LLM-as-a-Judge评估方法。研究结果尤其重要，因为它挑战了孟加拉语OCR中关于连字错误的主导假设，指出视觉误识别才是主要挑战。这一发现对于未来孟加拉语OCR模型的设计和优化具有指导意义。该基准的发布将极大地推动该领域的研究进展。

title: MuRA: Multi-Rank Adaptation for Efficient and Effective Test-Time Vision-Language Generalization
summary: Vision-language models exhibit remarkable zero-shot capabilities but suffer significant performance degradation under distribution shifts. While test-time adaptation (TTA) via Low-Rank Adaptation offers a parameter-efficient solution, we identify a fundamental bottleneck in current methods: the reliance on static rank configurations. Because visual inputs inherently possess varying information densities, a fixed rank forces an inevitable optimization compromise, leading to underfitting on complex scenes and overfitting on simple ones. To bridge this gap, we propose Multi-Rank Adaptation (MuRA), a novel framework that dynamically selects and fuses adaptation modules of varying capacities based on token-level visual complexity. MuRA synergizes Multi-Rank Orthogonal Decomposition to provide a superior, knowledge-preserving initialization, and Unified Component Fusion with Continuous Router Updating to sustainably learn semantic-to-rank mappings. Furthermore, we provide rigorous theoretical justifications mathematically proving the necessity and gradient stability of this adaptive mechanism. Crucially, MuRA's dynamic design uniquely thrives at the deepest visual layer, capitalizing on the shortest gradient backpropagation path. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MuRA achieves state-of-the-art accuracy across extensive domain generalization and cross-dataset benchmarks while significantly reducing both computational and memory overhead.

AI.title_translation: MuRA：一种用于高效有效测试时视觉-语言泛化的多秩适应方法
AI.tldr: 当前测试时适应（TTA）方法依赖于静态秩配置，在视觉信息密度变化时会导致优化折衷。MuRA提出了一种新颖的框架，根据令牌级别的视觉复杂性动态选择和融合不同容量的适应模块，以实现更优的泛化能力并降低计算和内存开销。
AI.motivation: 当前测试时适应（TTA）方法依赖于静态秩配置，在视觉输入信息密度变化时会导致优化折衷，从而在复杂场景下欠拟合，在简单场景下过拟合。
AI.method: MuRA框架通过多秩正交分解提供知识保持初始化，并结合统一组件融合和连续路由器更新，以可持续地学习语义到秩的映射。它根据令牌级别的视觉复杂性动态选择和融合不同容量的适应模块。
AI.result: MuRA在广泛的领域泛化和跨数据集基准测试中实现了最先进的准确性，同时显著降低了计算和内存开销。
AI.conclusion: MuRA通过动态适应不同视觉复杂性的能力，解决了现有TTA方法的局限性，并在保持高效的同时实现了卓越的性能。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言模型展现出卓越的零样本能力，但在分布偏移下性能会显著下降。虽然通过低秩适应（LoRA）进行的测试时适应（TTA）提供了一种参数高效的解决方案，但我们发现当前方法存在一个根本性的瓶颈：依赖于静态秩配置。由于视觉输入本身具有不同的信息密度，固定的秩会导致不可避免的优化折衷，从而在复杂场景下导致欠拟合，在简单场景下导致过拟合。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了多秩适应（MuRA），一个新颖的框架，它根据令牌级别的视觉复杂性动态地选择和融合不同容量的适应模块。MuRA协同利用多秩正交分解提供了一个更优越的、保留知识的初始化，以及统一组件融合与连续路由器更新，以可持续地学习语义到秩的映射。此外，我们提供了严格的理论依据，在数学上证明了这种自适应机制的必要性和梯度稳定性。至关重要的是，MuRA的动态设计在最深的视觉层独树一帜，利用了最短的梯度反向传播路径。广泛的实验表明，MuRA在广泛的领域泛化和跨数据集基准测试中实现了最先进的准确性，同时显著降低了计算和内存开销。
AI.summary: MuRA是一种新颖的测试时适应（TTA）框架，旨在解决现有方法中静态秩配置导致的性能下降问题。它通过根据视觉输入的局部复杂性动态调整适应模块的容量，实现了更优的泛化能力。该方法结合了多秩正交分解和统一组件融合，并在最深的视觉层进行优化，以最小化计算和内存开销，并在多项基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 测试时适应, 视觉-语言模型, 多秩适应, 动态调整, 领域泛化
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为MuRA的新颖的测试时适应（TTA）框架，解决了现有TTA方法依赖静态秩配置而导致的性能瓶颈。MuRA通过动态地根据视觉输入的局部复杂性选择和融合不同容量的适应模块，实现了更优的泛化能力，并显著降低了计算和内存开销。该方法在理论和实验上都得到了充分的验证，并在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，具有重要的理论和应用价值。

title: Omega-S: A Functional Resilience Index for LLM Fine-Tuning
comments: 15 pages of main text plus appendices; 12 tables. Code, per-seed data and all negative results at https://github.com/BiomeMakers/OmegaS-LLM
summary:
Fine-tuning a large language model on new data degrades what it previously learned. We present Omega-S, a drop-in penalty computed from the weight matrix alone: it needs no previous-task data, no Fisher matrix and no stored copy of the old weights. It is three lines in an existing training loop and adds under 4% to the cost of a step.
  Retention. On Llama-3-8B with LoRA, fine-tuned from code to prose and measured by HumanEval over ten seeds, Omega-S retains more of the original capability than no regularisation on 9 of 10 seeds (0.173 -> 0.238 absolute pass@1; sign test one-sided p=0.011, Wilcoxon p=0.006), as a retention ratio, 62.9% -> 84.1%. It also beats tuned weight decay on 10 of 10 seeds (p=0.002) and tuned EWC on 8 of 10 (p=0.014), every arm re-measured in the same session.
  Mechanism, measured rather than asserted. Omega-S is topological by construction, its objective built from Tr(A^3), but we measured which of its four factors actually moves and three do not: their elasticity with respect to the weights is at or below 1e-4, against 9e-3 for the degree-variance term. As implemented, the composite reduces to a penalty on the variance of node degrees, which means row magnitude in square modules and directional alignment in non-square ones. We report this because a method whose name promises one thing and whose gradient does another should say so. We also enumerate the open design choices, including a contrast-preserving construction that does what it was designed to do and makes retention worse on all ten seeds.
  Repeating an identical configuration, same seed and same hardware, gives a standard deviation of 0.104 in retention ratio. We have not found this quantified for low-rank fine-tuning of language models, and it bounds every seed-paired comparison in this literature, ours included.
  Code, per-seed results and the full record of negative results are available.
comment: 15 pages of main text plus appendices; 12 tables. Code, per-seed data and all negative results at https://github.com/BiomeMakers/OmegaS-LLM

AI.tldr: Omega-S是一种新的、计算成本低的微调方法，它通过惩罚节点度数方差来提高大型语言模型在新数据上训练时的保留能力，并且优于其他正则化方法。
AI.motivation: 在大型语言模型在新数据上进行微调时，会损害其先前学到的知识。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为Omega-S的即插即用惩罚项，该惩罚项仅从权重矩阵计算得出，无需先验任务数据、Fisher矩阵或旧权重的副本。它通过惩罚节点度数的方差来实现，并对训练成本的增加很小。
AI.result: 在Llama-3-8B模型上使用LoRA进行代码到文本的微调时，Omega-S在90%的种子中比不使用正则化更能保留原始能力（通过率从0.173提高到0.238），并优于经过调整的权重衰减和EWC方法。
AI.conclusion: Omega-S是一种有效且计算成本低的方法，可以提高大型语言模型在微调过程中的能力保留率，并且其有效性得到了实验验证。
AI.translation:
微调大型语言模型 على 新数据会损害其先前学到的知识。我们提出了 Omega-S，一种仅从权重矩阵计算得出的即插即用惩罚项：它不需要先前的任务数据、Fisher 矩阵或旧权重的副本。它位于现有训练循环中的三行代码中，并将每步的成本增加了不到 4%。
保留率。在 Llama-3-8B 上使用 LoRA，从代码微调到散文，并通过十个种子的 HumanEval 进行测量，Omega-S 在 10 个种子中的 9 个中比不进行正则化更能保留原始能力（绝对通过率从 0.173 提高到 0.238；单侧符号检验 p=0.011，Wilcoxon p=0.006），作为保留率，从 62.9% 提高到 84.1%。它还在 10 个种子中的 10 个中优于经过调整的权重衰减（p=0.002），在 8 个种子中的 10 个中优于经过调整的 EWC（p=0.014），每个臂都在同一会话中重新测量。
机制，测量而非断言。Omega-S 在构造上是拓扑的，其目标由 Tr(A^3) 构建，但我们测量了它的四个因子中哪些实际移动，哪些则没有：它们相对于权重的弹性在 1e-4 或以下，而度数-方差项为 9e-3。如实现所示，该复合项归结为对节点度数方差的惩罚，这意味着在方块模块中是行幅度，在非方块模块中是方向对齐。我们报告这一点是因为一个名称承诺一件事而梯度做另一件事的方法应该说明这一点。我们还列举了开放的设计选择，包括一个对比保留构造，它完成了其设计目的，但使所有十个种子的保留率都变差。
重复相同的配置、相同的种子和相同的硬件，保留率的标准差为 0.104。我们尚未为语言模型的低秩微调量化这一点，它限制了该文献中我们自己的所有种子对比较。
代码、每个种子的结果和负面结果的完整记录均可用。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种名为 Omega-S 的新方法，用于提高大型语言模型（LLM）微调过程中的能力保留率。Omega-S 是一种计算成本低廉的正则化技术，它通过惩罚权重矩阵中的节点度数方差来实现。实验表明，Omega-S 在 Llama-3-8B 模型上优于现有方法，能够显著提高模型在微调后的性能保留。
AI.keywords: LLM微调,能力保留,Omega-S,正则化,节点度数方差
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖且高效的正则化方法 Omega-S，用于解决 LLM 微调中的灾难性遗忘问题。该方法计算成本低，易于实现，并且在实验中表现出优越的性能。然而，文章也提到了一些未被充分探索的设计选择和负面结果，这为未来的研究提供了方向。

title: CARE-X: Towards Clinically Useful Radiology VLMs with Auxiliary Supervision, Reward-Aligned Learning, and Tool-Augmented Measurement
summary: A clinically useful chest X-ray system must go beyond fluent report generation: it should classify findings with tunable decision thresholds, localize them spatially, and derive the anatomical measurements upon which many diagnoses depend. Today's Vision-Language Models (VLMs) treat these as separate problems, if they address them at all, leaving a gap between what radiologists need and what generative models provide. We introduce CARE-X, a chest X-ray VLM that narrows this gap by unifying auxiliary discriminative supervision with reward-aligned generation. CARE-X augments its generative backbone with focal-loss classification and composite-loss grounding heads, co-trained alongside the language-modeling objective. This auxiliary supervision produces discriminative diagnostic predictions with tunable decision thresholds and precise spatial localization while also improving report quality, providing evidence that structured prediction and generation reinforce one another. Building on this foundation, Decoupled Clip and Dynamic Sampling Policy Optimization (DAPO) leverages task-specific reward signals for report generation, visual question answering (VQA), and spatial grounding, directly optimizing the clinical quality metrics that matter in practice. The result is state-of-the-art performance on the majority of metrics across four report-generation benchmarks, 94.0% VQA accuracy on ReXVQA (+6.0 pp over the next-best baseline), and generative spatial decoding that reaches near parity with dedicated detection heads. Separately, to address measurement-dependent diagnoses, we couple Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct with native tool-calling capabilities for invoking deterministic measurement tools, while retaining full visual access to the image. This hybrid inference yields +43.6 pp average F1 over perception-only baselines across five measurement-dependent conditions.

AI.title_translation: CARE-X：通过辅助监督、奖励对齐学习和工具增强测量技术，构建有临床实用价值的放射学视觉语言模型
AI.tldr: CARE-X是一个改进的胸部X光视觉语言模型，通过结合辅助分类和定位监督、奖励对齐生成以及与测量工具的集成，在报告生成、视觉问答和解剖测量方面取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在处理放射学任务时存在不足，无法满足临床需求，例如可调决策阈值的分类、解剖学测量以及空间定位等，它们将这些视为独立问题，导致生成模型与放射科医生需求之间存在差距。
AI.method: CARE-X通过以下方式改进了胸部X光VLM：1. 结合了辅助判别式监督（如focal loss分类和composite loss定位）与奖励对齐生成。2. 使用DAPO（Decoupled Clip and Dynamic Sampling Policy Optimization）策略来优化报告生成、视觉问答和空间定位。3. 将Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct模型与确定性测量工具的调用能力相结合，以解决依赖测量的诊断问题。
AI.result: CARE-X在四个报告生成基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，在ReXVQA数据集上的视觉问答准确率达到94.0%（比次优基线高6.0个百分点），并且在生成式空间解码方面接近专用检测头的性能。此外，通过与测量工具的集成，在五个依赖测量的诊断任务上的平均F1分数比仅基于感知的基线提高了43.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CARE-X通过整合辅助监督、奖励对齐学习和与测量工具的集成，显著提高了胸部X光视觉语言模型的临床实用性，在报告生成、视觉问答和解剖测量方面均取得了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 一个有临床实用价值的胸部X光系统必须超越流畅的报告生成：它应该能够对病变进行分类（具有可调的决策阈值）、在空间上进行定位，并推导出许多诊断所依赖的解剖学测量。当今的视觉语言模型（VLMs）将这些视为独立的问题，即使它们处理了这些问题，也导致了放射科医生所需与生成模型所能提供的之间存在差距。我们引入了CARE-X，一个胸部X光VLM，它通过结合辅助判别式监督和奖励对齐生成来缩小这一差距。CARE-X通过focal loss分类和composite loss定位头来增强其生成主干，并与语言建模目标共同训练。这种辅助监督产生了具有可调决策阈值和精确空间定位的判别式诊断预测，同时也提高了报告质量，提供了结构化预测和生成相互强化的证据。在此基础上，解耦裁剪和动态采样策略优化（DAPO）利用特定任务的奖励信号来进行报告生成、视觉问答（VQA）和空间定位，直接优化了实际中重要的临床质量指标。其结果是在四个报告生成基准测试中取得了大多数指标的最先进性能，在ReXVQA上的VQA准确率达到94.0%（比次优基线高6.0个百分点），并且生成式空间解码达到了接近专用检测头的性能。另外，为了解决依赖测量的诊断问题，我们将Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct与调用确定性测量工具的原生工具调用能力相结合，同时保留对图像的完全视觉访问。这种混合推理在五个依赖测量的条件下的平均F1分数比仅基于感知的基线高出43.6个百分点。
AI.summary: CARE-X是一个创新的胸部X光视觉语言模型，它通过引入辅助判别式监督（用于分类和定位）以及奖励对齐生成（使用DAPO策略），显著提升了模型在报告生成、视觉问答（VQA）和空间定位任务上的性能。此外，CARE-X还集成了与测量工具的交互能力，以解决依赖解剖学测量的诊断问题，并在多个临床相关任务中取得了最先进的成果。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 胸部X光, 辅助监督, 奖励对齐学习, 解剖测量
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为CARE-X的综合性胸部X光视觉语言模型，有效地解决了现有模型在临床应用中的局限性。通过整合辅助监督学习、奖励对齐生成以及与外部测量工具的交互能力，CARE-X在报告生成、视觉问答和解剖测量等多个关键临床任务上均取得了显著的性能提升，并达到了最先进水平。特别值得注意的是，模型不仅提高了诊断的准确性和定位的精确性，还解决了依赖精确解剖学测量的复杂诊断场景，这对于提高放射学诊断的可靠性和临床实用性具有重要意义。研究方法新颖且有效，为开发更智能、更实用的医学影像分析工具提供了有价值的参考。

title: Intertemporal Preference Steering in Qwen3 via Contrastive Activation Addition
summary: We study linear representations of temporal horizon in the large language model Qwen3-32B and use them to change the model's time-related preferences, recommendations, and capabilities. We train contrastive linear probes on teacher-forced temporal-choice answers to find a short-term versus long-term direction in the model's residual stream, and evaluate contrastive activation-addition steering on a held-out binary temporal-choice task, an out-of-distribution monetary intertemporal-choice task, and a TravelPlanner capability benchmark. The central result is that temporal-horizon directions can be identified with simple contrastive linear probes and then used for steering to induce large, bidirectional preference changes. On an out-of-distribution monetary choice task that varies reward size and delay, steering strongly shifts the model's indifference threshold between smaller-sooner and larger-later rewards in both directions. We further show improvements on a planning-related capability metric under moderate temporal steering. These results suggest that model intertemporal preferences are measurable and steerable, which is relevant for AI systems that give advice involving delayed costs and benefits, and for safety questions about long-horizon planning.

AI.title_translation: Qwen3通过对比激活加法进行跨期偏好引导
AI.tldr: 研究人员发现，可以通过识别和操纵大型语言模型Qwen3中的时间地平线方向来引导其跨期偏好，从而在不同任务中产生显著且可控的偏好变化。
AI.motivation: 研究大型语言模型（LLM）中的时间偏好，以及如何操纵这些偏好以用于有益目的，例如在AI系统中提供涉及延迟成本和收益的建议，以及解决有关长期规划的AI安全问题。
AI.method: 训练对比线性探针来识别Qwen3模型残差流中的短期与长期方向，并使用对比激活加法引导技术来操纵这些方向，以改变模型的跨期偏好。
AI.result: 成功识别出时间地平线方向，并能通过激活加法引导在金钱跨期选择任务中（即使在分布外）以及规划能力基准测试中诱导显著的双向偏好变化，显著改变了模型在“小额-即时”奖励和“大额-延迟”奖励之间的无差异阈值。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型中的跨期偏好是可测量的，并且可以通过识别出的时间地平线方向进行引导，这对于需要进行跨期权衡的AI应用和AI安全至关重要。
AI.translation: 我们研究了大型语言模型Qwen3-32B中时间地平线的线性表征，并利用它们来改变模型与时间相关的偏好、推荐和能力。我们训练了对比线性探针，用于处理教师强制的时间选择答案，以在模型的残差流中找到短期与长期方向，并在一个独立的二元时间选择任务、一个分布外的货币跨期选择任务和一个TravelPlanner能力基准测试上评估了对比激活加法引导。核心结果是，可以通过简单的对比线性探针识别出时间地平线方向，并用于引导以诱导大的、双向的偏好变化。在一个改变奖励大小和延迟的分布外货币选择任务上，引导在两个方向上都强烈地转移了模型在“小额-即时”奖励和“大额-延迟”奖励之间的无差异阈值。我们进一步表明，在适度的 temporal steering 下，规划相关能力指标有所改善。这些结果表明，模型的跨期偏好是可测量的并且是可引导的，这对于涉及延迟成本和收益的建议AI系统以及关于长期规划的安全问题具有相关性。
AI.summary: 本研究探索了在Qwen3大型语言模型中引导跨期偏好的方法。通过训练对比线性探针来识别模型残差流中的时间地平线方向，并利用对比激活加法技术进行引导。实验结果表明，该方法能够显著且双向地改变模型在跨期选择任务（包括分布外任务）中的偏好，并能改进规划能力。这证明了LLM的跨期偏好是可测量和可控的，对于AI建议和长期规划安全具有重要意义。
AI.keywords: 跨期偏好,Qwen3,对比激活加法,时间地平线方向,模型引导
AI.comments: 这项研究为理解和控制大型语言模型中的时间偏好提供了一个重要的方法。通过识别和操纵“时间地平线方向”，研究人员不仅能够测量模型的偏好，还能对其进行引导，这在需要进行跨期权衡的应用中具有巨大潜力。然而，研究的局限性在于其主要集中在Qwen3模型上，并且“对比激活加法”的具体机制和可扩展性仍需进一步探讨。未来的工作可以探索该方法在更多模型和更复杂的跨期决策场景中的应用。

title: Cross-Model KV Cache Transfer in LLM Families: A Closed-Form Linear Mapping for Prefill Reuse
summary: Production deployments often swap between different-sized models in a family for cost-quality cascading, mid-conversation switching, and routing, and each swap forces the receiver to repay the prefill from scratch. We propose cross-model KV cache transfer, where the receiver reuses the source's KV cache, skipping prefill. We find that cross-model KV has substantial linear structure across matched-KV pairs, where source and target share KV head count and per-head dimension. On Qwen3 14B->32B, one source layer explains 56% of variance in the target's keys and 32% in values, rising to 79% and 65% with multiple source layers. Building on this, we design a closed-form ridge mapper that operates per head and proceeds in three steps. First, for each target layer we select the top-k most predictive source layers and concatenate their KV as input. Second, we strip RoPE from the keys before mapping, so the fit is position-free and reusable across context lengths. Third, we fit ridge regression on a small calibration set of 500 FineWeb-Edu sequences of 1,024 tokens each. Surprisingly, across six pairs in three families, this linear mapper retains 73-98% of the receiver's standalone-prefill accuracy on four pairs, while two degrade sharply. A nonlinear MLP recovers up to +37 pp HellaSwag retention on the failures. The mapper runs 2.7-25x faster than re-prefill and remains stable across multi-turn handoff, making cross-model KV cache transfer practical.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型家族中的跨模型KV缓存迁移：用于预填充重用的闭式线性映射
AI.tldr: 在生产环境中，模型切换会导致预填充成本。本文提出了一种跨模型KV缓存迁移方法，通过线性映射重用源模型的KV缓存，避免从头开始预填充。该方法在多个模型家族上进行了验证，并在大多数情况下保留了较高的准确性，同时显著提高了效率。
AI.motivation: 在生产环境中，由于成本-质量级联、对话中切换和路由等原因，经常需要在同一模型家族的不同大小的模型之间进行切换。每次切换都会迫使接收模型从头开始进行预填充，造成计算资源浪费。
AI.method: 提出了一种跨模型KV缓存迁移方法。该方法利用了模型之间KV缓存的线性结构。具体来说，设计了一个闭式的岭回归映射器，该映射器对每个KV头进行操作，并分三步进行：1. 为每个目标层选择k个最具预测性的源层KV作为输入。2. 在映射前去除Keys的RoPE（旋转位置编码），以实现位置无关性和跨上下文长度的可重用性。3. 在一小组校准数据上拟合岭回归模型。
AI.result: 该线性映射器在六个模型对（三个模型家族）上进行了测试，保留了接收模型独立预填充准确率的73-98%，尽管在两个模型对上准确率有所下降。通过使用非线性MLP，在失败的模型对上可以将HellaSwag的保留率提高多达37个百分点。该映射器比重新预填充快2.7-25倍，并且在多轮切换中保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型KV缓存迁移通过利用KV缓存的线性结构，并使用闭式线性映射器，可以有效地重用预填充信息，从而显著提高效率并降低计算成本。虽然在某些情况下准确率可能下降，但可以通过非线性模型进行弥补。该方法在实际应用中具有可行性。
AI.translation: 生产部署通常在不同大小的模型之间进行切换，以实现成本-质量级联、对话中切换和路由，而每次切换都会迫使接收方从头开始进行预填充。我们提出跨模型KV缓存迁移，其中接收方可以重用源模型的KV缓存，跳过预填充。我们发现，跨模型的KV缓存具有显著的线性结构，匹配的KV对共享KV头计数和每头维度。在Qwen3 14B->32B上，一个源层可以解释目标层Keys中56%的方差和Values中32%的方差，使用多个源层时，这一比例分别上升到79%和65%。在此基础上，我们设计了一个闭式的岭回归映射器，该映射器对每个头进行操作，并分三步进行。首先，对于每个目标层，我们选择k个最具预测性的源层，并将它们的KV连接作为输入。其次，在映射前剥离Keys的RoPE，使拟合具有位置无关性，可跨上下文长度重用。第三，我们在一个包含500个长度为1024个token的FineWeb-Edu序列的小型校准集上拟合岭回归。令人惊讶的是，在三个模型家族的六个模型对上，该线性映射器在四个模型对上保留了接收方独立预填充准确率的73-98%，而在另外两个模型对上准确率急剧下降。非线性MLP在失败的情况下可以将HellaSwag的保留率提高多达37个百分点。该映射器比重新预填充快2.7-25倍，并且在多轮切换中保持稳定，使得跨模型KV缓存迁移具有实际意义。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种跨模型KV缓存迁移技术，旨在解决大型语言模型（LLM）在生产环境中频繁切换模型时产生的预填充成本问题。研究发现，不同大小模型间的KV缓存（特别是Keys和Values）存在显著的线性关系。基于此，研究者设计了一个闭式的岭回归映射器，通过选择预测性强的源层KV，去除位置编码，并在少量数据上进行校准，实现了KV缓存的跨模型迁移。实验结果表明，该方法在大多数模型对上能保留高达98%的独立预填充准确率，并且计算效率远超重新预填充。对于准确率下降的情况，引入非线性MLP可以有效恢复性能。该技术显著提高了模型切换的效率和实用性。
AI.keywords: KV缓存迁移, 线性映射, 预填充重用, 大型语言模型, 效率优化
AI.comments: 这项研究解决了大型语言模型在实际应用中一个关键的效率瓶颈。通过发现并利用KV缓存之间的线性结构，提出了一种创新的迁移方法，大大减少了模型切换时的计算开销。闭式线性映射器的设计简洁高效，并且在实验中取得了令人鼓舞的结果。然而，对于准确率下降的模型对，需要进一步研究其根本原因，并探索更鲁棒的映射方法，例如文中提到的非线性MLP，这可能为未来的研究提供了方向。总体而言，这项工作对于优化LLM的部署和降低成本具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: NCGR: Noise-Conditional Gated Rectification for Camera Extrinsic Perturbations in BEV 3D Object Detection
summary: Camera-based bird's-eye-view (BEV) 3D detection typically assumes accurate and fixed camera extrinsics. In detectors using spatial cross-attention (SCA), extrinsic perturbations displace the image-plane projections of BEV reference points, causing queries to sample features from incorrect regions and degrading detection performance. To address this failure mode, Noise-Conditional Gated Rectification (NCGR) is proposed to compensate for projection errors without explicitly estimating a full six-degree-of-freedom extrinsic correction. For each query-camera pair, a 2D rectification offset is predicted and modulated by a camera-level gate to rectify the base projection before native deformable sampling. During training, the perturbation-derived quantities used to construct the condition and gate are gradually replaced through scheduled interpolation by counterparts generated from an auxiliary scalar predicted from camera features. This transition enables blind inference without perturbation metadata. During training, a weight-shared clean-teacher/perturbed-student pair is used, and the rectification module is supervised by a BEV-consistency objective between the two branches. NCGR is evaluated on nuScenes with simulated dynamic and static extrinsic perturbations. In a five-camera dynamic stress test, NCGR achieves 39.69% NDS, compared with 28.00% for BEVFormer and 33.23% for CAPE. Under clean extrinsics, NCGR maintains performance comparable to that of BEVFormer.

title: Structured-Sparsity-Aware Joint User Activity Detection and Channel Estimation for OTFS-Based Grant-Free Random Access
comments: 6 pages, 4 figures, accepted by IEEE PIMRC 2026
summary: Grant-free random access (GFRA) is a promising solution for massive machine-type communications (mMTC) in future wireless networks. However, reliable user activity detection and channel estimation are critical challenges, particularly when orthogonal time-frequency space (OTFS) modulation is integrated with GFRA to address doubly selective channels induced by high mobility. In this paper, we propose an OTFS-based GFRA framework that exploits the inherent structured sparsity of delay-Doppler channels. By adopting a basis expansion model (BEM), we formulate joint user activity detection and channel estimation as a structured compressive sensing problem. A bi-level sparsity structure is identified, consisting of common sparsity across multiple receive antennas and activation sparsity across mMTC users. To effectively leverage this structure, we construct a two-layer factor graph and develop a structured sparsity expectation propagation (SS-EP) algorithm for efficient Bayesian inference. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme significantly outperforms existing benchmarks.
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, accepted by IEEE PIMRC 2026

AI.title_translation: 基于OTFS的结构化稀疏感知联合用户活动检测与信道估计的无主授权随机接入
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于OTFS的无主授权随机接入框架，利用双层稀疏结构（多天线公共稀疏性和用户激活稀疏性）来解决用户活动检测和信道估计的挑战，并提出了一种名为SS-EP的算法进行贝叶斯推断，仿真结果表明该方法优于现有基准。
AI.motivation: 在未来的无线网络中，大规模机器类通信（mMTC）需要一种有前景的无主授权随机接入（GFRA）方案。然而，当OTFS调制与GFRA结合以应对高移动性引起的双选择性信道时，可靠的用户活动检测和信道估计是一个关键的挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于OTFS的GFRA框架，利用延迟-多普勒信道的固有结构稀疏性。通过采用基扩展模型（BEM），将联合用户活动检测和信道估计的问题构建为一个结构化压缩感知问题。识别出一种双层稀疏结构，包括跨多个接收天线的公共稀疏性和跨mMTC用户的激活稀疏性。为了有效利用这种结构，构建了一个两层因子图，并开发了一种结构化稀疏期望传播（SS-EP）算法来进行高效的贝叶斯推断。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的方案显著优于现有的基准方案。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种新颖的OTFS-GFRA框架，通过利用结构化稀疏性并采用SS-EP算法，有效地解决了用户活动检测和信道估计的挑战，并在仿真中取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.translation: 无主授权随机接入（GFRA）是未来无线网络中大规模机器类通信（mMTC）的有前景的解决方案。然而，可靠的用户活动检测和信道估计是关键的挑战，特别是当正交时频空间（OTFS）调制与GFRA集成以解决由高移动性引起的双选择性信道时。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于OTFS的GFRA框架，该框架利用延迟-多普勒信道的固有结构稀疏性。通过采用基扩展模型（BEM），我们将联合用户活动检测和信道估计的问题制定为一个结构化压缩感知问题。我们识别出一种双层稀疏结构，包括跨多个接收天线的公共稀疏性以及跨mMTC用户的激活稀疏性。为了有效利用这种结构，我们构建了一个两层因子图，并开发了一种结构化稀疏期望传播（SS-EP）算法来进行高效的贝叶斯推断。仿真结果表明，所提出的方案显著优于现有的基准。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种创新的OTFS-GFRA框架，通过利用延迟-多普勒信道的结构稀疏性，将联合用户活动检测和信道估计问题建模为结构化压缩感知问题。该方法识别并利用了跨天线和跨用户的双层稀疏性，并开发了一种名为SS-EP的算法来实现高效的贝叶斯推断。仿真结果表明，该方法在性能上优于现有技术。
AI.keywords: OTFS, GFRA, 用户活动检测, 信道估计, 结构化稀疏性
AI.comments: 该研究在OTFS-GFRA框架下，巧妙地利用了延迟-多普勒信道的结构稀疏性，并提出了一种新颖的SS-EP算法来解决用户活动检测和信道估计的挑战。该方法在理论和仿真层面都展现了优越性，为未来无线通信中的mMTC场景提供了有价值的解决方案。然而，算法的计算复杂度以及在真实复杂环境下的鲁棒性有待进一步研究。

title: ANNOTARES: A Dataset for Extracting Logical Structures from German Statutory Texts
summary: The automatic structural analysis of legal texts is a cornerstone of legal technology, yet the extraction of their logical components remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we introduce the task of identifying and segmenting legal conditions (Tatbestand) and legal consequences (Rechtsfolge) within German statutory texts. To support this task, we present ANNOTARES (Annotations of Tatbestand-Rechtsfolge Sequences), a novel dataset comprising German law texts with span-level annotations. Spanning three distinct legal codes, the dataset is designed to evaluate both domain-specific performance and cross-statute generalizability. We benchmark diverse architectural approaches: a rule-based baseline, CRFs, BiLSTMs, BiLSTM-CRF, and modern Transformer-based models, including BERT variants and LLM-based methods. Our results demonstrate that BERT and LLM-based models achieve superior performance in capturing the complex syntactic structures of legal language. We release our dataset to facilitate further research in automated legal reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 德语法定文本逻辑结构提取数据集ANNOTARES
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了ANNOTARES数据集，用于从德语法律文本中提取法律条件和法律后果，并评估了多种模型在该任务上的表现，发现基于Transformer的模型效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 自动分析法律文本的结构，特别是提取其逻辑组成部分（法律条件和法律后果），在法律技术领域仍然是一个重大挑战。
AI.method: 提出了ANNOTARES数据集，包含跨越三个不同法律法规的德语法律文本，并进行了跨度级别的标注。评估了包括规则基线、CRF、BiLSTM、BiLSTM-CRF以及BERT和LLM在内的Transformer模型。
AI.result: 基于BERT和LLM的模型在捕捉法律语言复杂的句法结构方面取得了优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: ANNOTARES数据集为法律文本逻辑结构提取任务提供了支持，基于BERT和LLM的模型在该任务上表现出巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 自动分析法律文本的结构是法律技术的一个基石，但提取其逻辑组成部分仍然是一个重大的挑战。在本研究中，我们提出了在德语法定文本中识别和分割法律条件（Tatbestand）和法律后果（Rechtsfolge）的任务。为了支持这项任务，我们提出了ANNOTARES（Tatbestand-Rechtsfolge序列的标注），一个包含德语法律文本及跨度级别标注的新数据集。该数据集涵盖了三个不同的法律法规，旨在评估特定领域的性能和跨法规的泛化能力。我们对多种架构方法进行了基准测试：一个基于规则的基线、CRF、BiLSTM、BiLSTM-CRF，以及包括BERT变体和基于LLM的方法在内的现代Transformer模型。我们的结果表明，BERT和基于LLM的模型在捕捉法律语言复杂的句法结构方面取得了优越的性能。我们发布我们的数据集，以促进自动化法律推理的进一步研究。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了ANNOTARES数据集，旨在解决德语法律文本中法律条件和法律后果提取的挑战。该数据集包含跨三个法律法规的标注数据，用于评估不同模型的性能。实验结果显示，基于BERT和LLM的模型在处理法律文本的复杂句法结构方面表现出色，为自动化法律推理的研究奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 法律文本分析, 逻辑结构提取, ANNOTARES数据集, Transformer模型, 法律科技
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入ANNOTARES数据集，有效地解决了法律文本逻辑结构提取这一关键问题。数据集的多样性和标注的细粒度为模型评估提供了坚实的基础。研究结果强调了先进的Transformer模型在理解复杂法律语言方面的潜力，为法律科技的进一步发展指明了方向。不过，未来可以进一步探索该数据集在不同法律体系或语言中的泛化能力。

title: ATLAS: Learning to Recommend Across Unseen Domains
comments: 18 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Includes appendix with proofs and additional experiments
summary: Recommender systems remain domain-bound: a model trained on one interaction environment typically requires retraining or target-domain adaptation before it can operate on a new catalogue. A recommender trained on movies cannot be directly deployed to recommend groceries or video games. Existing approaches mitigate this by transferring restricted forms of recommendation knowledge, adapting to the target domain, or leveraging large language models (LLMs) for transferable representations. We instead ask whether recommendation-specific knowledge learned solely from multiple heterogeneous domains can generalize to entirely unseen domains without target-domain adaptation or language-model pretraining. We introduce ATLAS, a multi-source recommendation domain generalization framework that learns a shared, domain-invariant user-item representation from disjoint source domains, enabling zero-shot recommendation on unseen domains. ATLAS combines a Gromov-Wasserstein alignment that preserves how users relate to one another across domains, an adversarial objective that makes item representations indistinguishable across domains, and residual vector quantization (RVQ) codebooks that compress user and item embeddings into a discrete latent space, capturing hierarchical interaction patterns while suppressing domain-specific variation. Trained on five Amazon domains and applied directly to ten unseen domains, ATLAS outperforms state-of-the-art sequential, graph-based, cross-domain, quantization-based, and LLM-based baselines on most unseen domains, with an average relative gain in HitRate of 24%. Ablations and representation analyses validate each component, and we identify a pronounced source-domain diversity effect: increasing source heterogeneity substantially improves zero-shot transfer. ATLAS establishes recommendation domain generalization as a promising paradigm for zero-shot recommendation.
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Includes appendix with proofs and additional experiments

AI.title_translation: ATLAS：学习跨越未见域的推荐
AI.tldr: ATLAS是一个多源推荐域泛化框架，通过学习共享的、域不变的用户-物品表示，实现了在未见域的零样本推荐，无需目标域适应或语言模型预训练。它结合了Gromov-Wasserstein对齐、对抗性目标和残差向量量化，并在大量实验中证明了其优越性，表明域泛化是零样本推荐的一个有前途的范式。
AI.motivation: 现有的推荐系统通常受限于特定领域，需要重新训练或进行目标域适应才能在新环境中运行。本研究旨在探索是否能仅通过从多个异构域学习推荐知识，实现向完全未见域的泛化，而无需目标域适应或语言模型预训练。
AI.method: ATLAS框架结合了三种技术：1. Gromov-Wasserstein对齐，用于保持用户间的跨域关系。2. 对抗性目标，用于使物品表示在不同域之间无法区分。3. 残差向量量化（RVQ）码本，将用户和物品嵌入压缩到离散的潜在空间，捕捉分层交互模式并抑制域特定变异。
AI.result: 在五个亚马逊域上训练的ATLAS模型，在十个未见域上直接应用，其在大多数未见域上的表现优于最先进的基线方法（包括顺序、基于图、跨域、基于量化和基于LLM的方法），平均相对命中率提升了24%。消融实验和表示分析验证了每个组件的有效性，并发现增加源域多样性可显著提高零样本迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS成功实现了推荐域泛化，为零样本推荐提供了一个有前途的范式。研究结果表明，通过学习域不变表示，推荐系统可以有效地泛化到未见域，而无需进行昂贵的目标域适应或依赖大型语言模型。
AI.translation: 推荐系统仍然受限于特定领域：在一个交互环境中训练的模型通常需要重新训练或进行目标域适应才能在新目录上运行。在电影上训练的推荐器不能直接部署到推荐杂货或视频游戏。现有方法通过转移有限形式的推荐知识、适应目标域或利用大型语言模型（LLM）进行可迁移表示来缓解这种情况。我们转而询问，仅从多个异构域学习到的特定于推荐的知识是否能在没有目标域适应或语言模型预训练的情况下泛化到完全未见的域。我们引入了ATLAS，一个多源推荐域泛化框架，它从不相交的源域学习共享的、域不变的用户-物品表示，从而在未见域中实现零样本推荐。ATLAS结合了Gromov-Wasserstein对齐（保持用户间的相对关系）、对抗性目标（使物品表示在域之间无法区分）以及残差向量量化（RVQ）码本（将用户和物品嵌入压缩到离散的潜在空间，捕捉分层交互模式并抑制域特定变异）。ATLAS在五个亚马逊域上训练，并直接应用于十个未见域，在大多数未见域上的表现优于最先进的顺序、基于图、跨域、基于量化和基于LLM的基线，平均相对命中率提高了24%。消融实验和表示分析验证了每个组件，我们发现了一个显著的源域多样性效应：增加源域异质性可显著提高零样本迁移能力。ATLAS将推荐域泛化确立为一个有前途的零样本推荐范式。
AI.summary: ATLAS是一个创新的推荐系统框架，通过学习域不变的用户-物品表示，实现了在未见域的零样本推荐。它利用Gromov-Wasserstein对齐、对抗性学习和残差向量量化来捕捉跨域用户关系和物品共性，同时消除域特定信息。实验证明，ATLAS在多个未见域上显著优于现有技术，并且源域的多样性对其性能至关重要，为解决推荐系统的领域限制问题提供了一种新途径。
AI.keywords: 推荐系统,域泛化,零样本推荐,Gromov-Wasserstein,残差向量量化
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为ATLAS的域泛化框架，旨在解决推荐系统在跨不同领域时性能下降的问题。其核心创新在于通过Gromov-Wasserstein对齐、对抗性学习和残差向量量化等技术，学习一种能够泛化到未见域的共享、域不变的用户-物品表示。这种方法避免了对目标域数据的依赖以及对大型语言模型的预训练，从而在零样本推荐场景下展现出强大的潜力。实验结果表明，ATLAS在多个未见域上取得了显著的性能提升，平均命中率提高了24%，证明了域泛化作为一种解决推荐系统领域限制问题的有效范式。此外，研究还强调了源域多样性对模型性能的关键影响，为未来研究提供了有价值的见解。然而，该方法在处理极其稀疏或高度特异性领域时的表现仍有待进一步探索。

title: When Efficiency Becomes Fragility: Exploiting Dynamic Routing Vulnerabilities in Adaptive UAV Tracking
summary: Resource constraints on UAV platforms have driven a paradigm shift in aerial tracking, from pursuing performance toward balancing accuracy with efficiency. Adaptive Transformer Trackers, which leverage an input-dependent dynamic routing architecture, have emerged as a representative solution to this challenge. However, we reveal that behind this computation-on-demand flexibility hides a critical structural flaw: the Lipschitz singularity of computational path decisions, which has an unbounded local Lipschitz constant at discrete layer-skipping decision boundaries. This mathematical discontinuity renders adaptive tracking networks inherently unstable: tiny input perturbations can be amplified at the gating modules, causing dramatic changes in the inference topology. We formally characterize this singularity in the context of adaptive tracking architectures and, for the first time, identify it as a directly exploitable new attack surface. This insight reveals a previously overlooked and highly vulnerable topological path space attack surface. Based on this, we propose the Adversarial Path-Inversion (API) framework. API generates imperceptible perturbations to precisely manipulate the gating decisions, forcing the inference onto altered computational paths. The severe inconsistency between the original and the inverted paths dismantles the representation capability of the model. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art adaptive trackers demonstrate that API achieves superior perturbation stealthiness, more effective attack, and faster inference speeds. This work opens a new dimension for the security analysis of dynamic tracking networks and provides a theoretical warning for constructing robust adaptive tracking architectures in the future.

AI.title_translation: 效率如何成为脆弱性：利用自适应无人机跟踪中的动态路由漏洞
AI.tldr: 自适应跟踪器利用动态路由来平衡精度和效率，但这种动态路由存在一个固有的数学缺陷（Lipschitz奇点），这使得它们容易受到称为API的新型攻击。API通过引入微小的、不易察觉的扰动来操纵模型的计算路径，从而严重破坏其跟踪能力。
AI.motivation: 资源限制促使无人机跟踪从追求性能转向平衡精度和效率。自适应Transformer跟踪器利用动态路由，但这种灵活性隐藏了一个关键的结构缺陷：计算路径决策的Lipschitz奇点，导致网络不稳定，容易受到输入扰动的放大，从而改变推理拓扑。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为API（Adversarial Path-Inversion）的框架。API生成不可感知的扰动来精确地操纵门控决策，强制推理转向改变的计算路径，从而破坏模型的表示能力。
AI.result: API框架能够实现优越的扰动隐蔽性、更有效的攻击和更快的推理速度。实验证明，与最先进的自适应跟踪器相比，API能够成功地攻击它们。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为动态跟踪网络的安全性分析开辟了一个新的维度，并为未来构建鲁棒的自适应跟踪架构提供了理论警示。
AI.translation: 鉴于无人机平台的资源限制，空中跟踪已从追求性能转向平衡精度与效率。利用输入相关动态路由架构的自适应Transformer跟踪器已成为这一挑战的代表性解决方案。然而，我们揭示，在这种按需计算的灵活性背后，隐藏着一个关键的结构缺陷：计算路径决策的Lipschitz奇点，它在离散的层跳跃决策边界处具有无界的局部Lipschitz常数。这种数学不连续性使得自适应跟踪网络本质上不稳定：微小的输入扰动会在门控模块处被放大，导致推理拓扑发生剧烈变化。我们在这个自适应跟踪架构的背景下，正式地表征了这个奇点，并首次将其识别为一个可以直接利用的新攻击面。这一见解揭示了一个先前被忽视且高度脆弱的拓扑路径空间攻击面。基于此，我们提出了对抗性路径反转（API）框架。API生成不可感知的扰动，以精确地操纵门控决策，强制推理转向改变的计算路径。原始路径和反转路径之间的严重不一致性，破坏了模型的表示能力。在最先进的自适应跟踪器上的广泛实验表明，API实现了优越的扰动隐蔽性、更有效的攻击和更快的推理速度。这项工作为动态跟踪网络的安全性分析开辟了一个新的维度，并为未来构建鲁棒的自适应跟踪架构提供了理论警示。
AI.summary: 该研究揭示了自适应无人机跟踪器中动态路由的潜在脆弱性。研究人员发现，其输入依赖的动态路由机制存在Lipschitz奇点，这使得模型容易受到微小扰动的攻击，导致推理路径发生剧烈变化。为此，研究人员提出了对抗性路径反转（API）框架，通过生成不可见的扰动来操纵模型的计算路径，从而有效攻击自适应跟踪器。实验证明了API的有效性和隐蔽性，并为未来设计更安全的自适应跟踪系统提供了警示。
AI.keywords: 自适应跟踪器,动态路由,Lipschitz奇点,对抗性攻击,无人机跟踪
AI.comments: 这项研究非常有价值，它揭示了当前自适应无人机跟踪器在效率和安全性之间的权衡问题。通过精确的数学分析，发现了动态路由机制中的关键漏洞，并提出了有效的攻击方法。这不仅有助于理解现有模型的局限性，也为未来开发更鲁棒、更安全的跟踪系统提供了重要的理论指导和实践启示。然而，该研究主要关注理论分析和攻击方法，对于防御此类攻击的策略和实现，可以进一步探索。

title: Why do we need social singularity? A mechanism-based critique of gradual scenarios in AI existential-risk discourse
summary: This paper critiques recent gradual and cumulative AI existential-risk scenarios, arguing that, despite their substantive contributions, they remain insufficiently sociologically specified. In particular, these scenarios lack a reflexive perspective, retain a largely technologically deterministic structure, and underestimate the role of collective agency and other social processes. As a result, they also discount the possibility of major social conflict accompanying AI diffusion, which limits their overall plausibility. The paper further identifies a set of social mechanisms likely to become significant before or during AI deployment, including interpretive and performative dynamics, mobilisation and countermobilisation, path dependence and lock-in, cross-regime divergence and multi-speed diffusion, and social-psychological mechanisms such as attachment and reactance. It argues that these mechanisms will interact recursively with AI diffusion and reshape future trajectories, which may subsequently branch, reverse, or undergo discontinuous shifts, thereby expanding the space of plausible AI futures. On this basis, the paper also proposes a novel analytic distinction between technological singularity and social singularity. Whereas the former refers to a putative technological threshold in AI development, the latter denotes a social discontinuity produced by the anticipated approach of that threshold. The central implication is that the most consequential disruptions may emerge not only from advanced AI itself, but also from the social dynamics provoked by the expectation of its arrival.

title: Microlocal analysis of a non-linear cone transform and applications to Compton camera imaging
summary: We present a novel method to recover the source intensity, $f : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$, and attenuation coefficient, $μ: \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$, in Compton camera imaging. We apply a non-linear model, which accounts for ray attenuation. We show that the data, $h$, can be modeled $h = \mathcal{R}(f,μ) = R(fg)$, where $g = \exp(-Gμ)$ models attenuation, $G$ is a (linear) divergent beam transform, and $R$ is a linear operator which defines the integrals of $fg$ over cones. Commonly in the literature, $μ$ is set to zero, and the data $h = Rf$ is linear. We address the case when $μ\neq 0$ and the transform is non-linear. To simplify the analysis, we first transform the data into weighted line integrals, $\tilde{h} = \mathcal{D}_k(f,μ) = D_k(fg)$, where $D_k$ is a weighted ray transform. Assuming practically reasonable geometric conditions, we show that $\tilde{h} = \exp(-X_{w_1}μ)X_{w_2}f$, where $X_w$ is a weighted X-ray transform, and the $w_i$ are smooth weights. After which, we use the theory of conormal distributions to describe the singularities of $\tilde{h}$. We show that there are artifacts in the reconstruction, and we quantify their strength using Sobolev spaces. We combine this theory with a geometric argument to recover the edges of $f$ and ultimately prove that $f$ and $μ$ are unique to $h$. The recovery of $f$ is notably more stable than that of $μ$, which we also discuss. To validate our theory, we present simulated reconstructions of $f$ and $μ$ using the proposed method.

title: Socially Grounded Agentic AI: Coordinating Plural Perspectives through Social Theory
comments: Pluralistic Alignment Workshop @ ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
summary: As AI systems are deployed across increasingly diverse social contexts, alignment can no longer be framed as the optimization of a single, unified set of values. Instead, systems must be able to recognize, represent, and respond to multiple legitimate perspectives. This has led to growing interest in pluralistic alignment, which seeks to move beyond one-size-fits-all models of appropriate behaviour. However, current approaches often lack a clear account of how values are socially organized, contested, and coordinated in practice. In this paper, we argue that social theory provides essential conceptual and design resources for addressing these challenges. Drawing on established traditions in sociology, we show how perspectives can be understood as structured by roles, shaped through interaction, and distributed across fields of power and expertise. We translate these insights into concrete implications for AI system design, including role-based representations, structured coordination among perspectives, and context-sensitive evaluation. For agentic systems, this requires aligning not only final outputs, but also the role activations, deliberative traces, aggregation rules, and feedback loops through which those outputs are produced. Our contribution is to reposition pluralistic alignment as a problem of socially grounded coordination rather than output diversification. We outline a design space for systems that engage multiple perspectives in structured and accountable ways, and we identify directions for future work to implement and empirically evaluate these approaches in real-world settings.
comment: Pluralistic Alignment Workshop @ ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea

title: UniEvo-RS: Omni-Prompt Unified Remote Sensing Segmentation with Representative Exemplar-Driven Prototype Evolution
summary: Prompt-driven vision-language models (VLMs) hold immense promise for accelerating dense remote sensing (RS) annotation, but static models suffer from severe performance degradation when deployed on novel scenes, unseen categories, or visually confusing backgrounds. Moreover, existing unified paradigms primarily rely on intra-image specific prompts, lacking flexible task routing to adapt to multi-intent operational workflows. In practical batch mapping, annotators typically refine a small set of representative samples before processing large datasets. Motivated by this practice, we propose UniEvo-RS, an omni-prompt unified RS segmentation framework equipped with representative exemplar-driven prototype evolution. First, we construct a multi-instruction prompt dataset that unifies text-driven and visual-driven prompts within a single architecture, establishing a dynamic task-routing mechanism for highly diverse RS annotation scenarios. Second, we introduce a representative feedback-driven, training-free prototype evolution mechanism. By contrasting manual annotations with initial predictions on exemplars, UniEvo-RS distills prediction errors into positive and negative prototypes. These prototypes enhance LLM query recall and suppress spatial background noise under a fixed-budget clustering memory. Extensive experiments show that UniEvo-RS unifies diverse prompting tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance across most settings. Crucially, with minimal interaction on a few exemplars, it enables training-free, progressive accuracy enhancement on unseen categories during batch annotation.

title: StreamDAM: Presence-Aware Memory for Real-Time Streaming Video Object Segmentation
summary: Quality-tier video object segmentation (VOS) trackers such as DAM4SAM top accuracy leaderboards, but they are measured offline, one frame at a time with no clock. Under an honest streaming protocol at 30 frames per second, where a frame that misses its budget is served the last mask already computed, the winner collapses: the rich memory that makes it accurate is too slow to keep up, and what it emits is blind to whether the object is even present. We trace both failures to one place, the tracker's memory pipeline, and rebuild it for streaming. \method{} makes the memory machinery itself run at frame rate through in-model optimization rather than a bolted-on fallback, and governs it with a single learned presence signal that decides what enters memory, how far back the tracker reads, when to withhold output, and when to re-detect. A mechanism analysis shows why a fixed policy cannot win: the control that helps when an object truly disappears is the one that hurts when it is merely hard to see, so the choice must be made per frame. Across four benchmarks and five modern baselines, \method{} is the strongest streaming tracker, recovers nearly all of the offline model's accuracy under the clock, and on the hardest content exceeds the offline model it is built from.

title: Sparse Weight Decomposition for Efficient Circuit Extraction
summary: Dense pretrained transformers do not naturally expose interpretable units for circuit extraction. Existing approaches obtain such units by learning auxiliary sparse representations or training sparse models, incurring substantial additional computation while potentially introducing a fidelity gap between the representation being analyzed and the original pretrained model. We propose Sparse Weight Decomposition (SWD), which reparameterizes pretrained linear projections by factorizing each weight matrix into two sparse factors whose shared intermediate coordinates serve as individually addressable circuit units. Without training a separate replacement network, this parametric representation supports the same scoring, selection, and ablation circuit extraction workflow used for methods that learn sparse features. Across single-matrix replacements, SWD matches the held-out fidelity achieved by Transcoder and other strong baselines while using less than 1% of the data that those baselines use to train their replacements. For matched replacement fidelity, SWD reaches the same circuit sufficiency and necessity targets with fewer active read/write edges and selected units across tasks on GPT-2, Qwen2.5, and Qwen3.5-27B. We further show that SWD remains effective for full-model replacement of all attention and MLP weight matrices after fine-tuning the nonzero factor values. Finally, SWD also features a zero-data variant, allowing broader use of mechanistic interpretability analysis (e.g., per-step analysis).

title: Trajectory inference via Acceleration Matching
summary: Trajectory inference is a fundamental problem in many scientific domains: given a collection of unpaired snapshots of observations at discrete time points, the goal is to generate smooth trajectories that best resemble and interpolate the data. Existing algorithms exhibit computational challenges: they either rely on preprocessing subroutines to enforce smoothness or on simulation-based training objectives, both of which can be expensive. In order to overcome these limitations, we propose a new algorithm called Acceleration Matching (\texttt{AM}). Our approach consists of lifting the original interpolation problem to phase space and then regressing onto an explicit conditional acceleration field that induces random, smooth trajectories that agree with the prescribed marginals. Importantly, our resulting training algorithm only requires positional data, avoids trajectory simulation during training, and is devoid of expensive preprocessing. We provide ample numerical evidence suggesting that \texttt{AM} is competitive with or superior to existing algorithms on several benchmark problems from the existing literature.

title: Implementing Causal Perception: Competing SCMs and Situated Fairness
summary: Causal perception occurs when agents with competing Structural Causal Models (SCMs) of the same system infer different probability distributions, including the hypothetical distributions implied by each agent's SCM under the same set of interventions. It shapes how agents reason about the system and how they perceive its fairness. Causal perception is a promising probabilistic framework, but it has remained purely theoretical. This work provides the first implementation of the causal perception framework of Álvarez and Ruggieri (2025). We operationalize structural (agents disagree on the causal graph) and parametrical (agents agree on the causal graph but disagree on its weights) causal perception. We design algorithms for computing interventional and counterfactual distributions and propose suitable distance measures to quantify the disagreement. Using the German Credit dataset, we illustrate how causal perception affects accuracy and fairness in a multi-expert decision setting. We show that the perception verdict is sensitive to the choice of distance metric and threshold. We also show that causal perception changes fairness assessments and threshold-based decisions. Bias proves situated with respect to the agent's SCM, demonstrating that competing worldviews in fairness problems cannot be ignored.

title: When and Where to Look: Adaptive Visual Evidence Scheduling for Efficient Long Video Understanding
summary: Efficient long-video understanding requires vision--language models (VLMs) to reason over a small number of frames selected as sparse visual evidence. Existing relevance-based methods rely on static one-shot selection with fixed frame budgets and candidate pools, while agent-based schedulers achieve adaptivity through costly multi-round reasoning and interactive search. We propose EcoFrame, a training-free framework for low-overhead query-adaptive visual evidence scheduling. EcoFrame leverages the VLM's inference feedback to determine when to increase the frame budget and where to search for additional candidate evidence. Specifically, entropy-gated budget scheduling uses output uncertainty to stop early when the current evidence is sufficient or progressively expand the frame budget otherwise. Meanwhile, attention-guided candidate proposal converts frame-level attention into a temporal prior, enabling dense local search in informative regions while preserving global coverage when attention is diffuse. Experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU demonstrate that EcoFrame achieves a better accuracy--efficiency trade-off across multiple VLM backbones. On Qwen2.5-VL, EcoFrame achieves an average accuracy of 64.4, surpassing BOLT at 63.5, while providing a $1.85\times$ speedup over AKS and BOLT. Compared with the agent-based A.I.R., EcoFrame maintains comparable accuracy with up to a $13.5\times$ inference speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/AK-DREAM/EcoFrame.

title: Low-Dimensional High-Leverage Subspace Optimization: Beyond Full-Parameter Coupled Training for Neural Network Quantization
summary: Low-bit quantization suffers severe accuracy degradation on compact networks, rooted in the dominant full-parameter coupled training paradigm that ignores parameter subspace heterogeneity. Their limited feature redundancy leaves little room to absorb quantization errors. Conventional pipelines adopt monolithic optimization: PTQ reconstructs fixed pretrained models without improving inherent quantization friendliness; QAT updates all parameters jointly, suffering from gradient coupling between backbone weights and calibration parameters. In this paper, we identify normalization affine parameters as a low-dimensional high-leverage subspace dominating quantization robustness, and propose Normalization Affine Preconditioning (NAP) for targeted subspace optimization. For PTQ, NAP freezes backbone weights and fine-tunes only affine parameters under the target fake-quantization graph on full-precision models, proactively boosting quantization friendliness before downstream reconstruction. For QAT, we introduce an alternating QAT-NAP schema that decouples feature learning and numerical calibration, breaking the performance ceiling of saturated joint training. Theoretical analysis confirms BN affine parameters fully cancel the channel-wise affine component of quantization distortion, while nonlinear rounding and clipping residuals form the irreducible error boundary; distillation-guided NAP acts as directional flatness optimization, projecting teacher-student logit mismatch onto the restricted subspace. Experiments on ImageNet and CIFAR-100 show NAP recovers severely collapsed low-bit quantization, consistently boosts reconstruction-based PTQ, and outperforms saturated full-parameter QAT with negligible tuning cost. This work reveals the principle of targeted low-dimensional subspace optimization, offering a new perspective beyond full-parameter coupled training for efficient deep learning.

title: Equivariant Music Transformer
summary: Humans recognize a musical passage even when it is shifted in time or transposed in pitch, indicating a notion of equivariance in the representation space. Our analysis, however, shows that standard music transformers map such time-shifted or pitch-transposed inputs onto uncorrelated representations: these models become progressively less equivariant as they scale in size or train longer. This suggests that in standard music transformers, additional model capacity is allocated to memorizing absolute patterns rather than capturing shared musical structures. In this paper, we propose the Equivariant Music Transformer (EMT), which enforces equivariance through self-distillation by jointly optimizing a next-token-prediction and an auxiliary equivariance regularization loss. We find that the additional equivariance loss acts as a beneficial regularizer, simultaneously improving next-token prediction and producing equivariant latent representations. Through both objective and subjective evaluations, EMT demonstrates superior equivariance and generative capability compared to data augmentation, feature engineering, and state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines. More broadly, our findings reveal that standard language modeling methods alone do not capture music's translational symmetries, and dedicated inductive biases are required to produce better music representations. The code, weights and demos are available online.

title: The Transformer Revolution, Part 1: Dynamic Processing through Output- Weight Interconnections
comments: v1: 7 Sections, References, Appendix, Tables (2 tables), Figures Part A (6 figures), Figures Part B (42 figures), Figures Part C (5 figures)
summary: This paper offers a new interpretation of the Transformer during inference. Against the "stochastic parrot" view that large language models merely reproduce statistical regularities learned in training, we argue that Transformers construct and apply prompt-dependent transformations whose parameters are generated during inference. We call this form of computation SIDPP: Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing. The Transformer is interpreted as a system that transforms concepts by means of concepts. Token vectors are the concepts to be transformed; parameterized transformations defined by matrices and vectors are the transforming concepts. These may be static, when fixed through training, or dynamic, when generated from the input sequence. Mechanically, they correspond to groups of simple neural networks.
